sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: After an actual Dexterity (Acrobatics) task resolves to Failure or Critical Failure, or loses an opposed check including an initiating tie, and before its consequences commit, you may spend this feat's one long-rest use to reroll that complete check. NEW: reroll the entire original one- or two-d20 procedure with the same advantage/disadvantage state and the same modifiers. Keep the new result even if worse, recomputing natural shifts for a fixed DC; the opponent's already rolled total does not change. The reroll is part of the original paid action, not another movement attempt or escape Action. If another feature can alter a die, declare an eligible sequence before resolving it; this feat cannot reroll its own reroll, and no earlier result can be restored merely because the new result is worse. A purely Strength (Athletics) check does not qualify.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Complete-procedure reroll; Critical Failure and opposed-loss coverage; result-information window; one-use initialization follows shared proposal.
submittedWorkedCases: DC 15, original natural 3 plus 3 gives Failure. Spend the use; the replacement natural 1 plus 3 becomes Critical Failure and must stand. The falling consequence occurs once after the replacement.
With advantage, original faces 2/4 and +3 fail DC 15. Replace both faces, not only the lower face. If replacement 1/8 gives 11, keep Failure; no second use is available until a completed long rest.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep complete-procedure reroll before committed consequences; fixed-DC degrees and opposed-total loss remain different. LR is beneficial owner rest, not a daily reset.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW: Soldier means at least one actually acquired level in the Soldier Base class; a background title, uniform, rank or NPC occupation alone does not satisfy it. Add +2 when the Director calls for an ability check whose declared goal is evaluating a concrete battlefield plan, deployment, approach, withdrawal or fortification. Intelligence (Investigation) analyzes visible formations and routes; Intelligence (History) recalls an actually studied battle or doctrine; Intelligence (Engineering) evaluates a constructed defense. Use another ability/skill only when the actual task warrants it, with PB once. Do not roll merely to obtain the bonus. The result supplies the ordinary task's actionable information or plan, not extra allied attacks, higher class save DCs, free Overwatch, advance knowledge of hidden forces or compelled obedience. Timing and information access belong to that actual planning task.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Soldier class binding; bounded task examples using existing skills; no new Tactics skill.
submittedWorkedCases: A Soldier 1 with INT 14 and Investigation proficiency analyzes an observed barricade: d20 + INT + PB + 2. Their later crossbow attack receives none of the tactics bonus.
A character with a soldier-themed background but zero Soldier class levels does not meet this proposed acquisition gate.

originalSourceObject.effect: When you roll a natural 1 on an Animal Handling check, treat the die as a 2. You can communicate simple emotional intent to beasts through posture and sound.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: On an actual Animal Handling check, replace every d20 face of 1 with an effective face of 2 before selecting the advantage/disadvantage die, calculating the total and applying fixed-DC natural shifts. Keep the rolled face in history, but use 2 for this check's natural-result rule. Apply the same replacement to any lawfully rerolled die. It is a replacement, not another roll or a reroll trigger. A margin can still produce Critical Failure; the broader legacy promise is not adopted. Through observable posture and audible sound, communicate a simple emotional intent such as calm, warning, approach or leave. The beast must perceive the relevant signal. This grants neither language comprehension nor obedience, a trained mount, communication through total sensory obstruction, nor a changed attitude. A check is required only where the ordinary interaction calls for one.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: While your current body has usable grasping anatomy and the surface has actual adequate handholds, gain a climbing Speed equal to your current legal walking Speed. Apply body, load, armor and condition limits that actually govern that movement; do not derive a fresh unpenalized speed. Expenditure still comes from the shared movement budget. A steep angle alone does not impose disadvantage on a required climbing check. A sheer or inverted route still needs a check and an actually supportable method: usable cracks, holds, rigging, an anchor or another explicit ability. This feat provides no adhesion to a smooth unsupported ceiling. The Director states grip failure, a fall or loss of progress before the check under the route's actual conditions. Other causes of disadvantage, required hands, hazardous surfaces and zero-Speed conditions remain.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Current-speed derivation; support/anatomy requirements; angle-only disadvantage removal; prerequisite mapping is shared NEW proposal.
submittedWorkedCases: Walking Speed reduced from 30 to 20 gives climbing Speed 20 on a held wall. Moving 10 feet on the ground leaves 10 feet of this movement budget for climbing.

A perfectly smooth inverted ceiling with no anchor is not traversable solely with this feat. A rope-supported inverted traverse can be attempted, with no angle-only disadvantage but any actual slickness penalty intact.

originalSourceObject.description: Careful insight and presence let the character read the listed surface thoughts in dialogue.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Observe one actual creature speaking for a continuous minute, with sufficient access to its audible speech and relevant visible or otherwise perceivable behavior. NEW: understand that speech directly or through an actually present interpreter whose interpretation spans the observation; a written transcript alone is insufficient. At the minute's end make Wisdom (Insight) opposed by that creature's Charisma (Deception), with ordinary actual proficiency. Higher total wins; a tie yields no new insight. On success the Director supplies one genuine current surface motive, emotional pressure or conversational goal reasonably supported by the observation. It is a fact about that exchange, not an ongoing mind-reading effect, a lie detector, an exact secret thought or proof of the speaker's factual claims. To try again on the same issue, obtain materially new behavior, stakes or evidence. Time still passes and an unwilling subject may stop speaking or leave.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Continuous access and understanding requirement; interpreter bridge; opposed tie and renewed-evidence boundary.
submittedWorkedCases: Insight 16 versus Deception 16 leaves the conversation unchanged; no motive is revealed. An additional identical minute does not earn an automatic fresh attempt.
Success can reveal that a merchant urgently wants the meeting ended. It does not reveal the unknown name of the person they intend to meet afterward.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At acquisition choose History, Religion, or one specifically documented culture-specific Lore credential. If you are not proficient in the selected credential, gain its proficiency. If you already are, use twice PB for that credential's checks concerning cultures, customs and historical context; other checks in the selected skill retain normal PB. NEW: snapshot which branch applies on acquisition. Later gaining proficiency from another source does not retroactively convert the initial proficiency grant into Expertise. If a chosen culture has no separate recorded Lore credential, record a bounded History specialization for that named existing culture. It gives proficiency only for that subject, or twice PB there if History or that same subject is already proficient; it never creates general proficiency in a twenty-first skill. Double PB replaces rather than adds to normal PB and does not stack with other Expertise. Preserve actual access to knowledge and existing canon. No cosmological fact or cultural history is authored by choosing the feat.

originalSourceObject.name: Disguise Expert
originalSourceObject.description: Practiced deception adds the listed +5 when the character is disguised.
originalSourceObject.effect: While wearing a prepared disguise, add +2 to Deception checks made to maintain the assumed identity. Creating a convincing disguise requires appropriate materials and 10 minutes.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Spend ten actual minutes preparing a physically plausible assumed identity using sufficient actual clothing, cosmetics, props and appropriate tools for the chosen disguise. Record its identity, wearer, materials and limitations. The feat owner gains +2 to their Deception checks to maintain that identity while actually wearing the prepared disguise; creating a disguise for another person does not give that wearer this feat's bonus. NEW: an existing prepared disguise made by another competent person can qualify when the holder wears it as intended. A disguise does not alter body size, anatomy, voice, knowledge, language, credentials or magical signature unless another source actually does. Detection uses the actual encounter's check and observer; success in preparation is not permanent immunity to inspection. Ordinary materials grant no extra numerical modifier. A reviewed tailored garment's own disguise/task bonus keeps its separate documented family and wearer restrictions. A ruined or incompatible disguise ceases to qualify until legally repaired or prepared again.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Wearer ownership; preparation record; another creator's usable disguise; bonus-family proposal requires conference.
submittedWorkedCases: The feat owner prepares an ally's disguise in ten minutes; the ally gets the physical disguise but no borrowed +2. The owner wearing their own prepared disguise receives +2 on the actual identity-maintenance check.
A small disguise cannot make a Large creature fit a human-sized doorway or supply a password. A successful clothing deception does not resolve either obstacle.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep ten-minute physical preparation and wearer-owned bonus with actual attire-family eligibility; no new size, voice or credentials.

sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define normal travel pace, actual visibility/recording tools, ten-minute mapping requirement and what reliable means. originalSourceObject.name: Dungeon Cartographer
originalSourceObject.description: An experienced explorer builds a map while moving through a dungeon.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can create reliable maps while traveling at a normal pace. After mapping an area for 10 minutes, you and allies using the map gain advantage on checks to retrace that route until the dungeon reshapes it.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Use actual recording tools and observable route evidence to map while moving at the adopted normal travel pace. This expressly permits that narrow concurrent mapping; it does not permit another incompatible Watch job. NEW: track ten accumulated active minutes on one identified continuous route or area, pausing when unable to observe or record. After those minutes, the resulting map grants advantage to you and allies actually using an accurate accessible copy on checks whose purpose is retracing its recorded route. It conveys no unseen passage, secret door, current occupant or guaranteed safety. The map remains useful until the route is reshaped or materially changed; mark changed segments unreliable while preserving still-valid observations. A map of one path cannot supply advantage to another. The feat does not grant normal-pace stealth, foraging, scouting or unlimited movement.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Accumulated mapping minutes, route identity, accurate-copy access and segment invalidation; final pace supplied by expedition decision.
submittedWorkedCases: Six observable mapping minutes, a five-minute obscured halt, and four more observable minutes complete the ten-minute route record; the halt counts on the world clock but not as mapping.
After one bridge collapses, the old map can still guide the intact approach. It cannot grant advantage to cross the missing bridge or prove an unobserved alternate route exists.

Resolve once-per-Long-Rest per recipient versus practitioner, positive-healing gates, anti-loop ledgers and coexistence with reviewed Field Medic tempHP. Stable/already-conscious/dead subjects do not manufacture a new stabilization event.

originalSourceObject.name: Field Surgeon
originalSourceObject.description: A Wisdom-trained medic uses Medicine to stabilize an ally at 1 HP.
originalSourceObject.effect: When you successfully stabilize a dying creature with Medicine or a healer’s kit, it regains 1 hit point. A creature can benefit from this feat once per long rest.
originalSourceObject.legacyEffect: Stabilize ally with 1 HP using Medicine
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When you actually cause a living dying creature to become Stable by a legal Medicine stabilization or a real healer's-kit use, offer that recipient 1 HP. Use the ordinary Action/DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) route or the ordinary Action/one-kit-use route; an independently owned feature may explicitly change that action cost. NEW: treat the 1 HP as a direct state-recovery grant following the completed stabilization, not ordinary rolled healing. Broad cannot-regain-HP restrictions and the living-target gate apply; it receives no ordinary healing bonuses. Record one Field-Surgeon-family entitlement per recipient's own completed-long-rest epoch, shared across all practitioners. Commit it on the eligible offer even when HP gain is blocked. The actual stabilization remains recorded; if recovery is blocked the creature stays Stable at 0 with its normal existing recovery deadline. If positive HP is gained, clear the obsolete Stable deadline normally. A separately owned Field Medic temp-HP offer still uses the genuine stabilization event, even if the recipient is now at 1 HP. Already Stable or dead creatures create no new trigger.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Direct recovery classification; recipient family lock; blocked-offer consumption and event ordering. GPT must decide this classification against the current healing contract.
submittedWorkedCases: Medicine succeeds for a dying recipient: record stabilization, then recover 1 HP and end zero-HP unconsciousness if no independent cause remains. A later practitioner cannot supply a second Field Surgeon point before that recipient completes a long rest.
Decay blocks HP gain: the recipient remains Stable 0 and the feat entitlement is spent. Field Medic may still offer its separately legal temporary HP, which do not wake the recipient.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt direct 1-HP recovery after genuine stabilization and shared recipient LR-offer lock; keep broad recovery blockers, independent Field Medic and existing bodily consequences.

records.originalQuestion: Resolve Investigation5+, ten-minute scene examination, appropriate senses/access, actual successful check and a finite additional physical clue. Define no-extra-clue cases, repeat examinations, lost/moved evidence and no fabricated suspect identity or Director duty to create impossible evidence.

originalSourceObject.name: Forensic Investigator
originalSourceObject.description: Investigative training reveals the listed hidden clues from a scene.
originalSourceObject.effect: When examining a scene for at least 10 minutes, the Director must reveal one additional physical clue that could reasonably be discovered there on a successful Investigation check.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Spend at least ten active minutes examining an identified scene with actual senses, light, physical access and tools appropriate to the proposed search. Then resolve its Intelligence (Investigation) task and ordinary consequences. On Success or Critical Success, reveal one additional physical clue that could reasonably have been discovered in the searched evidence, beyond the ordinary success information. NEW: before resolving the check, the Director records a finite eligible extra clue or that no further physical evidence is available. If none exists, say so; do not invent evidence or refund the elapsed time. Interpretations are distinguished from observations. Repeating an unchanged search, sharing the result or adding a second feat owner cannot clone the same clue into a new fact. A new area, technique, access or evidence can justify a different examination. Destroyed or moved evidence must actually be available to the method used.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Finite predeclared clue reservoir; no-extra-clue output and repeat handling.
submittedWorkedCases: Ordinary success finds a forced lock; the feat additionally reveals an actual distinctive metal shaving caught in the frame. It cannot name the unknown culprit without evidence.
A thoroughly washed empty chamber may yield no surviving additional clue. Success confirms that no further physical clue is available to this examination; it does not create footprints.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep real ten-minute examination and finite additional clue; no clue is invented by a successful check or second owner.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Accurately recall the substance of text you actually read and understood. Verbatim quoting, locating a passage or comparing previously studied writings can still require an appropriate actual check; add +2 to that check. Recalling a straightforward understood summary needs no artificial roll solely to obtain a bonus. An unread cipher, unknown language, unseen page or remote revision is not previously studied content. Loss or alteration of memory by an explicit effect follows that effect. Knowing that a formula was discussed does not provide all missing formula instructions, research success, ownership rights or a prepared spell. The feat neither stores a perfect visual copy nor grants live remote access to the original.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Add +2 on a lawful check to open a lock whose actual construction the Director identifies as complex before the attempt. Possess the necessary access and implements; the feat does not provide them or a universal permission to pick a magical seal. NEW: the source's protection applies only to a trap whose trigger is this lock-opening attempt failing. If the final total is less than DC by 5 or more, that protection does not apply and the trap's real trigger resolves. A natural-1 task downgrade without a five-point numerical deficit does not by itself remove this protection. Independent touch, proximity, damage, time, wrong-key or tampering triggers still operate at their own actual moments even on a success. A legally repeated failed attempt receives the same margin rule but spends its real time and remains exposed to all independent events; it cannot undo a previously triggered trap. Thievery's acquisition bridge is specified in the shared proposal.

originalSourceObject.description: Survival 4+ and Wisdom 13+ support the listed tracking with +10 accuracy.

originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Add +2 on Survival checks whose actual purpose is tracking. Follow existing, perceivable tracks at the adopted normal travel pace and, on an actual successful tracking check, identify the approximate count, size and age of the tracks to the precision the evidence supports. NEW: use Wisdom (Survival) for following and reading tracks unless an actual task expressly calls for another ability. Record a range or uncertainty rather than fabricate an exact census from poor evidence. The normal-pace permission changes only the tracking activity and does not remove travel hazards, actual visibility limits, route access, cargo constraints or stealth penalties. No tracks, obliterated tracks or an unrelated map cannot become usable tracks solely because the feat is owned. Preserve `skill_feats1_master_tracker` as an alias of `master_tracker`; it adds no second acquisition or +2.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Ordinary skill ability; evidence-based precision; normal-pace scope; alias preservation.
submittedWorkedCases: Success may reveal roughly three Medium walkers who passed within the last hour. Intermixed prints may justify a count range rather than an exact identity.
A save containing both the current ID and its compatibility alias represents one feat and one +2 contribution, never +4.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep +2 and normal-pace tracking with real evidence; compatibility alias is one identity, not another grant.

sourceObject.description: Dexterity 15+ at level 7 supports the listed one automatic Escape Artist success each day.
sourceObject.effect: Once per long rest, when restrained or grappled, you may automatically succeed on the check or save to escape.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

records.originalQuestion: Define declaration and charge use for automatic success on an actual allowed grapple/restraint escape check or save. Bind action/time, source-specific escape availability, multiple restraints, no-save/no-check prisons and physical destination. It does not automatically grant teleportation or an escape roll absent from the source.

sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define declaration and charge use for automatic success on an actual allowed grapple/restraint escape check or save. originalSourceObject.name: Rogue’s Escape
originalSourceObject.description: Dexterity 15+ at level 7 supports the listed one automatic Escape Artist success each day.
originalSourceObject.effect: Once per long rest, when restrained or grappled, you may automatically succeed on the check or save to escape.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once per completed long rest, while actually Grappled or Restrained, you may declare automatic success in place of one check or save that the holding effect actually permits to escape. NEW: declare and spend the use immediately before rolling, after choosing the legal escape action and paying its normal action or other cost. This supplies ordinary Success, not Critical Success or a natural 20. For an opposed escape, it wins that one permitted escape contest. Resolve the printed successful escape outcome for the selected holding effect; independent grapples/restraints remain unless that source's single check ends them together. No-check prisons, an inaccessible release mechanism, unconscious action restrictions or a feature forbidding an escape attempt are not bypassed. The feat changes no location by itself and grants neither movement nor teleportation. The spent use is not refunded because another restraint still holds you.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Pre-roll declaration, opposed-success bridge, one-effect target and no invented escape permission.
submittedWorkedCases: Spend an Action and the feat use on the one grapple's allowed Athletics/Acrobatics escape; it succeeds, but a separate magical restraint requiring its own save remains.
A sealed stone cell with no Grappled/Restrained escape check provides no eligible activation and spends no feat use.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep pre-roll ordinary success on one already-authorized escape; pay original Action and LR allowance, no new escape, teleport or critical benefit.

records.originalQuestion: Resolve Arcana5+, one-minute real study/sight/language requirements, school and activation-method information, harmfulness and mythic concealment. Define the no-trigger protection's exact scope against proximity/touch/time triggers without making all runes inert or granting activation/control/formula knowledge.

sourceDirection.name: Runic Scholar
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Resolve Arcana5+, one-minute real study/sight/language requirements, school and activation-method information, harmfulness and mythic concealment. originalSourceObject.name: Runic Scholar
originalSourceObject.description: Arcana 5+ and Intelligence 14+ support the listed instant identification of magical symbols.
originalSourceObject.effect: After studying a magical symbol for 1 minute, identify its school, activation method, and whether it is harmful without triggering it, unless it is protected by mythic concealment.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Study one actual magical symbol for one continuous minute with sufficient direct perception of its relevant marks. NEW: passive visual or equivalent noncontact examination by this procedure is not itself treated as activating that symbol, including a trigger based solely on this feat's act of looking or recognizing. It does not suppress a trigger already satisfied by approach, touch, entering a ward, speech, a third party or elapsed time; those can interrupt or harm the scholar normally. Do not touch, speak an activation or cross a ward as a free part of study. At completion learn the actual school, activation method and whether activation is harmful. If the source has no school, report that instead of inventing one. An explicit mythic concealment blocks this information and is not dispelled. This is recognition of magical operation, not translation of arbitrary surrounding writing; ordinary language rules still govern quoted words and other text. Identification grants no control, disarming, copied spell or hidden formula.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Narrow study-caused-trigger immunity with explicit gaze bridge; independent triggers; no-school result and language boundary. Requires careful hazard comparison.
submittedWorkedCases: Studying a gaze-activated rune by this exact procedure does not activate it solely through that studying gaze. Crossing its separately specified threshold before the minute ends still triggers it.
A time-triggered mark activates at its deadline during the minute; the feat does not pause the deadline or retroactively finish the study.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt one-minute noncontact examination protection only against study-caused triggers; independent triggers/mythic concealment and surrounding text remain separate.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Remove only disadvantage on your Stealth check that an actual rule or stated terrain adjudication assigns because the terrain is nonmagical and difficult. Do not invent a default disadvantage for all difficult terrain. NEW: declare silent-debris movement before any voluntary movement on your turn; outside initiative declare it before the complete continuous traverse. Halve your otherwise current applicable movement Speed for that whole turn or traverse, including the Speed used by Dash, and pay ordinary terrain costs from that reduced budget. Changing movement mode or leaving the debris does not refund that interval's reduction. Your own careful footfalls and disturbed ordinary debris make no revealing sound from that traverse. This is a narrow sound suppression; carried clattering gear, speech, attacks, collisions, collapsing structures and other independent sounds remain. Actual difficult-terrain movement costs and body/load limits remain. Magical terrain's sound or disadvantage is not suppressed by the nonmagical clause. Observers may see, smell or otherwise locate you; use actual Hide/Stealth rules for those senses. The feat does not establish Hidden automatically.

A silent traverse across pebbles remains plainly visible in a lit corridor. A loudly rattling carried chain is a separate sound source.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: First identify an actually authorized copying procedure and the exact spell or scroll, legal source access, rank, language/notation, ability/tool requirements, facility and recipient record. Reduce only that actor's eligible copying active time to one half and mundane-material quantities to three quarters; rare inks and unique components are unchanged. NEW: apply the strongest eligible reduction separately to each time/material category, rather than multiplying overlapping reductions. Wizard Spell Scribing therefore supplies the same half-time factor and its better half-cost factor for its own qualifying copying; owning both gives neither quarter time nor a second material discount. Convert to minutes and round the final active time upward to a whole minute. For divisible mundane inputs retain exact quantities; for indivisible items round required remaining units upward; a listed aggregate gp expense rounds upward to the next cp. Separately identify rare/unique inputs before applying a discount to a mixed bill. No classification from absence: an unitemized ambiguous special-ink bill must be resolved by its source procedure before a discount is claimed. Level-up free additions remain free. Matrix preparation, reconstructing unknown text from memory, formula research and copying an ordinary craft formula are not spell/scroll copying. A usable scroll can be duplicated only under a separately authorized scroll-production procedure; the feat supplies no procedure or item effect.

originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At the adopted normal travel pace, you may use passive Perception to notice a trap's actually detectable clue. NEW: compare 10 plus the relevant Wisdom (Perception) modifier, with applicable PB once, to the trap's stated detection DC; meeting it notices the clue. There is no natural d20 or generic passive ±5 from advantage/disadvantage. A source explicitly requiring an active search or a different sense still controls; concealment, line, range and sensory access remain. Detecting a clue does not reveal every component or disarm the device. Add +2 to a saving throw against a trap you can actually see at the save event, including a visible operative component sufficient to recognize the incoming trap effect. A remembered location behind total visual obstruction is not sight. An ordinary creature attack or unrelated hazard is not a trap solely because it surprises you. If a source explicitly classifies a magical installation as a trap, retain that classification and its save rules.

Compare reviewed Chef/Cooking/Herbalism/finite harvest without inventing extra biomass or treating legacy+10% as a second benefit.

sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Resolve Nature4+ and define what the source's two bonus effects are, to which real forage output they attach, activation/duration/frequency/recipients and consumable cost. originalSourceObject.name: Wilderness Chef
originalSourceObject.description: Nature 4+ and Wisdom 13+ support the listed forage bonus effects.
originalSourceObject.effect: Forage creates +2 bonus effects.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: The current source names two bonus effects without defining either. NEW complete proposal for discussion: once per completed long rest, after you personally finish a legal successful forage task yielding actual edible material, designate at most your current PB ordinary portions from that finite yield. Spend 30 active minutes with an actual cooking kit, safe heat and water if the food needs them to prepare those portions. No extra food, ingredients or Supply are created; record the original forage batch and its real quantities. Each designated portion has exactly two proposed riders: (1) Trail-ready preparation pauses its ordinary unprotected spoilage clock for the next six elapsed hours while kept clean in an appropriate container, after which its prior age resumes; breach or contamination ends this protection and other preservation does not add the intervals. (2) The eater may add +1 to one actual Constitution save against ordinary foodborne illness or food poisoning within one elapsed hour after fully consuming the portion, declaring before that roll. This does not work against magical poison, weapon poison, existing illness or non-food hazards. Record one recipient entitlement per completed long rest across all Wilderness Chefs; consuming another portion neither refreshes nor stacks it. Pay the cook's use at preparation start, even if interrupted. A poisoned or unsafe ingredient is not made edible; no other cooked recipe, Chef-serving or Feast effect is added to the same physical portion. These two riders are deliberately proposed new text, not recovered source or an interpretation of the legacy +10%.

sourceObject.name: Anatomy Lore
sourceObject.description: You have studied the weak joints, organs, and pressure points of giants, ogres, and other colossal foes common to Aethel's wilds. Prestige lineage: Giant Killer. completed from the existing development record.)

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: As a Bonus Action, mark one actually visible Large-or-larger creature with a perceivable physical weak point and legal line of effect. NEW: maximum range 60 feet; keep at most one such mark, replacing the old one without refund. At marking choose damage mode, or advantage mode if the target is Huge or larger. The mark lasts until the end of your next original regular turn, using the current virtual-marker rules if initiative changes. It is consumed by your next actual attack roll against that target, hit or miss; attacks against others neither consume it nor receive its benefit. Damage mode adds half, rounded down, of that attack's own rolled weapon/natural/unarmed damage dice plus its ordinary ability modifier after its actual critical-dice adjustment, minimum zero. Do not include spell damage, separate riders, copied damage, added Smite/sneak dice or another percentage enhancement in this proposal's base. Add this extra amount as the attack's native damage type before target defenses, once. Advantage mode gives advantage to that next attack; ordinary cancellation still applies. Once per completed short rest, after an actual hit from advantage mode against a Huge-or-larger marked target, you may spend the use to force a Strength save against DC 8 + PB + INT modifier. On failure halve that target's current applicable movement Speeds until the end of your next original regular turn; do not stack same-family halves. NEW: the rider can qualify when the feat's advantage was canceled, because the selected paid mode still applied. The creature must possess relevant anatomy; no taxonomy or immunity is rewritten. The same attack cannot claim this proposed percentage enhancement and another percentage enhancement on the same base: select one, retaining other independently legal flat/dice riders.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain advantage on actual Animal Handling and Survival checks involving beasts; this alone gives no new permitted check or beast language. NEW combat-read procedure: spend an Action observing one visible actual beast within 60 feet with legal line of effect; make Wisdom (Survival) against DC 10 + its recorded CR, rounding the final DC upward. Do not infer a missing CR. On success learn its actual diet, temperament and observed combat habits to the extent those are knowable from the evidence. Choose participating allies within 30 feet who can perceive and understand your briefing; those allies gain +2 to attack rolls against that one creature for one elapsed minute. You may be included as an ally. Keep at most one active briefing per feat owner; a new successful briefing replaces the old. Same-feat briefings on the same attacker/target do not stack. The separate beast call takes one Action and spends the short-rest use at the attempt: call an actually present nonhostile beast within 300 feet, CR 1 or lower, through a signal it can perceive, and make Wisdom (Survival) DC 15. On success it approaches by its actual movement and a possible route, then attempts one physically safe simple task you describe: tracking, carrying within capacity, or a non-damaging distraction. NEW: its task lasts at most one minute from arrival, with an overall ten-minute deadline from the call; interruption, incapacity or an impossible route can prevent completion. The Director retains its actual agency and behavior; it does not obey suicidal orders or become permanently friendly. No eligible beast means no created beast, no roll and no spent use. This does not establish a summoned body, new stat block, extra offensive budget or player-owned combat companion. Any later command/control must follow an actual separately owned source.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Knowledge Action/range/DC, briefing recipients/cap, call Action/payment/sensory bridge, safe simple tasks and finite arrival/task deadlines. CR-based numbers and offensive boundary require GPT/bestiary/class review.

A real nonhostile CR 1/4 beast 200 feet away may approach after a successful DC 15 call using its actual route. A sealed wall with no route prevents arrival; the successful call is not teleportation and its spent use is not refunded.

records.originalQuestion: Source says exact value and properties of any item on Investigation success. Distinguish mundane appraisal from Identify and formula discovery; no automatic private-lore exposure, artifact classification or guaranteed sale.

sourceDirection.name: Appraise
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Source says exact value and properties of any item on Investigation success. originalSourceObject.name: Appraise
originalSourceObject.description: You can accurately determine the value of items.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can determine the exact value and properties of any item with a successful Investigation check.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Spend ten active minutes closely inspecting one actual item with adequate sensory access and tools appropriate to safely examine it. NEW: make Intelligence (Investigation), DC10 for a plainly identifiable mundane object,15 for complex mundane construction,20 for an ordinary magical item, or25 for a unique unfamiliar construction; a specific item's explicit identification DC or concealment exception controls instead. Set the classification and actual information before rolling. On Success or Critical Success, learn its exact current reference value and complete discoverable operative properties, including magical properties and a curse unless that curse's specific source prevents this identification. Reference value means the recorded undamaged catalog price adjusted by the governing condition/valuation rule, or a Director-established local fair-market valuation when no catalog price exists, fixed before the roll. It is not a guaranteed purchase or sale offer. The property result states uses, limits, charges, activation and known operational risks from the actual item's complete record; it does not invent a missing profile, formula, historical truth or cosmology. A source explicitly resisting identification may withhold its protected part while other properties are identified. Safe appraisal is not activation or disarming; actual independent touch/proximity triggers remain. Failure spends time and yields no exact appraisal; another attempt needs changed evidence, access or method. This deliberately preserves a powerful item-identification benefit and requires direct comparison with Identify before adoption.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Time, DC tiers, value definition, magic/curse scope and explicit identification exceptions. Restricting any source's 'any item' promise requires the stated joint decision.
submittedWorkedCases: A known item with reference value40gp can be appraised at40gp while a real buyer offers only20gp. The feat identifies the reference value; it does not compel that buyer to pay40gp.

An ordinary magical wand's complete operative profile can be learned on the proposed DC20 success. An explicitly identification-proof curse remains protected by its own source; its lore is not invented.

records.originalQuestion: Complete tools/materials, work time and information fidelity for accurate maps; never-get-lost must specify known routes, missing information, illusions, teleportation and changed terrain. originalSourceObject.name: Cartographer
originalSourceObject.description: You excel at navigation and mapmaking.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can create accurate maps and never get lost. You have advantage on Survival checks for navigation.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Create an accurate record of a route or place you actually observe, using real recording materials. NEW: record one minute of active map work for each distinct junction or approximately100feet of visible route, whichever requires more work; a scale overview from a clear vantage can be recorded in ten minutes. Ordinary mapping is separate work unless another feature, such as Dungeon Cartographer, permits concurrent normal-pace mapping. 'Never get lost' means you retain a reliable account of your own traversed path and current position relative to its still-valid recorded landmarks: you cannot accidentally choose a wrong already-known branch solely through a navigation failure. It does not reveal an unvisited area, locate an unknown destination, connect an unobserved teleportation gap or preserve a physically destroyed route. A changed or illusory landmark may require investigation; the feat preserves what was actually perceived rather than certifying it true. Gain advantage on actual Survival navigation checks, including where incomplete new information still makes the route uncertain. Others using your map receive its actual information, not your personal never-lost guarantee or advantage unless another feature grants it.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When an actual Intimidation task would use Strength, you may use Charisma instead; choose before rolling. NEW: compare true character levels, not CR, Hit Dice, faction standing, rank or apparent seniority. A creature with only CR and no character level is not qualified through a fabricated conversion; its Director can supply an actual level only if its real profile legitimately includes one. Check eligibility at the roll, without granting the speaker metagame disclosure of the hidden value. Equal or higher level gives no advantage from this clause. All actual social possibilities, agency and costs remain.

originalSourceObject.name: Courtly Manners

originalSourceObject.effect: You have advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with nobles and can gain audience with important figures more easily.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain advantage on actual Charisma ability checks when directly interacting with someone who genuinely holds a noble social position recognized by the current community. Preserve the source's breadth: it is not restricted to etiquette checks or friendly nobles. A Charisma attack or saving throw is not an ability check. Success secures that opportunity on those terms, not immediate entry, a title, waived security or agreement to the later request. A repeated identical petition to the same gatekeeper yields no new roll without a changed circumstance. Required identity, dress and communication remain actual resources.

sourceObject.name: Deceiver
sourceObject.description: You are a master of deception.
sourceObject.effect: You gain proficiency in Deception and can lie convincingly even under magical compulsion.

records.originalQuestion: Preserve Deception proficiency and lying under magical compulsion. Identify exact effects that prohibit lies versus compel actions or reveal thoughts, declare any exception precisely, and retain saving throws/conditions. No automatic lie success, blanket magic immunity or retrospective erasure of witnessed facts.

sourceDirection.name: Deceiver
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Preserve Deception proficiency and lying under magical compulsion. Identify exact effects that prohibit lies versus compel actions or reveal thoughts, declare any exception precisely, and retain saving throws/conditions. No automatic lie success, blanket magic immunity or retrospective erasure of witnessed facts.

originalSourceObject.name: Deceiver
originalSourceObject.description: You are a master of deception.
originalSourceObject.effect: You gain proficiency in Deception and can lie convincingly even under magical compulsion.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain Deception proficiency. NEW explicit source exception: you can deliberately speak a false assertion even while a magical effect would otherwise prohibit that assertion solely because it is a lie or require that assertion to be truthful. This is a narrow exception to truth-compulsion, including the lie-prohibition part of Zone of Truth, and must be approved against those exact spell records. You still make any actual save and remain subject to the effect's other clauses. It grants no automatic convincing success: resolve a real Deception check, opposed defense or other social procedure where required. It does not falsify memories, thoughts, directly revealed facts or independently recorded events; confer no blanket immunity to charm, compelled actions or orders; and does not let you avoid an order to speak or move when that obligation is separate from truthfulness. If another effect punishes actual lies, this feat permits the lie but does not negate its punishment. The caster receives only the information their source actually grants; the feat adds neither an automatic warning nor an undetectability guarantee.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Precise truth-compulsion exception and preservation of all independent magical effects; fixed duplicate proficiency. Consequential Zone of Truth comparison required.

A spell that directly reveals an actual memory is not changed by the holder speaking falsely. A separate penalty triggered by telling a lie still resolves.

records.originalQuestion: Preserve Performance proficiency; complete a finite performance work/income and information-gathering procedure with time, audience, venue, lawful opportunity, costs and failure. sourceDirection.name: Entertainer

originalSourceObject.name: Entertainer
originalSourceObject.description: You can captivate audiences.
originalSourceObject.effect: You gain proficiency in Performance and can earn money and gather information through performances.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain Performance proficiency. NEW finite work procedure: arrange a real two-hour performance booking with an accessible venue, an actual audience and a willing payer, using the necessary real instrument, props or voice. The default mundane fee for this proposed booking is2sp, quoted and agreed before work; an actual negotiated contract may specify another amount or a performance standard. Complete the two active hours to earn the contractual payment from that payer, minus any actual venue costs. If the contract makes pay contingent on a check, state that DC and failure payment before accepting. During one fifteen-minute audience interaction within that booking, make Charisma (Performance) DC12 to engage attendees; on success one willing attendee offers an actual relevant local event, contact or rumor from their knowledge. Label hearsay and uncertainty; no attendee with relevant information means no invented rumor. The booking can coexist with that expressly allowed conversation, not another work action or rest. Repeating for the same unchanged audience gives no new information roll; a new booking needs real demand and payment. Record spent time, patron and money so no repeated-roll income is created.

sourceObject.name: Forager
sourceObject.description: You can find food and water in the wild.
sourceObject.effect: You can find enough food and water for yourself and up to 6 other people each day in any terrain except deserts or arctic regions.

records.originalQuestion: Preserve self plus up to six others per day and desert/arctic exceptions. Define time, checks, actual availability, creature-size portions, edible food versus potable water, conservation/transport and group overlap. Do not conjure food in a stripped/sealed area or automatically grant abstract Supply unrelated to actual resources.

sourceDirection.name: Forager
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Preserve self plus up to six others per day and desert/arctic exceptions. Define time, checks, actual availability, creature-size portions, edible food versus potable water, conservation/transport and group overlap. originalSourceObject.name: Forager
originalSourceObject.description: You can find food and water in the wild.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can find enough food and water for yourself and up to 6 other people each day in any terrain except deserts or arctic regions.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW finite interpretation of the source guarantee: in an accessible non-desert, non-arctic area that actually contains enough recoverable edible food and potable water, spend one active eight-hour forage Watch to gather the normal daily food and water requirement for yourself and up to six other ordinary Small/Medium people. This feat guarantees that result from qualifying available resources without a separate yield roll; it does not guarantee access through a hazard, remove contamination or defeat a resource-specific harvesting gate. Identify a real foraging area and deplete its recorded stocks. The actual expedition procedure supplies food/water units, body-size requirements, carry weight and Supply conversion; this feat creates no extra abstract Supply. Larger or unusual consumers use their actual greater requirement from the same finite quantity, not seven unlimited creature-day portions. Record one feat forage output per holder per24 elapsed hours, shared across all locations, with the window beginning on completion; a second feat owner can work separately only against remaining real stock and their actual time. Deserts and arctic regions use ordinary foraging. A stripped, sealed or foodless place cannot satisfy the prerequisite, and no water appears because food exists. Preserve, transport and consume the actual output normally.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Eight-hour guaranteed-yield procedure, qualified stock/access boundary, 24-hour output cadence and standard-person quantity. Literal seven-person promise preserved where its actual resources exist; other cases explicitly require conference.
submittedWorkedCases: An adequately stocked temperate area can provide seven standard person-days of both food and water after the holder's real Watch. The carried water still needs sufficient containers and capacity.
A previously depleted chamber cannot yield another seven person-days. Food present without a potable water source cannot silently fulfill the missing water half.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep the source guarantee only against real finite stock and author exact EX58 food/water ceilings, not abstract Supply or free transport.

sourceObject.description: You excel at gathering information.
sourceObject.effect: You can gather information about local events, people, and rumors twice as fast as normal.

records.originalQuestion: Define the actual baseline time for obtaining local information and how half-time rounds, including audience/contact costs and simultaneous work. Faster gathering does not change truth, completeness, secrecy, coercion or willingness. Compare rumors/research and avoid repeated unchanged-evidence rerolls.

sourceDirection.name: Gossip
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define the actual baseline time for obtaining local information and how half-time rounds, including audience/contact costs and simultaneous work. originalSourceObject.name: Gossip
originalSourceObject.description: You excel at gathering information.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can gather information about local events, people, and rumors twice as fast as normal.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Identify an actual local information-gathering task, its contacts, topic, permitted method, normal active time and real costs before work. Spend half that actor's normal active time, rounded upward once to a whole minute. NEW: absent a more specific procedure, an ordinary round of local inquiries through accessible willing contacts takes two active hours, reduced here to one. The feat does not reduce an appointment's calendar wait, another person's work, mandatory travel, deciphering unknown language, a fixed magical duration or a research procedure that is not gathering local events, people or rumors. Use the ordinary information/social check and result without an extra numerical bonus. Faster acquisition does not make gossip true, complete, public or freely given. Keep actual bribes, admission, obligations and secrecy risks. No retry of unchanged evidence merely because the task was faster; record which contacts actually supplied which claims. Apply the final feat conference's time-reduction stacking rule rather than multiply overlapping discounts silently.

The holder learns a rumor more quickly, but a false rumor remains false and an unwilling contact does not become willing from the time reduction.

sourceDirection.name: Improved Athlete

originalSourceObject.name: Improved Athlete
originalSourceObject.description: Your athletic abilities are exceptional.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Requires the actual Athlete feat, ID athlete. Gain climbing and swimming Speeds equal to current legal walking Speed; alternate sources granting those same modes do not add together. Use actual anatomy, support, water conditions, breathing and the spent-cost ledger; neither movement mode permits an impossible surface or cancels hazards. NEW reading of the source's unrestricted long-jump clause: a standing long jump can span up to the current Strength score in feet; a running long jump uses that same base and retains Athlete's separate increase equal to the nonnegative current Strength modifier. For this proposal, a running approach means at least10feet of actual immediately preceding movement on supporting ground. Both the approach and airborne distance spend movement normally. The feat changes horizontal distance, not vertical clearance, a high jump, flight or safe landing. A legal check can still be needed for a hazardous takeoff or landing, and no success creates additional distance. These proposed standing/running distinctions and the10-foot approach need comparison with the complete movement source review before adoption.

originalSourceObject.description: You are an exceptional climber.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Requires the actual Climber feat, ID climber. NEW: ceiling and overhang climbing is possible with actual usable grips, anchors or equipment sufficient for the current body's support; the feat removes the angle-only bar but supplies no adhesion to a featureless unsupported surface. Pay the ordinary climbing movement budget and make any real required check, including Climber's advantage when applicable. If that climb check fails by a final numerical deficit of1–4, you avoid the fall caused by that failed check. Remain at the last legally supported position, spend the movement/action/time already committed, and gain no progress through the failed segment. A natural-1 degree downgrade with deficit below5 still receives this narrow fall protection. A failed result with total meeting the DC due solely to a natural downgrade also avoids that check's fall under this NEW clarification. Deficit5+ receives no protection. The feat does not stop an unrelated shove, lost anchor, collapsing support, already ongoing fall or deliberate release. A retry needs a legally available new attempt under the climb task, without refunded movement.

submittedWorkedCases: DC18, total14 fails by4: remain at the last supported place without gaining the failed traverse, and keep the spent movement cost. Total13 fails by5 and may fall normally.

records.name: Keen Mind

sourceObject.name: Keen Mind
sourceObject.description: You have a mind that can track time, direction, and detail.
sourceObject.effect: You always know which way is north, the number of hours left before sunrise or sunset, and can recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.

records.originalQuestion: Define remembered observations versus previously hidden information, one-month elapsed-clock scope and precision, true north where meaningful, and sunrise/sunset information where none occurs. Preserve uncertainty rather than invent astronomy, planes or omniscience. Jewelcrafting06:00 recovery is not proof of actual sunrise; cosmology remains deferred.

sourceDirection.name: Keen Mind
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define remembered observations versus previously hidden information, one-month elapsed-clock scope and precision, true north where meaningful, and sunrise/sunset information where none occurs. Preserve uncertainty rather than invent astronomy, planes or omniscience. Jewelcrafting06:00 recovery is not proof of actual sunrise; cosmology remains deferred.

originalSourceObject.name: Keen Mind
originalSourceObject.description: You have a mind that can track time, direction, and detail.
originalSourceObject.effect: You always know which way is north, the number of hours left before sunrise or sunset, and can recall anything you have seen or heard within the past month.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Always know the direction designated as true north in the current region's established physical/map frame and the remaining elapsed hours to its actual next sunrise or sunset when that event exists. This requires no artificial navigation roll, but does not reveal passages, destinations or a safe route. NEW boundary: where no such direction/event is defined by actual setting evidence, record 'not defined here' or 'no scheduled event' rather than inventing a cosmological answer; confer on any real exception later. Accurately recall anything you actually perceived by sight or hearing within the past month, including sounds or marks you did not understand, without thereby translating them or learning concealed details. NEW: for this feat's memory window only, month means30elapsed24-hour days; this does not define the world's calendar. Recollection can reproduce the perceived sequence, but limited attention, obstructed senses and a deceptive illusion limit what was perceived. Explicit memory alteration follows its own effect. Numerical dawn-like recharge receipts are not evidence of sunrise. No soul, plane, alignment or celestial explanation is authored here.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Defined-frame/no-event boundary;30-day memory window and perception-versus-truth distinction. No new astronomical canon.
submittedWorkedCases: A rune seen clearly ten days ago can be recalled in its observed form, but an unread language remains untranslated. A hidden reverse side was never seen.
A place with no actual sunrise schedule receives no invented time-to-sunrise. An item that recharges at06:00 does not establish a sunrise at06:00.

records.name: Leadership

sourceObject.name: Leadership
sourceObject.description: You inspire others to follow you.
sourceObject.effect: You can recruit followers and hirelings more easily, and they are more loyal to you.

records.originalQuestion: Complete a finite recruitment and loyalty benefit with actual willingness, pay, number/type/level of followers, time and obligations. Separate hirelings from bonded combat companions and summoned units; no free statblock, extra turn, forced loyalty or bypass of command/structural caps. Compare Natural Leader and Commanding Presence.

sourceDirection.name: Leadership
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Complete a finite recruitment and loyalty benefit with actual willingness, pay, number/type/level of followers, time and obligations. Separate hirelings from bonded combat companions and summoned units; no free statblock, extra turn, forced loyalty or bypass of command/structural caps. Compare Natural Leader and Commanding Presence.

originalSourceObject.name: Leadership
originalSourceObject.description: You inspire others to follow you.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can recruit followers and hirelings more easily, and they are more loyal to you.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW finite recruitment/loyalty procedure: during a real recruitment effort, designate up to current PB actual willing prospective followers or hirelings. Spend one active hour interviewing and briefing them, agree on their actual jobs, pay, duration, risk, equipment and departure terms, and gain+2 on any legitimate Persuasion checks to secure those agreements. An automatic willing agreement needs no roll. The feat creates no candidate, free wage, stat block, level, binding, summoned unit or extra class companion. Keep at most PB current designated contracts receiving the feat's loyalty benefit; designate at agreement or at a new hour-long briefing, never retroactively during a morale event. While the employer honors the terms and the work remains within the agreed risk, a designated follower gains+2 on an actual loyalty/morale check whose purpose is deciding whether to abandon that agreement under pressure. This is not a bonus against every fear spell or a compulsion to stay; no roll is invented where the person's real decision is certain. Broken terms, unpaid wages or an unagreed suicidal demand remove this benefit until genuinely repaired and re-briefed. Actual transport, expedition caps, combat turns and command budgets continue to govern each recruited person. Dismissal ends designation without transferring any creature's property or earned wages.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: PB designated-contract cap, one-hour briefing, +2 recruitment and scoped+2 loyalty checks; contract/agency bounds. Requires final hireling procedure.
submittedWorkedCases: PB3 can designate three real hired people, each still requiring a valid contract and actual pay. The feat does not authorize a thirteenth expedition character against the owner's12-character cap.
A follower ordered into danger expressly excluded from their contract does not receive a loyalty check that forces compliance. The employer must negotiate a real change or accept refusal.

originalSourceObject.name: Negotiator
originalSourceObject.description: You excel at making deals.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can negotiate better prices for goods and services, and you have advantage on Persuasion checks during negotiations.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain advantage on actual Persuasion checks during negotiations for real goods or services. NEW: before the check, establish the seller/buyer's available stock, normal quote, attainable concession, payment and conditions. A successful check secures that announced better quote or term; no universal percentage discount or guaranteed buyer is created. A concession can be a lower price, improved payment schedule, delivery, included fitting or a better actual sale offer, with its exact value set before rolling. The counterpart must have authority and willingness to consider it. Failed unchanged negotiations cannot be repeated by restating the same bargain or swapping speakers without a materially changed offer or evidence. Distinct standing, sponsor and service benefits use their own actual clauses; advantage does not stack. Different purchase and resale quotes remain separate, and this feat never establishes a same-price repurchase promise or circular money source. Record the final agreement and any taxes/fees through the actual settlement procedure.

Buying for45gp does not force any buyer to repurchase for50gp. A later actual resale uses that buyer's own stock, demand and quote.

originalSourceObject.effect: Increase Intelligence or Wisdom by 1, +5 bonus to passive Perception and passive Investigation

records.name: Pathfinder

sourceObject.name: Pathfinder
sourceObject.description: You can navigate any terrain.
sourceObject.effect: You and your party can move at normal speed while tracking, and difficult terrain doesn't slow your group's travel.

records.originalQuestion: Define one actual traveling party, tracking pace and what difficult terrain travel ignores, including mounts/vehicles, separation, route access and adverse hazards. Distinguish strategic travel time from tactical Speed/movement costs, climbing/swimming, forced march and impassable surfaces. Compare Wilderness Walker and Master Tracker.

sourceDirection.name: Pathfinder
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define one actual traveling party, tracking pace and what difficult terrain travel ignores, including mounts/vehicles, separation, route access and adverse hazards. Distinguish strategic travel time from tactical Speed/movement costs, climbing/swimming, forced march and impassable surfaces. Compare Wilderness Walker and Master Tracker.

originalSourceObject.name: Pathfinder
originalSourceObject.description: You can navigate any terrain.
originalSourceObject.effect: You and your party can move at normal speed while tracking, and difficult terrain doesn't slow your group's travel.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: While you actively lead one physically coordinated traveling party, the party may track at its actual normal travel pace and ignore ordinary difficult terrain's reduction of strategic travel rate. NEW: party members must remain on the led route and able to follow your current directions directly or through their actual communications chain; separated scouts and a different caravan receive no remote benefit. Use the normal rate of the actual slowest participating body/vehicle, with actual capacity, access and work/rest limits. A mount or wagon can benefit only on a route it can physically traverse; the feat supplies neither a road through an impassable gap nor a swim/fly/climb mode. Severe weather, visibility, moving currents, climbing tasks, hazards, loading and other independent delays still apply. This changes the difficult-terrain travel-rate factor and tracking activity, not tactical difficult-terrain movement costs, combat Speed, forced-march rules or resource consumption. If leadership/coordination ends, subsequent travel uses ordinary rates; already elapsed time is not recalculated.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: One coordinated party, strategic-only terrain-rate scope, actual slowest traveler and vehicle legality. Full travel numbers come from the live expedition verdict.
submittedWorkedCases: A coordinated party with a slower laden wagon uses that wagon's actual normal route rate while ignoring the ordinary rough-ground slowdown. The feat cannot make the wagon cross a path narrower than its body.
A scout who leaves the coordinated route loses the group benefit for their separate travel. During combat, ordinary difficult-terrain costs still apply.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt coordinated party strategic terrain/tracking exception with genuine instructions, slowest body/profile, actual route and no tactical or mount-mode creation.

records.name: Ranger Training

sourceObject.name: Ranger Training
sourceObject.description: You have learned wilderness survival techniques.
sourceObject.effect: You gain proficiency in Survival and Nature, and you can hide even when only lightly obscured by natural phenomena.

records.originalQuestion: Preserve Survival/Nature proficiency and legal Hide while only lightly obscured by natural phenomena. Define actual natural obscurity, sight lines and observed hiding limitations; no invisible state or automatic success. The feat name grants no Ranger class level, spell list, companion or expertise when already proficient.

sourceDirection.name: Ranger Training
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Preserve Survival/Nature proficiency and legal Hide while only lightly obscured by natural phenomena. Define actual natural obscurity, sight lines and observed hiding limitations; no invisible state or automatic success. The feat name grants no Ranger class level, spell list, companion or expertise when already proficient.

originalSourceObject.name: Ranger Training
originalSourceObject.description: You have learned wilderness survival techniques.
originalSourceObject.effect: You gain proficiency in Survival and Nature, and you can hide even when only lightly obscured by natural phenomena.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain proficiency in Survival and Nature. Existing proficiency gives no Expertise under the proposed fixed-grant rule. You may attempt to Hide while only lightly obscured by actual natural phenomena, such as naturally occurring foliage, rainfall, falling snow, fog or blowing dust that genuinely interferes with the observer's view. NEW: this is an express eligibility exception to the ordinary clear-sight bar only while that qualifying partial obscurity exists; it permits a real Hide attempt against each affected observer, not automatic Hidden. Use normal Stealth, observer-specific passive DC, sound, other senses and revealing-event rules. A fully clear view or an observer unaffected by that natural obscurity gains no new bar to seeing you. Ordinary darkness and magical concealment use their own source permissions; merely naming a magical effect 'natural' does not qualify it here. The feat grants no Ranger class level, spells, companion, tracking expertise or movement benefit.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Observed natural obscurity examples; precise Hide eligibility exception; independent observer/sense rules.
submittedWorkedCases: Actual rain lightly obscures a character from one observer, permitting a Hide attempt. The character still rolls Stealth and can fail to become Hidden from that observer.
A creature using an unaffected sense or a clear angle does not lose the character's position solely because another observer's view is obscured.

records.name: Scavenger

sourceObject.name: Scavenger
sourceObject.description: You can find useful items in unlikely places.
sourceObject.effect: You can find basic equipment and supplies in ruins, dungeons, and other locations where others have been.

records.originalQuestion: Complete finite time, check, location availability and legal item table/value/quantity caps for basic equipment and supplies. Establish preexisting recoverable objects, ownership, condition and repeat-search depletion. No item creation, automatic harvest ingredient identity, magic loot or direct sale-value-to-Supply conversion.

sourceDirection.name: Scavenger
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Complete finite time, check, location availability and legal item table/value/quantity caps for basic equipment and supplies. Establish preexisting recoverable objects, ownership, condition and repeat-search depletion. No item creation, automatic harvest ingredient identity, magic loot or direct sale-value-to-Supply conversion.

originalSourceObject.name: Scavenger
originalSourceObject.description: You can find useful items in unlikely places.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can find basic equipment and supplies in ruins, dungeons, and other locations where others have been.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW finite search procedure: choose an accessible previously occupied site and spend thirty active minutes searching one bounded area, such as a room, wreck compartment or campsite. Before the roll the Director records the actual recoverable mundane equipment/supplies, their condition, ownership and access barriers. Make Intelligence (Investigation), DC12 for ordinary scattered remains,15 for concealed useful pieces or20 for heavily obscured remains; a specific site DC takes precedence. On success identify up to1d4 actual item lots from that finite inventory, with a combined reference value at most10gp and combined cargo at most1Load. The die cannot create missing lots: take no more than actually exist and are within those limits. The player chooses which identified lots to retrieve, paying any separate safe-access/removal time; uncollected objects remain in place. These are ordinary catalog-compatible items or usable supplies, not magic loot, a free recipe ingredient classification or converted gp-to-Supply. A larger valuable object can be noticed by the normal search result but is not granted as an extra feat output. Mark searched evidence and removed quantities; another unchanged search of the same area gives no fresh roll or generated inventory. Genuine new access, deposited material or a different bounded area can justify a new attempt.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Thirty-minute task, DC tiers, finite1d4/10gp/1Load discovery cap and site depletion. These numerical bounds need explicit source agreement.
submittedWorkedCases: The die gives4 but the site holds only two eligible real lots worth7gp and0.5Load: only those two can be recovered. No third or fourth lot appears.
A found locked chest still requires opening and ownership consequences. Repeating the scavenging roll cannot turn its unknown contents into free mundane supplies.

records.name: Survivalist

sourceObject.name: Survivalist
sourceObject.description: You excel at surviving in harsh conditions.
sourceObject.effect: You can survive in any environment and can help others do the same. You need only half the normal amount of food and water.

records.originalQuestion: Resolve absolute survive-any-environment wording into explicit hazards and aid limits, without implying vacuum, lava, suffocation or universal immunity absent a rule. Preserve half food/water with exact units, size, rounding, schedules and stacking with Endurance/foraging. Do not grant rest benefits or erase existing deprivation.

sourceDirection.name: Survivalist
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Resolve absolute survive-any-environment wording into explicit hazards and aid limits, without implying vacuum, lava, suffocation or universal immunity absent a rule. Preserve half food/water with exact units, size, rounding, schedules and stacking with Endurance/foraging. Do not grant rest benefits or erase existing deprivation.

originalSourceObject.name: Survivalist
originalSourceObject.description: You excel at surviving in harsh conditions.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can survive in any environment and can help others do the same. You need only half the normal amount of food and water.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Consume half your actual normal food requirement and half your actual normal potable-water requirement under the governing body/environment schedule. Keep the two quantities separate and exact; purchase indivisible containers or portions as needed but retain unused contents rather than rounding each consumption upward. NEW: choose the strongest applicable fractional requirement reduction instead of multiplying overlapping reductions. This does not erase existing deprivation or replace required breathing, shelter, equipment or rest. To complete the source's broad survival/help clause, NEW proposal: you have advantage on actual Survival checks to adapt a camp, clothing, route or shelter to an ordinary nonmagical environment and on Constitution saves caused solely by ordinary heat/cold exposure. During one active hour preparing a camp or travel plan, you can designate up to PB actual companions participating in that preparation; while they follow the plan and keep its required gear, they share the heat/cold-save advantage for the next eight elapsed hours. This does not confer food/water reduction on them, make unsafe material edible, or permit survival in lava, vacuum, drowning, magical extremes or an environment with no physically possible protective method. Actual hazard frequency, severity, DC and finite protection still apply. These explicit environmental limits are proposed replacements for the source's undefined absolute phrase, not a claim that it already said them.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Exact half quantities; strongest requirement reduction; new Survival/heat-cold advantage and PB companion preparation; explicit scope of 'any environment'.
submittedWorkedCases: A body needing2food units and4water units for the period consumes1food and2water with this feat; a separate half-requirement effect does not silently make either requirement one quarter.
PB3 permits three actual prepared companions to share the proposed heat/cold advantage for eight hours. They still need their normal water, and none gains the ability to breathe underwater.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt the explicit bounded survival assistance and strongest requirement reduction, using canonical2lb/8pint standard rather than an unexplained unit example.

The daily assessment, Rest Debt and unsupported-day recovery rules are unchanged. Include actual requirements by participant/time; do not halve companion or mount needs merely because they travel with you.

records.originalQuestion: Complete tracking across water/air using actual evidence, senses, time, DC, range and loss/reacquisition; distinguish finding no trail from automatic supernatural detection.
