sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: The source expressly allows tracking over water and air. NEW proposed completion preserves a real exceptional benefit: from an actual known starting trail or witnessed passage, you can perceive faint physical-passage impressions of that same creature's continuous route within60feet of your position for up to24elapsed hours after passage, including its waterborne or airborne segments. This is a feat-local extraordinary trail sense, not free knowledge of every nearby creature. Spend one active minute examining a segment and make Wisdom (Survival) DC15, increased by5 when the trail is more than12hours old and by5 where multiple actual trails are heavily intermingled; an exact concealing source may expressly block or modify this sensing. On success follow the actual local direction and learn the passage's approximate age, creature size and evident physical condition such as limping or bleeding. No exact current HP, identity, destination, invisible present location, future path or unobserved intent is revealed. You still need a physically possible way to traverse the route, time at your legal tracking pace and a new real examination when a junction or lost segment creates uncertainty. Teleportation supplies no traversed intervening path; track ends at departure and resumes only after separately finding the arrival trail. No new plane/soul/cosmological mechanism is inferred. Failed unchanged examination cannot be rerolled without changed access, evidence or method. This exceptional-sense choice needs explicit GPT review against mundane tracking and divination.

originalSourceObject.name: Wilderness Walker
originalSourceObject.description: Survival 4+ supports the listed freedom from terrain movement penalties.
originalSourceObject.effect: No movement penalty in terrain.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Use the shared Skill-feat proposal's explicit acquisition bridge for Survival4+: actual Survival proficiency and permanent ordinary skill modifier at least+4, excluding temporary/situational bonuses. NEW broad completion of 'no movement penalty in terrain': when your own body moves through an actually traversable route, ignore extra movement-cost factors and Speed reductions whose sole stated cause is the terrain itself, including ordinary difficult/severe ground and magical terrain that only imposes those movement penalties. Crawling, squeezing, load, injury, creature conditions, lack of a movement mode, occupied-space restrictions, forced movement and an actual obstruction remain separate causes and still apply. A terrain hazard's attack, save, damage, falling risk or inflicted Grappled/Restrained condition is not itself waived; if its separate condition reduces Speed, that condition remains. In strategic travel remove only your own terrain-derived rate penalty, not every party member's; the group still uses its actual slowest participant. A mount, vehicle or carried companion does not inherit your feat. Mode switching retains spent movement costs and never refunds earlier expenditure. This deliberately proposes broad terrain-cost protection, including qualifying magical terrain, and needs exact spell/hazard comparisons rather than silently narrowing the source to woodland alone.

records.originalQuestion: Source permits choosing light, medium or heavy with no prerequisite. Decide whether that remains a direct tier choice and whether this feat is repeatable for other tiers. Distinguish armor from shields, actual training from item ownership, and chosen-tier access from automatic lower-tier or weapon grants.

originalSourceObject.name: Armor Proficiency

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Choose one actual armor proficiency tier: light, medium or heavy. Preserve the source's lack of a prerequisite: NEW explicit selection permits direct heavy-armor proficiency without first learning lighter tiers. Only the chosen tier is granted; heavy does not automatically grant light, medium, shields, weapons or tools. NEW repeatability: this feat may be acquired again through another actual feat choice for a different armor tier not already proficient; record each chosen tier under one source family with distinct acquisition events. Choosing an already proficient tier gives no benefit and is not an eligible new selection. Training does not supply armor, alter fit/anatomy, remove its Strength requirement, waive donning time or invent an AC bonus. While legally using the selected tier, remove only the nonproficiency consequences that actual proficiency removes; other properties remain.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Direct tier choice retained; repeatability for distinct missing tiers only; no implied lower-tier/shield grants.

sourceObject.description: You can enter a battle rage.

records.originalQuestion: Complete once-per-Long-Rest activation action, minute clock, voluntary ending, incapacitation and simultaneous class/feat rages. Bound physical resistance to explicit damage types and clarify +2 on melee weapon, natural, unarmed or melee spell attacks. Compare Berserker Rage and Frenzied Rage without importing unstated class features, spell bans or rage extension.

sourceDirection.name: Berserker
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Complete once-per-Long-Rest activation action, minute clock, voluntary ending, incapacitation and simultaneous class/feat rages. originalSourceObject.name: Berserker
originalSourceObject.description: You can enter a battle rage.
originalSourceObject.effect: Once per long rest, you can rage for 1 minute, gaining +2 damage on melee attacks and resistance to physical damage.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW: as a Bonus Action, spend the feat's one long-rest use to enter this feat rage for one elapsed minute. Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, whether magical or nonmagical, and add 2 damage on each actual successful melee attack you own. The melee scope includes weapon, unarmed, natural and melee spell attacks; it is not limited to weapons. Add the flat 2 once to the attack's primary damage type before target defenses; it is not doubled by a critical hit and is not a separate hit, copied damage or spellcasting trigger. NEW: the rage ends early if you voluntarily end it as a Bonus Action or become Incapacitated. It does not require attacking or taking damage to continue, prohibit spellcasting/concentration, extend through repeated attacks, or grant unstated class rage features. Another real rage may coexist under its own rules, but same-scope resistance does not stack and bonuses obey their actual families; this feat's flat rider cannot be counted twice under aliases. A completed rest restores the use, not an encounter declaration.

sourceObject.name: Durable
sourceObject.description: Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits:
sourceObject.effect: Increase Constitution by 1, when you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, minimum amount regained equals twice your Constitution modifier

records.originalQuestion: Retain +1CON and the twice-CON-modifier minimum when spending a Hit Die for HP. Decide floor0/1 for nonpositive modifiers, whether the minimum applies after the die plus CON or to the die, per-die versus combined spending, score cap and maxHP recomputation. Respect actual Hit Dice, rest eligibility, Wounds and same-healing bonuses.

sourceDirection.name: Durable
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Retain +1CON and the twice-CON-modifier minimum when spending a Hit Die for HP. originalSourceObject.name: Durable
originalSourceObject.description: Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits:
originalSourceObject.effect: Increase Constitution by 1, when you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, minimum amount regained equals twice your Constitution modifier

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Increase Constitution by 1, normally no higher than 20, and recompute the real derived modifier and maximum-HP records without healing. For each actual Hit Die legally spent and rolled to restore HP, NEW: set that die's pre-healing-modifier amount to the greatest of its ordinary die-plus-CON healing amount, twice the current signed CON modifier, and zero. Apply the minimum after the ordinary die-plus-CON calculation, separately per die, before ordinary healing bonuses, reductions, blockers and maximum/Critical caps. The resulting actual HP gain may be less than this raw minimum or zero. It creates no Hit Die, rest permission or automatic restoration of spent dice. Wounds reduce actual Hit Dice recovery under their existing rule, not this individual die's result. Do not floor the die face itself at twice CON or multiply a combined multi-die pool a second time.

records.name: Endurance

sourceObject.name: Endurance
sourceObject.description: You can push your body beyond normal limits.
sourceObject.effect: You can go twice as long without food, water, or sleep, and you have advantage on Constitution saves against exhaustion.

records.originalQuestion: Resolve twice-as-long food/water/sleep deprivation against actual schedules, quantities and cumulative penalties, not infinite sustenance. Identify exact CON saves against Exhausted and environmental Strain, and whether sleep tolerance changes any rest benefits. No unprinted healing, RP recovery or universal immunity.

sourceDirection.name: Endurance

originalSourceObject.name: Endurance
originalSourceObject.description: You can push your body beyond normal limits.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can go twice as long without food, water, or sleep, and you have advantage on Constitution saves against exhaustion.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW precise deprivation bridge: while this feat is operative, accrue only half the ordinary food-, water- and sleep-deprivation time toward each respective unmet-need deadline. Use the same elapsed world clock, preserving fractional accrued time and prior exposure; do not halve the actual daily food/water quantity. A nominal 24-hour no-water threshold therefore requires 48 actual hours of otherwise identical deprivation under the feat. Partial intake and resets follow the actual deprivation procedure. Acquisition does not erase already accrued debt or penalties, and suppression changes future accrual rather than replaying old time. Gain advantage on actual Constitution saves whose source prevents or resists gaining the Exhaustion condition. NEW: include a Constitution save against ordinary environmental expedition Strain only if the source explicitly equates that save with exhaustion; do not apply it to Dissonance, serum Strain or every similarly named track. Sleep tolerance gives no short/long-rest benefits, extra active-work Watch, free recovery or exemption from an actual hard work cap. The live expedition verdict must supply the final baseline schedules and distinct track mapping.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Half-rate future deprivation accrual, no retroactive cure, exact save predicate and preserved rest/work limits.
submittedWorkedCases: Twelve actual hours without water adds six hours to a deprivation clock that would ordinarily accrue one-for-one. It does not produce half a ration of missing water.
Remaining awake longer does not itself restore RP or grant a beneficial long rest. An unrelated Warrior serum-Strain save does not gain this feat's advantage by name alone.
sourceDirection.decision: NEW FS-12 adopts a checkpoint-based exception to canonical daily shortage/Rest Debt penalties; it replaces the hypothetical deprivation timer, not the EX58 clock or requirements.

Do not double a Watch, create food/water, lengthen an actual sleep-debt deadline, or treat work as rest.
Maintain two separate feat records, foodWaterPending and sleepPending, each initially 0 and limited to 0 or 1. At a canonical daily checkpoint where food/water shortage is the sole reason for the one expedition-Strain penalty, 0 becomes 1 and that one penalty is omitted; 1 becomes 0 and the original one penalty applies. A day actually meeting both food and water requirements clears foodWaterPending. Another unmet mandatory logistical requirement still causes its original single daily penalty; Endurance does not reduce it or add a second daily penalty. The day remains unsupported wherever its actual requirements are unmet, even when the feat omits a Strain point.
At an actual canonical sleep-debt penalty event, apply the same 0→1/omit, 1→0/apply sequence to sleepPending. Assess each original event once: the unpaid deadline event and a subsequent missed designated Rest Watch follow their own EX58 scheduling; do not create an hourly or per-Watch penalty. Debt remains owed and deadlines reset only as EX58 says. A genuinely completed safe eight-hour rest clears sleepPending and actual Rest Debt, even if it supplies no additional beneficial-long-rest resource recovery. Food/water and sleep credits never offset each other. Other Strain, Exhaustion, air, weather and hazard causes retain their original rules.
Acquisition clears neither existing Strain nor existing debt. If the feat is unavailable at a checkpoint, apply the original cause-specific penalty and clear that cause's pending credit; availability later cannot rewrite the past. Preserve all assessed and omitted events and their causes. This is an explicitly NEW interpretation of 'go twice as long': it halves the frequency of the applicable canonical penalty events, not the elapsed length of every irregular sleep-debt window. Literal older wording and the rejected generic-timer draft remain historical.

records.originalQuestion: Source requires only CHA13, not a Feykin/Elf ancestry. Do not infer creature type, lineage truth or broad charm/fear immunity.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: The printed prerequisite is Charisma 13; acquiring this feat does not require or grant an Elf/Feykin ancestry. Gain advantage on actual saving throws to prevent or end the Charmed condition. A new sleep application while protection is operative fails. Other independent damage/conditions from the same source remain. This feat grants no creature type, lineage history, charm immunity or fear immunity.

sourceObject.name: Giant Strength
sourceObject.description: You possess the strength of giants.
sourceObject.effect: Your carrying capacity doubles, and you can wield weapons one size larger than normal without penalty.

records.originalQuestion: Define doubling under the current pounds and Load reconciliation, whether it affects push/drag/lift, and stacking with actual size or other capacity effects. Complete one-size-larger weapon access using existing weapon sizes, hands and damage rules; no automatic reach, extra dice, anatomy or exemption from other restrictions.

sourceDirection.name: Giant Strength
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define doubling under the current pounds and Load reconciliation, whether it affects push/drag/lift, and stacking with actual size or other capacity effects. Complete one-size-larger weapon access using existing weapon sizes, hands and damage rules; no automatic reach, extra dice, anatomy or exemption from other restrictions.

originalSourceObject.name: Giant Strength
originalSourceObject.description: You possess the strength of giants.
originalSourceObject.effect: Your carrying capacity doubles, and you can wield weapons one size larger than normal without penalty.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: After computing the current body's ordinary physical carrying capacity and inventory Load capacity from actual Strength and size, double both capacities. NEW: the same factor also doubles the corresponding push/drag/lift limit so that the paired physical-handling limits remain coherent. It does not double an item's weight, remove carried cargo, alter casualty Load, enlarge a mount's capacity or multiply an already modified result twice. Distinct capacity effects use their actual stacking clauses; no generic repeated doubling is granted. You may wield a weapon made for a body one size category larger than your actual current body without a size-only handling penalty. Use that weapon's actual reviewed item profile, hands, reach, damage and properties; the feat itself adds no damage die, reach, proficiency, free hand or two-size permission. An oversized weapon without a complete source profile remains an item-authoring dependency rather than receiving improvised bigger statistics. Real anatomy and Strength requirements still apply.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Pounds/Load/push-drag-lift capacity binding and one-category weapon permission; no invented oversized profile.
submittedWorkedCases: A Medium STR-18 body has ordinary 270-pound carry and 18 Load; this proposal gives 540 pounds and 36 Load, with the corresponding lift/push/drag limit doubled once.
Wielding an actual Large weapon does not give a Medium holder Large reach or an extra damage die unless that weapon's complete profile expressly supplies it.

sourceObject.name: Healer
sourceObject.description: You are skilled in medicine and healing.
sourceObject.effect: You can use a healer's kit to restore hit points and stabilize dying creatures more effectively.

records.originalQuestion: The source has no HP amount, action, target cadence or kit-charge cost. Complete all of them, including stabilization versus actual healing, touch/access and zeroHP/Wound gates. Bind the actual ten-charge Healer kit and compare the already-reviewed Field Medic plus pending Field Surgeon, without double expenditure, invented charges or unbounded repeat healing.

sourceDirection.name: Healer
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: The source has no HP amount, action, target cadence or kit-charge cost. Complete all of them, including stabilization versus actual healing, touch/access and zeroHP/Wound gates. Bind the actual ten-charge Healer kit and compare the already-reviewed Field Medic plus pending Field Surgeon, without double expenditure, invented charges or unbounded repeat healing.

originalSourceObject.name: Healer
originalSourceObject.description: You are skilled in medicine and healing.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can use a healer's kit to restore hit points and stabilize dying creatures more effectively.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW full healing procedure: as an Action, spend one real healer's-kit charge to treat one adjacent legally reachable living creature. Choose ordinary stabilization only, or this feat's healing treatment. A full actual kit has ten charges, costs 5 gp and weighs 3 lb under the reviewed item rule; transfer or partial use never refills it. Healing treatment has one entitlement per recipient per that recipient's completed short or long rest, shared across all Healer practitioners. Commit that entitlement and the charge before resolution even if healing is later blocked. If the recipient is dying, first cause an actual dying-to-Stable transition using this paid kit use, then resolve ordinary healing of 2d4 plus the practitioner's signed Wisdom modifier, minimum zero before the normal healing pipeline. One charge funds both parts of this single treatment. If HP gain is blocked, the stabilization remains with its genuine recovery deadline; if positive HP returns, close that obsolete deadline normally. A recipient whose healing entitlement is spent may still receive ordinary kit stabilization for its real charge and Action, without more feat HP. Already Stable creatures can receive the once-per-rest healing but create no new stabilization trigger. This removes no Wounds, Injury, disease or death. Independently owned Field Medic/Field Surgeon triggers require their actual source/event and own limits, with no duplicated kit charge or invented second stabilization.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Action, one-charge cost, 2d4+WIS healing, recipient short-rest family cap, blocked-offer commitment and stabilization-before-healing sequence.
submittedWorkedCases: One charge treats a dying target: record stabilization, then dice 3+2 and WIS +3 give 8 ordinary healing before actual modifiers/caps. A second Healer owner cannot repeat the HP treatment before that target rests.
Under a broad HP-gain prohibition the target remains Stable at zero; the charge and healing entitlement are spent. The feat does not resurrect a dead body.

sourceObject.description: You age more slowly than normal.

records.originalQuestion: Define the half-rate aging effect as a mechanical clock only, distinguishing natural versus magical aging without granting immortality or cosmology. Define advantage specifically on death saving throws, applicable timing and no replacement of Wounds, instant death or already-dead state; CON17 and character-level10 gate remain.

sourceDirection.name: Immortal Vigor
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define the half-rate aging effect as a mechanical clock only, distinguishing natural versus magical aging without granting immortality or cosmology. Define advantage specifically on death saving throws, applicable timing and no replacement of Wounds, instant death or already-dead state; CON17 and character-level10 gate remain.

originalSourceObject.name: Immortal Vigor
originalSourceObject.description: You age more slowly than normal.
originalSourceObject.effect: You age at half the normal rate and have advantage on death saving throws.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require Constitution 17 and total character level 10. From acquisition onward, accrue natural biological aging at half the body's otherwise applicable natural rate. NEW: keep elapsed world time and accumulated age separate; the feat does not reverse existing age or halve a discrete magical aging event unless that event expressly changes the natural aging rate. Suppression restores future ordinary accrual without retroactive catch-up or rejuvenation. This is a bounded mechanical clock, not immortality, resurrection or a new lifespan/cosmology claim. Gain advantage on actual death saving throws at the existing regular-turn start. Roll the two dice and select the higher before resolving death-save natural 1/20 and counters. Ordinary advantage cancellation applies. No extra death save occurs on an extra turn, and the feat does not replace Instant Death, a fatal Wound save, an effect without a death save or an already dead state.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Future natural-aging accrual versus discrete magical events; death-save advantage integration without new saves.
submittedWorkedCases: Two elapsed years under an unchanged ordinary aging rate add one biological year, while the world calendar still advances two years.
Death-save faces 1 and 12 select 12 under advantage, giving the ordinary success. The feat does not permit a roll after actual Instant Death.

sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define an exhaustive mechanical predicate for mind effects and +2 on actual saving throws. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Add 2 once to the actual saving throw against a mental effect meeting the shared proposed finite predicate. This can apply to an INT, WIS, CHA, CON or other save if the actual effect qualifies; it is not a blanket ability-based bonus. The same source cannot add twice when one effect both causes fear and deals psychic damage. No bonus applies to an opposed skill check, death save, ordinary concentration maintenance or an effect granting no save. NEW stacking completion: this distinct feat bonus can combine with Resilient Mind's independently applicable +1 Wisdom-save rider, subject to any explicit overriding source restriction; class-technique bonuses first obey their own strongest-only family. Preserve actual natural-save rules and any printed failure margin. The feat supplies no immunity, automatic success, new save, changed belief or agency override.

A Constitution concentration save caused by psychic damage is not itself the attack's mental-effect save; Iron Will does not add +2 merely from that causal history.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require Constitution 15 and actually owned Necrotic Affinity or Dark Fortitude, using their exact feat IDs. Gain resistance to necrotic and poison damage. NEW delayed-recovery procedure: once per completed long rest, after an actual positive-to-zero damage/loss event finishes its Core Instant Death, Wound and death processing and leaves you living at zero, you may commit the use to that real dying/Stable episode. Record a recovery deadline at the start of your next original regular turn, preserving its virtual marker if initiative changes. At that deadline, before the normal death save, if you are still living at zero in that same episode, attempt direct state recovery to 1 HP. Broad HP-gain prohibition blocks the point; it does not create stability or refund the use. Earlier positive healing closes the pending episode and cancels this later recovery without reducing HP; actual death cancels it and cannot be reversed. On actual successful recovery, NEW: gain a one-elapsed-minute rider adding 2 necrotic damage once to each genuine personally owned damaging attack/spell/feature event, before target defenses. Apply it once to a shared area roll/event, with each target resolving its own defenses; a mixed-type packet does not gain it per component. Fixed damage and actual ongoing source ticks can qualify, but copied/reflected damage, another creature's actions and newly invented split packets do not. The flat +2 is not doubled by critical hits. It is this feat's damage component, not ordinary spell damage for Lifeleech, and creates no new spell, hit, payment, resource event or damage root; it cannot recursively trigger itself. Direct recovery does not remove Wounds, Prone or an independent cause of Unconsciousness. It ends on its deadline or your actual death and does not stack with itself. Missing this delayed recovery or being killed before it never becomes a later corpse wake-up.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When you personally cast a spell you are actually entitled to cast, you may use a complete functional focus legal for that casting source to replace material-component requirements whose specified reference value is strictly less than100gp. NEW: this is an explicit exception for both consumed and nonconsumed components; total repeated units of the same required component within this cast before comparing the threshold. Components without an explicit price qualify as ordinary unpriced materials; a source-specific unique named object, target/body or expressly irreplaceable component does not become an unpriced generic material. A100gp component does not qualify. Hold/manipulate or display the focus exactly as the governing source permits; S,V,casting time,RP,concentration and other requirements remain. This feat cannot replace the actual target, a creature’s remains as a target, an item being enchanted or a required personally bonded object. For a reviewed Scribing payload actually cast by you, use the same cast-level rule only if otherwise eligible; activating a noncast magic item does not invoke this feat. Crafting ingredients, sacrificial recipe bodies, research costs and stored spell creation remain real unless their own exact procedure is a qualifying cast. Record each waived component and its stated reference value; market discounts cannot push an intrinsically100gp component under the threshold.

originalSourceObject.name: Bowyer
originalSourceObject.description: You are skilled at crafting and using bows.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Keep the printed proficiency with Longbow or Shortbow acquisition gate. NEW: this feat grants the narrow trained Bowyer craft credential for the shared mundane-creation bridge: add PB once to DEX construction of Shortbow, Longbow or a20-Arrow retail bundle using actual carpenter’s tools and a suitable bench. It is not general carpenter proficiency, a new trade level or access to magical Blacksmithing formulas, whose host list excludes bows/ammunition. Masterwork means the bridge’s earned P50 durability option, not automatic grade/accuracy/damage. Separately, whenever you hit with a legal ranged attack actually made with a Shortbow or Longbow, add+1 to its ordinary weapon damage component. NEW: an explicitly profiled bow-family model also qualifies if its profile actually says bow; crossbow, sling, thrown arrow, spell or bow-butt improvised melee does not. The personal+1 works with any legally used bow, not just one you made; arrows you sell do not confer your personal bonus. Flat+1 is not doubled on a critical and does not add to separate poison or spell-rider components.

originalSourceObject.name: Burglar
originalSourceObject.description: You are skilled at breaking and entering.
originalSourceObject.effect: You gain proficiency with thieves' tools and can pick locks and disable traps more effectively.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain thieves’-tools proficiency. NEW completion of “more effectively”: add+2 to actual checks using those tools to pick an accessible mechanical lock or safely disable an identified, accessible mechanical trap. PB still applies once; tool expertise replaces PB rather than adding another PB. This benefit does not reveal traps, find secret passages, open a structure without manipulating its lock or disarm an effect that has no usable mechanical disarm interface. Use the actual lock/trap’s printed time, DC, failure and retry procedure; if none exists, NEW ordinary accessible mechanical lock default is one minute and DC15, with failure consuming time and an unchanged-state retry requiring a materially different supported approach, better tools or new evidence. Simple obvious unlocked mechanisms need no roll. Magical devices keep explicit magical disarm requirements; a genuine mechanical safety on one can be manipulated only within its actual scope. This feat grants no trap immunity or generic faster Action.

FT84 source-follow-through selection (proposed; the following explicit interaction controls only this named composition):
FT84-Q03 / FT84-CLOSED-CREATION-01 — Craftsman applies to actual authorized creation, not names or all fixed-duration work.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: personally leading an independently authorized closed feat process that makes/assembles a new usable physical body or prepared kit is eligible creation even when it is non-artisan, lacks a catalog recipe ID or prints a fixed base duration. Craftsman supplies only its half-active-time factor; it supplies no process, skill, formula, assistants, work opportunity, materials, use or output. Use the strongest genuinely applicable creation reduction once. An explicit source exclusion or distinct alteration/preparation/service category still controls. Keep actual physical minimum phases only where the source requires them; do not manufacture an advanced-recipe incorporation phase for every short feat process.
Contraption Crafter's ten minutes are the ordinary base for its real gadget construction. With actual personally leading Craftsman ownership the complete job is five uninterrupted active minutes, not ten with a final five-minute discount and not two-and-a-half from a second equivalent half. The whole adjusted job must be uninterrupted; phase logging, assistant handoff, pauses, rest or partially completed earlier attempts cannot satisfy it. Keep actual Gnome heritage, usable tinker's tools, the same five-gp suitable owned parts and the same once-per-24-elapsed-hours use committed at start. A new lawful construction still ends its old gadget at start. Interruption spends the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget, no completion roll, no refundable tail and no resumable partial product. Completion rolls the same one d4 openly, once; it grants no chosen profile, duplicate gadget, general proficiency, quality, recipe XP or parts recovery. The same one-hour gadget lifetime starts at actual completion, not at the undiscounted hypothetical finish. Transfer/deployment/activation/recharge rules are unchanged. The time benefit is prospective and cannot manufacture a mid-job feat acquisition opportunity; if a real change interrupts the required work, the ordinary failure consequence applies.
Trapsetter's independently authorized thirty-active-minute kit assembly is likewise eligible creation: fifteen active minutes with Craftsman. This includes only its actual prepared-kit assembly from the real source parts; it cannot manufacture an ordinary twenty-caltrop stock bag out of an arbitrary substitute or count buying/deploying one as new creation. Keep the one completion DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves-tools check, ordinary task degree/natural shifts collapsed to binary, actual parts, failure consumption and recoverable remaining metal/frame. No manufacturing quality/yield/XP or general recipe is added. NEW NARROW WORK-CREDIT COMPLETION for this otherwise unphased kit assembly: track actual active work in seconds against the adjusted required total; pauses do not by themselves erase already completed usable physical assembly work. A pause earns no credit, protection or rest entitlement. Preserve the actual partial body and committed stock under their ordinary custody, deterioration and loss rules; work that a genuine physical event destroys cannot remain credited. The unfinished kit has no function. Resume only the remaining actual work with the real usable/replacement parts; do not duplicate stock, credit or partial bodies. No completion roll occurs until the whole adjusted job is actually complete. Neither Contraption's uninterrupted-work/use forfeiture nor advanced manufacture's incorporation/stabilization is imported. A more-specific explicitly authorized phase/loss rule still controls.
Kit assembly does not spend or refresh Trapsetter's three source-specific quick-placement allowances, arm a trap, clear an old active slot, reset hard-denial history or reduce placement, arming, disarming, collection or trigger/Reaction costs. Those remain separately paid physical events.
Apply the same predicate to Bowyer's actual bounded mundane bow/arrow creation and Master Smithing's authorized weapon/armor creation: their actual creation work qualifies, with full bridge credentials, stock, DC, phases and waits. Combat Engineering's actual barricade creation also qualifies but its own half factor and Craftsman compare once (60 to30, not15). Master Smithing's expressly nondiscounted eight-hour temper and Combat Engineering's expressly fixed ten-minute kill-zone preparation remain unchanged. Separate encoding, repair, maintenance, harvesting, copying, ritual casting and rest remain outside Craftsman. Actual advanced recipe121 still keeps its own required included incorporation/phase/stock/assistant rules; the short feat processes do not rewrite them. Merely printing a fixed duration neither exempts genuine creation nor makes a noncreation activity eligible.

A24-hour independent curing wait remains24hours. A2-hour self-repair is still2hours because repair is not creation, even if the repaired item was originally made with Craftsman.

Craftsman supplies only its half-active-time factor; it supplies no process, skill, formula, assistants, work opportunity, materials, use or output. Use the strongest genuinely applicable creation reduction once. An explicit source exclusion or distinct alteration/preparation/service category still controls. Keep actual physical minimum phases only where the source requires them; do not manufacture an advanced-recipe incorporation phase for every short feat process.
Contraption Crafter's ten minutes are the ordinary base for its real gadget construction. With actual personally leading Craftsman ownership the complete job is five uninterrupted active minutes, not ten with a final five-minute discount and not two-and-a-half from a second equivalent half. The whole adjusted job must be uninterrupted; phase logging, assistant handoff, pauses, rest or partially completed earlier attempts cannot satisfy it. Keep actual Gnome heritage, usable tinker's tools, the same five-gp suitable owned parts and the same once-per-24-elapsed-hours use committed at start. A new lawful construction still ends its old gadget at start. Interruption spends the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget, no completion roll, no refundable tail and no resumable partial product. Completion rolls the same one d4 openly, once; it grants no chosen profile, duplicate gadget, general proficiency, quality, recipe XP or parts recovery. The same one-hour gadget lifetime starts at actual completion, not at the undiscounted hypothetical finish. Transfer/deployment/activation/recharge rules are unchanged. The time benefit is prospective and cannot manufacture a mid-job feat acquisition opportunity; if a real change interrupts the required work, the ordinary failure consequence applies.
Trapsetter's independently authorized thirty-active-minute kit assembly is likewise eligible creation: fifteen active minutes with Craftsman. This includes only its actual prepared-kit assembly from the real source parts; it cannot manufacture an ordinary twenty-caltrop stock bag out of an arbitrary substitute or count buying/deploying one as new creation. Keep the one completion DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves-tools check, ordinary task degree/natural shifts collapsed to binary, actual parts, failure consumption and recoverable remaining metal/frame. No manufacturing quality/yield/XP or general recipe is added. NEW NARROW WORK-CREDIT COMPLETION for this otherwise unphased kit assembly: track actual active work in seconds against the adjusted required total; pauses do not by themselves erase already completed usable physical assembly work. A pause earns no credit, protection or rest entitlement. Preserve the actual partial body and committed stock under their ordinary custody, deterioration and loss rules; work that a genuine physical event destroys cannot remain credited. The unfinished kit has no function. Resume only the remaining actual work with the real usable/replacement parts; do not duplicate stock, credit or partial bodies. No completion roll occurs until the whole adjusted job is actually complete. Neither Contraption's uninterrupted-work/use forfeiture nor advanced manufacture's incorporation/stabilization is imported. A more-specific explicitly authorized phase/loss rule still controls.
Kit assembly does not spend or refresh Trapsetter's three source-specific quick-placement allowances, arm a trap, clear an old active slot, reset hard-denial history or reduce placement, arming, disarming, collection or trigger/Reaction costs. Those remain separately paid physical events.
Apply the same predicate to Bowyer's actual bounded mundane bow/arrow creation and Master Smithing's authorized weapon/armor creation: their actual creation work qualifies, with full bridge credentials, stock, DC, phases and waits. Combat Engineering's actual barricade creation also qualifies but its own half factor and Craftsman compare once (60 to30, not15). Master Smithing's expressly nondiscounted eight-hour temper and Combat Engineering's expressly fixed ten-minute kill-zone preparation remain unchanged. Separate encoding, repair, maintenance, harvesting, copying, ritual casting and rest remain outside Craftsman. Actual advanced recipe121 still keeps its own required included incorporation/phase/stock/assistant rules; the short feat processes do not rewrite them. Merely printing a fixed duration neither exempts genuine creation nor makes a noncreation activity eligible.

originalSourceObject.name: Forge
originalSourceObject.description: Racial feat tied to Dwarf heritage.
originalSourceObject.effect: Forged – All crafted armor has +10% durability and you resist fire by +10%.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual Dwarf heritage. NEW: when you are the lead and personally complete a newly crafted armor suit, record a P10 physical durability workmanship source on that exact output. “All crafted armor” means your own completed outputs, including a lawful transformative recipe whose actual armor host qualifies; purchased suits or merely repaired suits do not acquire it. Shields are excluded unless an exact armor profile expressly includes them. Use the reviewed strongest percentage workmanship family: P10 competes with P25/P50 rather than multiplying. Compute baselineB after actual size/grade, improved maximum B+max(1,floor(B×P/100)) for positiveP, apply any persistent flaw last, and preserve the actual damage deficit. This is permanent physical workmanship, unaffected by magic suppression, with no automatic current-HP healing beyond the existing capacity/deficit calculation. Separately, your personal fire-damage defense is explicitly10%, not standard half resistance. NEW: after ordinary fire immunity/resistance/vulnerability and other passive flat reductions, multiply the remaining nonnegative fire component by0.90 and round down once for this step before later eligible reactions/tempHP. One Forge instance applies once; it does not improve another creature wearing your armor or turn your fire defense into20%.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Use with an actual willing transaction in ordinary mundane goods, a finite buyer/seller and a quoted quantity. Exclude artifacts, magic-item effects, labor/services, taxes, guild tariffs and monopolies unless their own exact rule expressly admits ordinary negotiation. NEW procedure: before the check the provider states its ordinary quote, whether the deal is negotiable, the supported improvement ceiling0–10%, the relevant approach and a concrete price-persuasion DC, default15 for an ordinary receptive negotiation. Spend10actual minutes and make CHA/Persuasion for honest bargaining, CHA/Deception for an actual plausible misrepresentation, or an actually applicable established Profession credential with its ordinary ability; this does not create a new Profession skill. Success or Critical Success gives the agreed ceiling, default10% if a negotiable ordinary deal has no smaller stated ceiling; Failure/Critical Failure gives no feat discount and preserves the source’s actual deception consequences. The result changes the final otherwise-negotiated purchase by×(1-ceiling) or sale by×(1+ceiling), before final copper rounding, with no double count of the same concession. NEW same concession family: multiple owners/repeated checks cannot compound this feat or claim another10% on the same deal. A change of speaker or splitting one order does not reset unchanged-state negotiation. Keep the actual provider’s predeclared floor/ceiling and refusal; no roll creates stock, consent or guaranteed profit. Reconcile the final58-question social/settlement verdict before adoption.

originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual trained Tinkering trade level5or higher. Keep current+2repair wording over the preserved+5description/legacy wording. Add+2 to an actual eligible check to repair a complex mechanical mechanism using its governing repair credential and procedure; merely being made of metal does not make an object complex. NEW definition: a functioning assembly with interdependent moving, timing, pressure or control components, including a qualifying trap, clockwork or siege mechanism; no generic magic repair permission is added. If an actual authorized repair completes during your own beneficial Short Rest, add currentPB to that repair’s structural-current-HP restoration, capped at its recorded maximum, once for the physical target and completed repair. NEW narrow rest exception permits at most30active repair minutes inside that Short Rest with compatible light activity, actual tools, materials and safe access; longer repairs must be done as work and do not receive the rest clause merely because an observer rests nearby. This never raises maximumHP, refreshes charges/service, repairs a missing body or turns an unsuccessful check into success. Most ordinary full-restoration repairs already reach maximum, so their extraPB is capped away; an actual partial-restoration repair can benefit. Neither the feat nor taking a rest creates a free generic repair attempt.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Trade-level prerequisite; explicit complex assembly;30-minute rest exception and capped current-HP-only bonus.
submittedWorkedCases: A permitted partial mechanical repair restores2of a device’s missing8HP during a legal rest; withPB3 this feat restores5total, not5maximumHP. Actual materials and the original procedure still apply.
A successful ordinary repair already restores the device to maximum10. Its additionalPB grants0extraHP, not a new maximum13, and repairing it again cannot permanently increase its durability.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Halve active construction time for actual field fortifications, barricades or emplaced cover you personally lead; use the strongest applicable creation/construction discount once and pay for genuine materials, tools and participants. NEW fallback field-barricade profile: one5-foot-wide,3-foot-high braced wooden panel,20lb of real planks/bracing plus2gp ordinary hardware reference, carpenter’s or Tinker’s tools and60active minutes before this feat’s reduction; DC12 INT/Engineering at completion, binary Core task resolution. Success makes one physical20lb panel withAC15/10structuralHP; failure spends time and hardware, preserves only actually remaining reusable planks and creates no useful cover. This profile is not a crafting quality/yield/XP route. Larger works need their own complete plan and quantities, not an extrapolated instant fortress. Emplaced cover you build supplies the source+2AC where the actual obstruction provides half cover; the older+1comparison is retained as history, not added to the reviewed+2AC/+2DEX half-cover rule. Best cover only; no extra+2on top of ordinary cover. An obstruction too small to supply half cover gives no manufactured bonus. Add+2 to actual Engineering checks about siege devices, bridges or structural weak points, not every tool or attack roll.

NEW complete kill-zone procedure: spend10active minutes with actual tools and5lb of appropriate expendable mundane spikes, weights/cord or fuel/ignition supplies (reference10gp) preparing two adjacent5-foot ground squares within one10-foot choke point; select piercing, bludgeoning or fire before work. This is a fixed feat preparation, not another discounted recipe; supplies are consumed when preparing the setup. One setup per owner may exist, remains until moved/destroyed or24elapsed hours pass, and has one exposed control assemblyAC15/5HP. Spend an Action while conscious within30feet and able to see the prepared area to designate/arm it, expending one Short-Rest use for one minute. The first actual hostile entrant onto its ground during that minute, including forced arrival, triggers once if you are still conscious within30feet and can perceive that entry; ordinary occupants when armed and creatures flying above the ground do not enter its trigger. The entrant makes DEX saveDC8+PB+INT modifier snapshotted at activation; failure takes2d6chosen damage and halves all its nonteleport Speeds until the end of its current turn if it entered on that turn, otherwise until its next regular-turn end. Success avoids both. Discharge or timeout expends the setup; no repeat trigger, ally damage exemption on other traps, unused-use refund or remote knowledge. The zone ends if its control assembly is Broken, moved or disconnected from the prepared squares. This explicit manually supervised feat mechanism does not redefine ordinary Tinkering/rune traps.

sourceObject.name: Core Infusion
sourceObject.description: You drive elemental or arcane cores into steel and stone until the metal remembers how to burn, freeze, or sing. Prestige lineage: Forge Master. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Proficiency in Craft (Blacksmith), spellcasting ability or Engineering
sourceObject.effect: When you finish a long rest, you may infuse one weapon or armor you crafted with a minor property (e.g., +1 fire damage, +1 AC, or resistance to one energy type) for 24 hours. Relic-tier work requires a forge and rare materials. While wearing or wielding an item you infused, you gain +2 to Craft (Blacksmith) checks to repair it, and once per short rest you may re-roll one failed Craft check on that item.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Require actual Smith’s-tools/Blacksmithing proficiency and either actual spellcasting ability or actual Engineering proficiency. At completion of your beneficial Long Rest, you may touch one functional weapon or armor suit for which you have a genuine personal lead-crafter receipt and place one infusion on it for24elapsed hours. NEW: your own qualifying transformative manufacture counts, but buying, repairing or merely assisting does not. One active infusion per owner; replacing it ends the old one. One infusion slot per body across all owners; a new consensual infusion replaces the existing one rather than adding. The creature holding/wearing it must actually allow the accessible operation; no remote overwrite.

Choose one NEW closed minor property: a weapon adds+1fire to each actual hit made with it; an armor suit gains+1AC in equipment.defense-enhancement; or either body grants resistance to one chosen acid,cold,fire,lightning or thunder damage type while actually properly worn as armor or wielded as a functional weapon. The+1fire is a flat component of the same hit, not critical-doubled or an independent proc; it does not enhance spells merely cast while holding the weapon. Resistances do not double with same-type resistance. The magical infusion suspends while Broken, suppressed, melded or otherwise unusable, with its original clock running; repair/unsuppression can resume the remaining time but cannot refresh it. It is magical item functionality, not a spell, concentration or Counterspell target. The feat grants no Relic item or additional Relic property: any actual Relic work still requires its specifically authorized design, rare materials, forge and access, beyond this closed menu.

While you actually wear/wield your own currently active, usable infused item, gain+2 to actual Blacksmithing repair checks on that same item. Once per Short Rest you may reroll one failed actual Craft check on that same item under the shared reroll timing while this wear/wield eligibility holds. NEW: Craft here includes otherwise authorized Blacksmithing creation/alteration/repair checks actually acting on that item, not unrelated Engineering or research. Physical work still needs the source’s real tools/position and safe access; wearing a suit during a repair is not automatically feasible. A Broken item supplies neither bonus nor reroll because it cannot be functionally worn/wielded for the infusion. The reroll expends only this allowance, pays no duplicate batch cost, and never resurrects an ineligible work order.

An infused weapon breaks six hours into its24-hour duration. Its fire property and repair-check feat benefit suspend. Lawful repair four hours later can restore the remaining fourteen hours, not a new full day or free reroll while Broken.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
While conscious and actually holding a weapon in a legal grip, you cannot be involuntarily disarmed of that weapon. NEW: resolve an otherwise valid disarm attempt normally to determine whether it would succeed, then keep the weapon and deal1d4bludgeoning directly to that initiating attacker instead, subject to its ordinary defenses. This is the source’s special retaliation even for a legal ranged disarm; it is not an attack, critical hit, spell, weapon-damage proc or reflected copy, and cannot recursively trigger itself. A failed attempt deals nothing. It does not prevent voluntary release, destruction/Broken state, severed anatomy, a legal whole-body movement or losing consciousness, and does not protect unrelated held objects merely because they are called important. Add+2 to actual Craft(Blacksmith)/Smith’s-tools checks within the real tool scope. You may wield an actually profiled weapon one size category larger without the penalty imposed solely by that size mismatch; no extra size/damage/reach/hands/proficiency is created. This and Giant Strength confer the same one-category permission, not two categories.

Once per Short Rest, use a Bonus Action while conscious/capable and legally gripping a weapon to lock your grip. Until your next original regular-turn start, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage. Separately, the next legal melee hit you make during that duration gains+1d6of its ordinary melee damage type only if your cumulative actual displacement since locking is at most5feet. NEW: count voluntary/forced movement, carried movement and actual teleport displacement; in-place rotation is0. Once displacement exceeds5feet, the damage opportunity is lost for this activation even if you return; the opportunity-attack disadvantage persists for its original duration. On the first qualifying hit commit the rider once, with its attack dice doubled on a critical, in the same event. No further rider, free attack or extra Reaction follows. Losing consciousness ends this activation; ending initiative preserves its next regular-start deadline through the existing six-second outside timing, without refresh. Extra turns do not advance the original regular-start expiry.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Held-weapon-only no-disarm replacement and nonrecursive retaliation; one-size permission; full grip-lock movement,expiry and attack-dice rules.
submittedWorkedCases: An attacker’s legal disarm would succeed while you consciously hold your sword. You retain it and resolve1d4bludgeoning against that attacker. An unrelated shove can still move you and counts against a current grip-lock movement limit.

After locking, you move5feet and land a melee critical; its single+1d6rider becomes2d6for that hit. If you had moved10feet and returned5, the rider would be lost even though your final location is close; opportunity attacks still have disadvantage until expiry.

records.name: Master Smithing

sourceObject.name: Master Smithing
sourceObject.description: Kings queue for your steel. You measure temper, fold, and spell-work in the same breath. Prestige lineage: Forge Master. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: You can craft masterwork weapons and armor and work toward relic-tier items with appropriate materials and a forge access. Armor you craft reduces armor check penalty by 1 and may include one minor property (e.g., fire resistance 5, silent movement, or +1 to a saving throw) chosen at completion. Weapons you craft gain +1 to damage rolls; once per week you may temper one weapon you personally forged, granting it a named masterwork trait (flaming edge, returning throw, or spell-holding groove) that lasts until the weapon is broken or reforged.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Require actual Smith’s-tools/Blacksmithing proficiency and INT13. You may use the shared bounded mundane-creation bridge for its legal metal weapon/armor models, or an independently accessible reviewed recipe with all its original gates. “Masterwork” remains an earned quality result, not automatic equipment grade. Relic-tier work still needs an actual authorized design, rare materials, forge and access; this feat does not create a new relic catalog or bypass protected content.

NEW on genuine personal lead completion: an armor suit you craft reduces by1 an actual numeric armor-check penalty imposed by that suit, minimum0penalty; it creates no such penalty where none exists and does not remove Stealth disadvantage or a STR/Load/nonproficiency consequence. At completion choose at most one permanent minor armor property: flat fire reduction5after normal fire resistance/vulnerability but before Forge’s percentage layer; silent movement removing only that suit’s own armor-Stealth disadvantage; or+1to one chosen ability’s saving throws in the existing equipment.jewel-save-enhancement family. The fire/silence/save property is magical, suspends while the suit is Broken, suppressed, melded or improperly worn, and resumes only if the actual suit is lawfully restored. The numeric armor-check workmanship is physical. These properties do not themselves confer a generic new equipment grade, formula, enchantment slot or immunity. Your genuinely crafted weapon gains a permanent physical+1to its ordinary weapon-damage component on a legal hit, usable by its actual wielder; no automatic magical damage eligibility or critical doubling of the flat bonus. One same-feat workmanship identity per physical output, not another+1on each later alteration.

NEW weekly temper: no earlier than168elapsed hours after your previous successful temper completion, spend8active hours at an actual forge with Smith’s tools,25gp-reference/1lb of actual suitable tempering metal,resin and ink stock and one functional weapon you personally forged. This fixed alteration is not creation-time-discounted; no extra quality roll, output or XP. Commit supplies at start and finish only after all work; interrupted phases follow the craft framework. Record completion and select one named trait below. One trait slot per body; replacing a trait requires another lawful temper and ends the old one. Its magical trait lasts until the weapon becomes Broken or is actually reforged; breaking ends it permanently, ordinary repair does not restore it. Suppression merely pauses usable benefits while the body survives.

Flaming edge: on one actual legal weapon hit per actual turn, you may add1d4fire as part of that same event, doubled on an attack critical. NEW: it shares the weapon’s one printed-elemental-rider expenditure family with any actual Blacksmithing elemental rider; choose one qualifying rider, do not spend the same item/turn for both. Use the reviewed Blacksmithing outside-window, host-turn and transition-guard procedure in full, including persistent physical identity and no refund after mitigation.

Returning throw: after a legal thrown attack with this actual weapon resolves, it may immediately return along a clear unobstructed route of at most60feet to its thrower. An actual compatible free hand catches it; otherwise it lands at the thrower’s feet. It cannot return while Broken, caught/held by another creature, pinned, or across an impassable obstruction; no teleport, automatic escape from custody, extra attack or altered weapon range. An ammunition weapon itself being improvised-thrown uses its actual legal attack, but fired arrows are different bodies and do not inherit this trait.

Spell-holding groove: NEW one-use inscription capacity, not a stored paid cast. An eligible caster spends10active minutes with writing implements and5gp of actual suitable ink to encode one exact independently reviewed ordinary rank1spell the caster genuinely knows through a current casting source. Keep its source identity and complete restrictions; encoding spends noRP and grants no class/list/rank access. One eligible reader may later use that one payload under the reviewed Scribing temporary-repertoire casting rule: actual class/list placement, level/rank, ordinary RP,components,casting time,concentration and cadence all apply; commit and erase the inscription when the cast commits, even if countered. Actual accessible readable groove, functional weapon and source-legal free hands are required; wielding this weapon is not automatically a focus. It gives no extra Action, attack-triggered free spell, automatic hit or spell damage added to a weapon attack. One groove/one payload; a new encoding replaces an unspent one with new work/ink. Ending/breaking/reforging the trait destroys its inscription without a refund.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Require actual Engineering proficiency. You deal+20%damage with an actual personally caused eligible damage event against a creature actually typed Construct, an independently profiled fortification component or a siege-engine body. NEW: this includes legal direct weapon/spell damage and a genuinely attributable deployed explosive/trap, but grants no object targeting to creature-only effects and excludes copied/reflected damage, another operator’s event, HP-cost payments and a rider already counted through the same event. Determine eligible ordinary damage components including their normal dice and flat bonuses before target defenses; compute one bonus floor(0.20×their nonnegative total). Allocate that integer bonus proportionally among their actual damage types by largest remainder, with ties in the event’s recorded component order; this preserves types and avoids rounding every small component up. Do not recursively increase other percentage bonuses or the generated bonus. Apply actual defenses after the increase; this feature alone does not make damage magical.

An actual explosive you personally deploy gains+5feet to its explicitly circular/spherical blast radius, and targets do not receive half-cover bonuses on that explosion’s actual detonation save. NEW: do not invent a save or radius for a single-target/nonradial effect; three-quarters and total cover remain, and targeting/origin/line rules still apply. Allies are not exempt from the enlarged area. A source expressly prohibiting modification keeps that prohibition. Nonexplosive spells do not become explosives by description.

NEW weak-point study: spend an Action observing a visible structure/component or Construct within60feet and make INT/Engineering againstDC15for ordinary visible engineering orDC20for a genuinely unusual but diagnostically exposed design. An unsupported/fully hidden weakness cannot be invented. On Success/Critical Success, identify one actual weak point to allies who can perceive your explanation within30feet; the next legal attack by one such informed ally against that exact target within1minute has advantage, consumed when declared even if advantage cancels. The marker does not stack and expires if the structure meaningfully changes. Failure allows a retry only after genuinely changed evidence/method, not another free look each round.

Once per Short Rest, after studying one actual mundane wall/barricade section within30feet continuously from your regular-turn start through the start of your next regular turn (six elapsed seconds outside initiative), spend an Action adjacent to it with actual suitable demolition tools to collapse one exposed section at most5feet wide,5feet high and1foot thick. NEW size bounds complete “5-foot section”; thicker bodies lose only that genuine separable section, not an invented tunnel through the remaining wall. A wholly magical barrier is ineligible; a unique mundane wall is not immune merely by its name. The section must be physically reachable and its collapse possible from the actual exposed construction; no automatic reach through other walls. Record real structural/load consequences before use; this does not automatically collapse an entire building. The selected section becomes actual rubble in its original footprint, ordinary difficult terrain and half cover for creatures genuinely positioned behind it, including enemies where the same physical cover applies. It remains until real work clears it. NEW generic clearing is10active minutes per collapsed section with suitable tools/storage for displaced rubble; missing destination or tools prevents clearance. No automatic crushing damage or ejection into occupied space is created; use an independently supported hazard if actual bystanders/loads require one.

sourceObject.name: Trapsetter
sourceObject.description: Tripwire, caltrop, and charge—the ground remembers your name and bites when asked. Prestige lineage: Sapper. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Proficiency in Engineering or Disable Device
sourceObject.effect: You can set a mechanical trap as a bonus action (once per short rest per trap type: snare, caltrop field, or spring-loaded charge). Traps may stun, burn, or slow on a failed save (DC 8 + proficiency + Intelligence modifier). You gain advantage on checks to spot hidden traps and tunnels within 30 feet. When a creature triggers a trap you placed, you may use your reaction to move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature, repositioning behind cover or into a prepared kill-zone.

NEW these fields discharge after that first eligible trigger regardless of result; surviving actual metal/body can be recovered, but rearming requires a new prepared kit procedure/consumed expendables. A charge consumes its filling; this does not duplicate its frame. Placement speed does not shorten preparation or refill after transfer.

Pay ordinary terrain/mode costs from this distinct movement budget, respect speed0/restraints and actual paths. This movement provokes no opportunity attack from that triggering creature; other creatures’ normal opportunity attacks remain. One trigger event permits at most one Reaction; copies, already discharged traps and additional targets of one blast are not new triggers.

FT84-Q03 / FT84-CLOSED-CREATION-01 — Craftsman applies to actual authorized creation, not names or all fixed-duration work.

The whole adjusted job must be uninterrupted; phase logging, assistant handoff, pauses, rest or partially completed earlier attempts cannot satisfy it. Completion rolls the same one d4 openly, once; it grants no chosen profile, duplicate gadget, general proficiency, quality, recipe XP or parts recovery. The same one-hour gadget lifetime starts at actual completion, not at the undiscounted hypothetical finish. Transfer/deployment/activation/recharge rules are unchanged. The time benefit is prospective and cannot manufacture a mid-job feat acquisition opportunity; if a real change interrupts the required work, the ordinary failure consequence applies.

This includes only its actual prepared-kit assembly from the real source parts; it cannot manufacture an ordinary twenty-caltrop stock bag out of an arbitrary substitute or count buying/deploying one as new creation. Keep the one completion DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves-tools check, ordinary task degree/natural shifts collapsed to binary, actual parts, failure consumption and recoverable remaining metal/frame. sourceObject.description: Repeated, well-placed blows find the seams in an enemy's armor and press the advantage.
sourceObject.effect: Once per turn when you deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, reduce the target’s AC by 1 until the start of your next turn. This does not stack with itself.

Apply a separate −1 AC layer through your next original regular start. Further applications from any owner never sum below −1; retain independent expiry records, so the penalty persists while at least one remains. Fully prevented damage does not trigger; temp-HP absorption of a positive resolved packet still does. Copied, reflected, transferred and ongoing periodic damage do not generate applications. Do not damage or regrade armor.

sourceObject.description: A commanding voice directs three nearby allies into more favorable positions when the line must shift.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Action, once per short rest: choose one to three other willing allied creatures within30ft who can hear and understand the brief directive. Recheck hearing, willingness, position and capability at that recipient's resolution. Terrain and hazards apply; movement from this instruction provokes no opportunity attacks. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: If you have undergone no actual positional displacement since your most recent original regular-turn start, spend Reaction when a direct damage event would damage you. NEW all voluntary, forced, carried and teleport displacement counts, even returning to the same square; standing, turning in place and a failed move do not. Before your first encounter turn, count displacement since encounter entry. Reduce one whole resolved incoming event by max(0,PB+CON modifier), after ordinary passive defenses and before temporary HP. Allocate reduction across components in their stable order, never below0; one attack's fire and slashing are one event, separate attacks are not. Do not re-mitigate a transferred packet that explicitly forbids recipient mitigation. This affects damage only, not attached conditions, sacrificed HP or state assignment. Paying with a zero reduction is allowed but does not create healing.

originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once per turn during your own legal voluntary movement, declare crossing one hostile creature's occupied space whose size is no more than one category larger. You must have enough ordinary remaining movement cost and a visible or known legal unoccupied exit to traverse its entire occupied footprint; occupied terrain costs at least difficult. Before first entry, that creature may spend its Reaction for one legal melee opportunity attack against you, even though you are entering rather than leaving. All actual reaction, sight, reach and opportunity-immunity restrictions apply. If it hits, this passage fails: remain in your last legal outside space, spend the first attempted entry step's cost and the feat use. The hit's other consequences resolve normally. If it misses, declines, cannot attack or its opportunity attack is suppressed, proceed, paying actual traversal costs. Recheck the exit after interruptions; if traversal becomes impossible before entry, stay outside and spend the committed use. Do not willingly start a traversal without a complete legal route. Other creatures may make normal opportunity attacks. This does not shove or phase through a creature.

originalSourceObject.effect: +15% AC, can't move this turn

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW complete activation: when choosing your stance at the start of a regular own turn before using any stance benefit or moving voluntarily, choose Defensive Stance instead of a normal stance. No Action; one stance choice. Through your next original regular start, add floor(15% of your otherwise-current AC), minimum0, to AC. Compute the base after actual armor/shield/DEX/flat bonuses/penalties but before this or any other percentage-AC bonus; no percent-on-percent multiplication. Recompute when that underlying base changes, including conditional Guard. You cannot voluntarily change position by Speed expenditure, teleport or a feature while the current regular turn lasts; linked extra turns also retain the movement restriction. Standing/dropping Prone is allowed if ordinary budget/capability permits. Forced displacement remains possible and does not end the stance. Off-turn voluntary Reaction movement after that turn is allowed; AC lasts to expiry. It cannot coexist with Aggressive, Guarded, Mobile, Focused or Carrying because it occupies their stance choice, not a free extra buff.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: On a hit with a melee weapon attack, before rolling damage, select one held reachable object and forgo one actual base-weapon damage die to attempt disarming it. NEW remove one die before critical doubling; a critical1d8 weapon forgoes its entire doubled base2d8, retaining lawful flat damage and independent riders. Never pay with a rider die, a die already spent on another feat, or a fixed-damage expression. The target chooses STR or DEX save against DC8+PB+the actual attack ability modifier. Resolve remaining hit damage, then the save if the creature still holds the object. Failure drops it into an adjacent legal unoccupied space you choose, otherwise its own space. No extra damage to object, severed curse or bond; actual non-droppable bonds prevent dropping. An object wielded with two hands is still one object. No new once-turn cap: each separately paid qualifying hit can attempt, but the chosen die is spent even if immunity prevents the result.

A target's bonded blade cannot drop. The attacker's declared damage die is still forgone; the bond is not broken.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: After you take the Attack Action on your turn and make at least one attack with a weapon classified as ranged, spend your available Bonus Action that turn for one additional attack with a legal ranged weapon. NEW it may be a different ranged weapon and a different target; thrown melee weapons do not meet ranged-weapon classification. Supply actual ammunition, loaded state, reload/loading cadence and usable hands. Omit a positive ability damage modifier but retain a negative one, matching current two-weapon arithmetic; only a feature expressly restoring this attack's modifier can restore it. A two-weapon-only exception is insufficient. No attack is granted off-turn by a readied Attack; a linked extra turn may supply the trigger only if it has a legal Attack Action and Bonus Action, without refreshing any consumed shared allowances. This never grants an extra BA.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once per encounter, when you legally draw a genuinely sheathed melee weapon as part of making a weapon attack with it, declare Draw Cut before the attack roll. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At attack-roll resolution, before that attack's damage, check whether the actual target's normalHP is strictly below half its current effective maximum:2×HP<maximum. Choose the broadest actually applicable critical range among this and other features; never add their range expansions. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW complete procedure: Bonus Action, one perceived hostile creature within30ft that can perceive your deliberate threatening movement; oppose your CHA Deception with its WIS Insight. Higher total wins; ties preserve state, with no task-degree/natural shift. On success, apply−2AC against your next attack on that creature before your next original regular start. Declare the affected attack before rolling; it consumes the feint hit or miss. Failure has no effect. Only one unspent Feint per owner; a new successful Feint replaces your prior mark. Multiple owners can each set their own next-attack records, but one attack never receives more than one−2 Feint layer. Feint does not compel beliefs, create a universal off-guard condition or lower AC against other attackers. No rest use cap; the real BA and opposed check fund each attempt. If a target cannot perceive the act, it is ineligible rather than automatically beaten.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Before any melee weapon attack roll, you may declare Reckless Swing. That one attack gains advantage and adds one base weapon damage die if it hits; critical doubles that additional attack die. Regardless of hit, miss or advantage cancellation, all attacks against you have advantage through your next original regular start. Repeated declarations on separately legal attacks can each supply their one die but do not stack attacker advantage or create attacks; overlapping vulnerability records retain the same next-start deadline. This is not a rage and has no resistance or ability-score substitution. Spell, thrown ranged and unarmed attacks do not qualify; actual natural weapon melee attacks do. Ordinary costs, conditions and damage-source restrictions remain.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW acquisition bridge: the legacy Agility15 means DEX15 for this feat only; Melee Proficiency means actual proficiency with at least one melee weapon. After a hostile melee attack against you misses while your active Dodge actually applies to it, OR after an actual sourced Parry/Deflect effect expressly turns that attack into a miss, you may spend your available Reaction to make one legal melee weapon attack against that same attacker in reach. No movement or extra Reaction is granted. A parry that merely reduces damage is insufficient; missing for ordinary AC without qualifying Dodge/Parry is insufficient. If the defensive effect already used your only Reaction, you cannot also riposte. A permitted additional Reaction must explicitly allow an attack; defensive-only grants cannot pay. Apply shared causal-root prohibition on counterattack chains. Once per original regular-start interval even if another source grants extra attack-capable Reactions.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Track a consecutive direct melee-attack hit chain for each owner during one encounter. Every actual melee attack you make advances the event sequence: a hit on the same current target increases the count; a miss or attack directed at a different target ends the old chain, and a hit on the new target starts a new count1. NEW any intervening nonmelee attack also breaks the chain; movement, spellcasting without attacks and nonattack actions do not. Own/off-turn melee attacks participate, but copies/periodic events do not. Once per turn, before rolling a qualifying hit's damage, add min(PB, prior consecutive hits on that target) as a flat native-type bonus. Only declare when at least one prior hit exists; spending on this hit prevents spending on a later hit that turn. The chain persists across regular turn boundaries but ends on target death/removal, encounter conclusion, or loss of that actual creature identity. Transformation of the same surviving identity retains it if target continuity is real.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW feat-only geometry: you and one other willing allied, non-Incapacitated creature each threaten the same enemy with an actual legal melee attack, and the straight segment joining your occupied-space centers crosses the interior of that enemy's occupied footprint, placing you on opposite sides. Measure actual occupied bodies on the current map; a large creature needs opposite sides of its whole footprint, not merely two nearby squares. Both participants must perceive the target and be able to attack it; total cover or unusable reach prevents flanking. This geometry itself grants no universal advantage. Once per turn, when either participant hits that enemy with a melee attack, you may assign your feat allowance to add1d6 of one native damage type to that hit before damage is rolled. One successful attack may receive only one Tactical Flanker die across all owners; choose its funding owner before rolling. A critical doubles this attack rider die. Misses spend nothing; using your allowance on an ally prevents using it again on your own hit that actual turn. Perception/reach/geometry must hold at the hit.
