sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Bonus Action, once per short rest: while holding an actual usable ranged weapon, choose a creature you can see within that weapon's printed maximum legal long range (normal range if no long value) and with line of effect. NEW a thrown weapon with an actual range also qualifies. Record the chosen weapon only to establish activation range; stowing it later does not end the mark. For1minute, the first attack against the marked creature by each other creature currently allied to you gains+1 to hit. This is once per ally identity for the entire mark, not per turn, and is consumed by that attack even if it misses. You are not your own ally for this feat. A creature's later alliance change does not reset its used identity; a newly arriving genuine ally can use its own first attack. Only one mark per owner; replacement, owner death or expiry ends the old record. NEW owner incapacitation does not end an existing mark. No continuous range/tether after activation and no vision/targeting permission is granted. Multiple marks never give more than+1 to the same attack; all applicable unspent first-attack entitlements for that attacker consume on that first event.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Whenever your own direct legal effect pushes or knocks a creature a positive specified distance away from you or along its printed outward direction, increase that displacement by5ft. It can modify a weapon, ordinary maneuver, spell or class effect if you are the actual source; not a companion's own effect, pull, teleport, fall, current, carried movement or copy/transfer. Preserve its original size/eligibility/path. Add the5 once per displacement event; same-family copies do not add further5. The final movement still stops at walls, anchors and illegal positions. Once per turn, if that same displacement-producing effect has an actual STR/DEX/other save which the target fails by5 or more, also apply Prone independently of blocked displacement. No save is invented for an ordinary opposed Shove; its numerical contest difference is not a save failure margin. Automatic failure has no numerical margin unless its source explicitly says otherwise. If an original effect already applies Prone, do not duplicate it.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Positive outward displacement predicate, once-per-event extension and literal saved failure margin.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW full completion: Action, once per short rest, wield a loaded/properly supplied bow using arrows and choose a visible point within that bow's actual normal range and line of effect. Select up to PB distinct perceived creatures in a10ft-radius area around that point, each independently in normal range and with a legal shot. You may exclude allies; no hidden-target scan or compulsory friendly fire is added. Lock targets/order, spend the use and one actual arrow per selected target, then make one separate normal ranged weapon attack against each. Apply actual AC, cover, proficiency, crits and ordinary native bow damage to each; there is no area save/DC or shared damage roll. Extra Attack does not multiply this special Action. Each target at most once; newly entering creatures cannot replace lost targets. A target becoming illegal before its shot is skipped and its committed arrow remains spent. Interrupted remaining shots lose the use and committed ammunition. Loading/reload and all other item restrictions remain, so a weapon that cannot fire the necessary arrows cannot declare that many shots. It is a special Volley Action, not Attack Action for Double Tap or Eldritch Combat.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW complete interpretation: surrounded means at least two different conscious hostile creatures within5ft of you, on opposite sides under Tactical Flanker's center-segment geometry, each currently able to attack you in melee. While that predicate holds, gain+1AC as an explicit conversion of the source's undefined+5% evasion; this is not literal5%damage reduction or a separate avoidance roll. Once on your own turn, after your melee weapon attack hits a creature while surrounded, you may deal a cleave packet to one different perceived hostile creature within the actual reach of that same weapon. Amount is floor10% of that hit's eligible native weapon damage before percentages/defenses; allocate native types as shared arithmetic. No second attack roll, no new critical and no on-hit riders/resources from this derived packet; ordinary recipient defenses apply. The primary attack can be fully mitigated and still supply its legal pre-defense native amount, but a missed attack cannot. Cleave needs real reach/line, deals0 if the rounded amount is0, and cannot itself cleave or trigger a drop-generated attack/heal. Losing surrounded geometry ends AC immediately.

sourceObject.description: Your strikes carry whispers from beyond the veil—steel and sigil in a single motion. Prestige lineage: Hexblade. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Spellcasting ability, proficiency with martial weapons
sourceObject.effect: When you take the Attack action, you can cast a cantrip or 1st-level spell with a range of touch or self as part of the same action without provoking opportunity attacks. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Acquire only with a real spellcasting route and actual martial-weapon proficiency. NEW read1st-level as rank1 for this feat only. Once on your own regular-turn interval, when you take Attack Action and complete its attack sequence, append one actually available Action-time rank0 or rank1 spell with literal Touch or Self range as part of that same Action. You must have hit a creature with at least one of those attacks if choosing an external Touch target; that exact hit creature must also be a legal sole recipient of the spell. A Self spell must actually target only you, not a cone/area originating from Self that independently targets others. Spell must be acquired/prepared on a legitimate route with real level/rank access, RP or finite charge, components/hands/focus, target consent where required, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain, casting prohibitions and interruption. No normal casting cost is waived. An attack hit does not substitute for a spell's own required attack/save. Longer spells, BA spells and Reaction spells are not compressed by this grant. Separately, once per SR after your melee weapon attack hits, you may append one legitimately available Action-time Touch spell of any legally accessible rank to that same sole target without an extra Action; this can occur off-turn. NEW both modes share at most one embedded cast per actual regular creature turn and cannot be combined on the same hit/Action. Spend SR use at casting commitment, even if countered. These appended castings do not provoke opportunity attacks solely for casting/performing the appended attack-spell operation, but movement has ordinary triggers. Neither casting may create a further Eldritch append from attacks in its own causal root. Actual source-specific secondary/resource restrictions remain; no prestige class is acquired.

records.name: Favored Enemy (Dragon)

sourceObject.name: Favored Enemy (Dragon)
sourceObject.description: You have studied scaled tyrants—their breath, their pride, the tell before the roar. Prestige lineage: Wyrmslayer. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: You deal +2 damage to dragons and dragonkin. You have advantage on Survival and Lore checks to identify dragon ancestry, breath type, and lair habits. When you succeed on such a check against a dragon you can see, you and allies within 30 feet gain +1 to saving throws against that dragon's breath weapon until the end of the encounter. You cannot be frightened by a dragon's presence for more than 1 round, and once per short rest you may ignore difficult terrain caused by a dragon's lair hazards (molten glass, acidic pools, or shattered stone) while pursuing that wyrm.

Spend the once-per-SR critical use on declaration; take no−2 and no+50% from this feat for this attack. If it hits, treat it as critical; a miss remains a miss and spends the use and turn allowance. A grapple by another creature suffices because that alternative predicate has no ownership restriction.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Acquire with actual Favored Enemy (Dragon) OR total level8. You are immune specifically to actual Dragons' Frightful Presence effects; unrelated dragon fear/spell effects are not automatically that identity. Existing source-qualified Frightful Presence records are suppressed while immunity applies, with clocks retained. While you are conscious, other allied creatures within30ft and with line of effect to you have advantage on saves against effects that actually impose fear/Frightened; no hearing or common-language gate is added. This is current-position aura, checked at each save, not a permanent recipient list and not self-benefit. Gain+2AC against actual attacks made by a creature explicitly typed Dragon; dragonkin alone does not satisfy this feat. Once per SR, when a Dragon you can see makes a melee attack targeting you, spend Reaction before the attack roll to impose disadvantage on that one attack. Alternatively, when such a Dragon's actual breath weapon requires your save, after the initial result but before consequences, spend Reaction and the same shared SR use to reroll your whole save with advantage; independent disadvantage cancels normally and the new result is mandatory. It does not reroll anyone else or waive a no-save breath effect. A breath that instead makes an attack roll is eligible only for the attack mode if it is actually melee; the source's breath-save language creates no new save. Immunities, sight, Reaction prohibitions and actual source tags remain.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Source-qualified immunity, conscious other-ally aura/line, Dragon-onlyAC, two exact declaration windows and mandatory save reroll.
submittedWorkedCases: A visible Dragon melee attack prompts the pre-roll Reaction, consuming the shared SR use even if it misses.
A breath DEX save initially fails. The owner rerolls with advantage before damage and must keep the new result; nearby allies keep their own original saves.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep actual source ally wording including self, with original target/sensory/budget conditions; also restore ranged breath-weapon attack rolls.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Add+5 to actual new initiative rolls. originalSourceObject.effect: You can fight with two weapons without penalty to either hand.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: The current ordinary two-weapon rule has no inherent attack-roll penalty for either hand; retain that absence. NEW completion of without penalty: when you make the ordinary two-weapon Bonus Action attack, add your usual positive ability modifier to its damage instead of omitting it. A negative modifier still applies normally. This specific grant can also restore the positive modifier to Double Tap's BA attack only if that attack is actually the ordinary two-weapon attack under both sources; a lone-crossbow Double Tap is not. The normal Light one-handed melee weapons, two usable hands, Attack Action trigger and real BA still apply unless Dual Wielder independently expands Light eligibility. It waives no proficiency, Heavy, anatomy, injury or improvised penalty and grants no second BA.

records.name: Animal Companion

sourceObject.name: Animal Companion
sourceObject.description: You have formed a bond with an animal.
sourceObject.effect: You gain an animal companion that follows your commands and fights alongside you.

records.originalQuestion: Complete a finite legal animal profile/selection and acquisition route, number, size/level progression, actual bond/ownership and command economy. Define initiative/actions/reactions, no-command behavior, injury/death/replacement and global creature caps. Existing Ranger companion rules are comparison evidence, not automatic Ranger class access.

sourceDirection.name: Animal Companion
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Complete a finite legal animal profile/selection and acquisition route, number, size/level progression, actual bond/ownership and command economy. Define initiative/actions/reactions, no-command behavior, injury/death/replacement and global creature caps. Existing Ranger companion rules are comparison evidence, not automatic Ranger class access.

originalSourceObject.name: Animal Companion
originalSourceObject.description: You have formed a bond with an animal.
originalSourceObject.effect: You gain an animal companion that follows your commands and fights alongside you.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW acquisition: with actual Animal Handling proficiency, select one already real willing/tamed Beast, noncorrupted, INT<7, that fits one of the three finite body templates below. Finding, buying or taming it requires actual campaign access/consent; the feat creates no animal, stocked shop or universal charm. Spend one uninterrupted hour together at touch range; one bond attempt per completedLR, noRP. One feat bond at a time. Use the template corresponding to the real animal's body/native movement; do not turn a dog into a bird or grant a new breathing mode. AC12+floor(ownerPB/2), maximumHP5+total owner level; template attack/ability/movement values are explicit NEW. At initial bond convert existing HP proportionally max(1,floor(newMax×oldHP/oldMax)); preserve actual conditions/injuries. Later maximum growth never heals, decreases clamp without damage. Ordinary legal healing works, but no Hit Dice/rest-refill is invented. Use one shared BA command within60ft while the animal can perceive you: in its attached phase after your regular turn, move and make its one attack or Dash/Disengage/Help/Dodge. No independent turn/Reaction; uncommanded move defensively and Dodge. The animal's HP-only chassis dies at0, producing its one actual corpse and ending the bond, with no Wound/death-save sequence; this is a feat-specific NEW rule, not generic animal law. Death/release never creates replacement: after a new completedLR, a new real animal and full hour are required. Voluntary release takes one uninterrupted hour and ends the bond without healing; preserve the same physical animal and restore its prior ordinary profile with the same current-HP fraction, not a fresh full animal. A creature cannot have this and a Ranger bond simultaneously; transferring requires actual release and new paid acquisition, not additive statistics. Owner death ends the bond and, if the animal remains alive, restores its saved ordinary profile using the same positive-HP ratio conversion as release; a dead animal remains its actual corpse. Temporary owner incapacity prevents new commands but does not cancel a previously committed legal command; after that command, uncommanded phases remain defensive. This never supplies autonomous attacks.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Complete real-animal bond, three body templates, finite statistics, proportional conversion, command/HP-only death and no-free-replacement procedure.
submittedWorkedCases: A ground companion bonded by level5 has max10HP. A real animal at half of its oldHP converts to5HP, not full10.
At0HP it dies and leaves its actual body. Taking a rest alone neither revives it nor creates another beast.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt the bounded proposal with the completed EX58 controller/phase/physical-history interface; no future transport dependency or extra animal turn.

records.operationalRules:
NEW ACQ-05 purchase/bond distinction: acquire Animal Companion once by committing one actual earned unspent feat opportunity while meeting its actual Animal Handling proficiency prerequisite and all other acquisition gates. Record that paid grant and its acquisition snapshot atomically. The animal and bonding hour are not conditions of purchasing the feat. Ownership begins at that commitment, with no companion and one unspent bond attempt under FS-06; it grants neither an animal nor an earlier completed Long Rest. Animal identity, matching template and any actually sourced sense choice belong to each bond record, not a permanently locked feat-purchase choice. The retained nonrepeatability/permanent-choice metadata does not prohibit the replacements expressly allowed here. Canceling a proposed purchase before commitment spends no opportunity. A completed purchase is not refunded or repeated because no animal is available, a bond attempt fails, or a bond later ends. Animal Companion ownership alone can satisfy Companion Training's printed parent alternative, but supplies neither its separate feat opportunity nor a creature on which to use it.

NEW ACQ-05 bond attempt: an owner of this feat with actual Animal Handling proficiency, no current feat bond, no other pending bond attempt, an unspent attempt and any required post-bond-ending Long Rest may select one already real, positive-HP living, willing/tamed, noncorrupted Beast with INT<7 fitting one of the three finite templates. The selected animal must have no incompatible existing bond, including another Animal Companion or Ranger bond. Finding, buying or taming it still needs actual lawful access and its real willing/tamed relationship to this owner; no animal, stocked shop, consent or charm is supplied. Preserve its actual identity, ordinary profile, current/maximum HP, conditions, injuries, native movement, breathing, custody and required template choices. In one ordered start event, recheck admission, reserve this owner and animal for the work, spend the one attempt, and begin the hour. Merely proposing a target or rejecting it before that event does not spend an attempt; it never reverses a previously completed feat purchase. Starting costs no RP, second feat opportunity or universal fee. An attempt cannot begin while an existing feat bond is retained; such a rejected proposal does not release or alter that bond.

Spend one uninterrupted hour of actual bonding work together at touch range. Keep the same owner and animal, actual access, the required proficiency and animal eligibility throughout the work and at completion; the owner must remain able to perform it. This is active work, not beneficial rest, and grants no extra work Watch, assistant shortcut, handover or overlapping incompatible task. Loss of required touch-range access, willing/tamed eligibility, qualifying body state, or the owner's ability to continue, including incapacitation, or voluntary abandonment terminates the attempt. Elapsed time, real losses and the spent attempt persist; no partial hour, resumed fraction or same-epoch retry is awarded. The prospective animal remains in its actual current ordinary state; no feat profile or command entitlement was installed. After a full lawful hour, atomically complete the one bond and apply the existing template/HP conversion to the animal's latest lawful ordinary state, using the owner's then-current governing statistics. No new bond check or success chance is added. Admission alone or an incomplete hour cannot establish a companion.

The initial allowance is one attempt at feat purchase. Each genuinely completed beneficial owner Long Rest thereafter sets the allowance to one, never adds a stored second attempt. Apply FS-06's actual rest limits and one elapsed clock: no reset from Short Rest, debt-only Rest, a repeated rest receipt, a scene, a new target, a new controller, a new day label or level growth. Do not credit active bonding or release work as rest. An invalid claimed completion record is evidence rejection, not an attempt or feat-payment refund: reconcile the real start/interruption/rest history. Missing history cannot be replaced by an assumed unspent allowance. One feat bond at a time. Use the template corresponding to the real animal's body/native movement; do not turn a dog into a bird or grant a new breathing mode. Ordinary legal healing works, but no Hit Dice/rest-refill is invented. Use one shared BA command within60ft while the animal can perceive you: in its attached phase after your regular turn, move and make its one attack or Dash/Disengage/Help/Dodge. No independent turn/Reaction; uncommanded move defensively and Dodge. The animal's HP-only chassis dies at0, producing its one actual corpse and ending the bond, with no Wound/death-save sequence; this is a feat-specific NEW rule, not generic animal law. NEW ACQ-05 replacement boundary: when an established feat bond ends through release or death, record that actual ending event. Before this owner begins any later feat bond, require a genuinely beneficial owner Long Rest whose completion is ordered after that event, as well as an available attempt, a real eligible living target and the full new hour. A rest completed before the ending event or an unused prior allowance cannot satisfy that replacement gate. A qualifying completion after the event is sufficient; no additional rule requires the whole rest to have started after it. Existing active-work/rest restrictions still apply. Replacement is a use of the already-owned nonrepeatable feat, not a second purchase. NEW explicit rebond interpretation: a previously released living animal may be selected again if it genuinely qualifies; it is a new bond to the same physical individual, not a new or refreshed animal. A dead animal never becomes eligible merely through rest, release, purchase or this procedure. Voluntary release requires the owner's one uninterrupted hour of actual release work. NEW ACQ-05 release boundary: record its start, but end the bond only on lawful completion; interruption or abandonment grants no partial-hour credit and leaves the existing bond intact unless an independent event already ended it. A fresh release hour may be begun while the bond still exists. Release consumes no bond attempt, feat opportunity or RP. It does not require a second target or borrow the bonding hour's touch-range requirement; actual owner capacity and uninterrupted work remain mandatory. At completion restore the same living animal's saved ordinary profile with the existing positive-current-HP ratio conversion, preserving its current conditions, injuries and actual custody without healing or refilling it. End the outgoing bond's control entitlement and unexecuted commands; preserve all already-spent body/actor allowances. No automatic transfer of custody or command occurs. Record this end for the post-ending Long-Rest gate. A creature cannot simultaneously have this and a Ranger bond, or two owners' Animal Companion bonds. NEW ACQ-05 correction of 'new paid acquisition': a transfer requires the outgoing bond to end through its actual lawful release/death/termination procedure, real lawful access/custody for the receiver, and the receiver's independently authorized new bond. An existing Animal Companion feat owner does not buy that nonrepeatable feat again; they spend their own available attempt and full hour and satisfy their own post-ending Long-Rest gate, if any. The sender's rest, feat ownership or spent attempt neither transfers nor resets the receiver's history. A receiver without this feat must first acquire it through their own actual eligible unspent opportunity, or use an independently acquired receiving engine; receiving the animal grants no feat or class feature. An actual Ranger Beast Companion route retains its own acquired Warder/class-level/selection gates, eligible-beast limits, 4 RP, one-hour touch procedure, once-per-beneficial-owner-Long-Rest allowance and native profile/lifecycle. This feat's no-RP route, release hour and attempt rules do not waive or redefine that class engine. A Ranger bond cannot be ended by invoking another engine's feat-release permission. No universal transfer payment, new animal, healing, additive chassis, second controller, extra phase or refunded body/resource budget is granted. Owner death ends the bond and, if the animal remains alive, restores its saved ordinary profile using the same positive-HP ratio conversion as release; a dead animal remains its actual corpse. Temporary owner incapacity prevents new commands but does not cancel a previously committed legal command; after that command, uncommanded phases remain defensive. This never supplies autonomous attacks.

A body fitting both roles elects one compatible route before that round’s work, preserves all already-spent allowances and cannot switch routes to gain a second phase. Its actual load, tack, rider geometry, mounting/dismounting cost and ordinary independent temperament remain. One shared Bonus Action command and one offensive companion action per owner per numbered round apply where those source engines impose them. This feat supplies no blanket override of a specific engine’s attack or no-resource restrictions.

The feat’s0HP-death rule applies only to this feat chassis; an independently governed mount/Ranger chassis retains its own rules rather than taking both.

sourceObject.effect: Enemies do not gain advantage merely for flanking you, and you gain +1 AC against opportunity attacks.

originalSourceObject.description: A combatant reads pressure at the flank and shifts clear before an opening becomes a strike.
originalSourceObject.effect: Enemies do not gain advantage merely for flanking you, and you gain +1 AC against opportunity attacks.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At total level5, opponents receive no attack advantage against you merely because they flank you. Current reviewed combat supplies no universal flanking advantage, and the proposed Tactical Flanker geometry grants only its explicit damage rider; this protection creates no penalty for other defenders and does not erase that separate damage rider. Any independently sourced flanking-advantage rule is suppressed only as an advantage source against you; other advantage still works and ordinary cancellation applies. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain advantage on CON saves specifically to maintain actual spell concentration, including concentration holding a readied spell. Other CON saves, nonspell concentration and generic Strain/Wounds gain nothing. War Caster's same advantage does not add another die; actual disadvantage cancels normally. When an actual opportunity-attack trigger would let you spend Reaction against one creature, you may instead cast one legally available Action-time spell whose actual target selection is exactly that creature. NEW any accessible rank is permitted, with no other creature/object target, area, self-only effect, long casting time, BA or Reaction spell. Recheck spell range/line/perception at the opportunity window; original movement-trigger timing remains before exit. The spell retains its own attack/save, actual casting route/rank/RP or charge, components/hands/focus, concentration, Dissonance/Refrain and cast interruption. The spell resolves instead of the weapon attack and spends the same Reaction; no spell knowledge or cost waiver. For Sentinel and Battle Awareness it is a spell substitution, not an actual opportunity attack hit, so those weapon-attack event benefits do not automatically transfer.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: BA: choose one other willing ally within30ft that can perceive and understand your brief audible or visible direction. NEW gain advantage on its next attack roll before your next original regular start; the first attack consumes it whether hit or miss, with no replacement if disadvantage cancels it. One recipient per activation, no extra attack or forced action. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Requires the exact Alertness feat. NEW blindsense10ft is nonvisual location awareness: while conscious you pinpoint actual creature locations within10ft and line of effect, excluding total cover and explicit anti-detection blockers. It is not blindsight and does not meet can-see requirements, read objects/text, reveal type or identify illusions without an actual body. Hearing is not required under this explicit feat-only sense proposal. Actual Hidden location ends for you within that range, with Invisible's current known-position exception but unrelated darkness/unseen modifiers retained. While conscious, surprise restrictions are suppressed as in Alert; no extra actions or previous-turn recovery. Blind Fight may supply a broader30ft location sense independently, but no addition of their ranges and no promotion to sight.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW gain3luck points, initially full and restored to3 only on a completedLR; no overcap or conversion. On your own attack, ability/skill/tool check or save, after the initial d20 die/dice are visible but before the outcome and consequences are declared, spend at most1point to roll one additionald20. Choose either to keep the original dice unchanged or to replace one original die with the new face; then apply the roll's original normal/advantage/disadvantage selection over its original one/two positions. The added die is not a third freely best-kept die under disadvantage. Actual natural face is the final kept face; no source allows inventing an automatic result. It may affect an opposed check or death save because those are your checks/saves; it cannot reroll an enemy, a damage die, a flat result or a no-roll automatic failure. NEW one Lucky intervention per underlying roll event even if another rule later rerolls it. Resolve Elven Accuracy on initial eligible dice first, then Lucky; Elven Accuracy cannot reroll the added Lucky die. Other mandatory whole-roll replacements preserve their own order and consume the same event entitlement.

originalSourceObject.name: Mage Slayer
originalSourceObject.description: You have practiced techniques for fighting spellcasters.
originalSourceObject.effect: When a creature within 5 feet casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When a creature within5ft actually casts a spell and you can perceive the casting event, you may spendReaction for one legal melee weapon attack against it. NEW this reaction occurs after that spell fully resolves or is negated, not in its interruption window. Range/reach/line/perception and your capability must still hold at reaction resolution. A caster that teleports away, becomes untargetable, incapacitates you, or kills you can leave no legal attack. V/S or another actually perceptible magical cue can reveal casting; no automatic detection of fully imperceptible casting is granted. Reaction spells qualify as real casts, but the attack does not itself repeat casting or grant a newReaction. Readied spells trigger at actual preparation/casting, not a second time on held release. A damaging hit can cause ordinary concentration consequences afterward but does not retroactively negate the completed spell. No generic spell-save advantage or concentration disadvantage.

It suppresses only those creatures' opportunity attacks, not other Reactions or later-turn attacks. No Dash terrain immunity or teleport.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: While you are actually legally mounted, gain advantage on your melee attack rolls against creatures that are unmounted and smaller than the actual ridden mount at resolution. Other disadvantage cancels normally. This grants no mount, proficiency/control, target redirection, mount save evasion, immunity, extra action or shared turn. originalSourceObject.name: Savage Attacker
originalSourceObject.description: You fight with primal ferocity.
originalSourceObject.effect: Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the damage dice and use either total.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once per turn when you roll damage for your actual melee weapon attack, after seeing that roll but before consequences, reroll the entire eligible native weapon-dice pool once and choose either the complete original total or complete new total. NEW eligible pool includes base weapon dice, their critical copies and expressly additional weapon dice from feats such as Draw Cut, Orcish Fury or Piercer; exclude separate spell/Smite/poison/elemental rider dice and flat modifiers. Preserve each die's native type and apply the chosen corresponding per-type totals, not a pooled total reassigned to a preferred type. Never mix the best die from each pool or reroll only unfavorable dice through this feature. Roll once for each original die identity in the chosen pool, not new attacks or damage events. Maximized/fixed numeric damage has no rolled pool to reroll. Resolve Savage Attacker before Piercer's one-die adjustment if both are used; after selecting a pool you cannot return to a discarded pool to optimize a later modifier. Own and off-turn regular-turn allowances follow the shared cadence.

originalSourceObject.name: Sentinel
originalSourceObject.description: You excel at locking down enemies.
originalSourceObject.effect: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the creature's speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: When your actual opportunity attack hits a creature, set all its current Speed modes to0 for the rest of the actual turn containing that event. NEW the endpoint is that enclosing turn's end, including an actual extra-turn end, not the target's next future turn; outside initiative use the remainder of the current6second interval. The hit qualifies even if damage is0. This overrides ordinary positive Speed additions during the interval and preserves spent movement cost; ending it restores otherwise-current Speed without refunding cost. It stops subsequent voluntary Speed expenditure, but not independently legal forced movement or teleport. A flying creature withSpeed0 follows existing Falling/hover/support rules, not immediate invented fall damage. Disengage still prevents the opportunity trigger. A Reaction attack that is not an opportunity attack, or Combat Casting's replacement spell, does not qualify. No ally-attack trigger, extraReaction or bypass of condition defenses is granted.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: You may attempt Hide when only lightly obscured, provided an actual source of light obscuration affects that observer's view; use the normal observer-specific Stealth/passive procedure. This is an express permission to try, not automatic Hidden, invisibility or an ability to hide in plainly unobscured sight. When your ranged-class weapon attack misses, suppress the ordinary attack-rule automatic position reveal caused by that missed shot for observers from whom you were Hidden. Do not end your Hidden record merely for the shot's normal firing noise/trajectory. NEW independent clear observation, a successful Search, movement into unobscured sight, communication revealing your position or another actual disclosure can still locate you; they are not negated by missing. A hit reveals normally. Spell misses and thrown melee-class weapons are outside this ranged-weapon clause. It neither improves vision in darkness nor suppresses all evidence permanently.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require the exact Animal Companion feat OR actual Animal Handling proficiency. Your genuinely bound/tamed Beast companions under your lawful current command gain+2 to their attack rolls and+2flat once per native attack damage roll, not per die/type or critical doubling. NEW no benefit to an ordinary allied Beast, non-Beast construct/undead/familiar, or a body you have no actual companion/control relation with. Original source-owner stats remain; add this feat layer once across overlapping trainers. For real tracking checks, if you are proficient in Survival, the companion uses its ownWIS plus your currentPB as the inherited proficiency contribution; expertise is not inherited, and a better real own contribution can replace it, not add twice. If you lack Survival proficiency, nothing is inherited. During your regular turn spend the sharedBAcommand within60ft to one companion that can hear you, selecting attack, Dash, Disengage or Help. At total level10+, the same command can name two audible owned companions taking that same action in their attached phases. This changes command recipient count only: one shared offensive companion action per owner numbered round remains. For attack, designate at most one to spend that offense; the other may move defensively and Dodge, not bank an attack. Two pure support actions can both resolve if legal. Command fails without refund if eligibility is lost; no extra independent turns/Reactions. When one of your actually commanded Beast companions reduces a meaningful hostile from positiveHP to0, you gain one advantage entitlement for your next attack against a creature within30ft of you before your next future regular end. NEW only an attack meeting30ft consumes it; a farther attack does not. Same-family reapplication refreshes one entitlement/deadline, never queues multiple. Death is not required, source floors/copy/no-reward restrictions apply.

Define actual moonlight/transformed condition for+2initiative and once-Short-Rest free howl/roar, own/off-turn timing, audible30ft allies, eligible tracked/damaged foe and advantage expiration. No new transformation, compulsory ally attack or cosmology/astronomy decision.

originalSourceObject.name: Primal Instinct
originalSourceObject.description: The beast inside listens before the mind does. You trust that older voice. Prestige lineage: Mooncursed. completed from the existing development record.)
originalSourceObject.effect: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or smell. You cannot be surprised while conscious. You can track creatures across difficult terrain without penalty. Under moonlight or while transformed, you gain +2 to initiative and once per short rest you may howl or roar as a free action: allies within 30 feet who can hear you gain advantage on their next attack against a creature you are tracking or have damaged this encounter.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.
originalSourceObject.legacyEffect: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or smell. You cannot be surprised while conscious. You can track creatures across difficult terrain without penalty. Under moonlight or while transformed, you gain +2 to initiative and once per short rest you may howl or roar as a free action: allies within 30 feet who can hear you gain advantage on their next attack against a creature you are tracking or have damaged this encounter.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Gain advantage on actualWIS Perception checks relying on working hearing or smell, without a passive±5 adjustment. While conscious, surprise restrictions are suppressed as in Alert, with no retroactive actions. When actually tracking a real trail, ignore penalties caused solely by difficult terrain; preserve absent evidence, concealment, age, weather and source-specific no-trace restrictions. NEW the moonlight/transformed clause qualifies both the+2initiative and howl: at the actual initiative roll, if physically illuminated by real existing moonlight or in an actual body-transforming form, add2. It does not establish an astronomical calendar, count a moon-themed spell as moonlight, or treat an illusion/disguise as body transformation. Once perSR while that predicate holds, on your own regular turn without an Action cost, audibly howl/roar and choose one actual creature you are currently tracking through a legal source or personally damaged during this encounter. Other allies within30ft who hear at the moment gain advantage on their next attack against that chosen creature before your next future regular end. NEW recipient list and target are fixed, no continuing range tether and no extra attack; one family entitlement per ally, consumed by its first eligible attack hit/miss/cancellation. The body must actually be able to howl or roar; articulated speech or a shared language is not required. Silence or an anatomy unable to make that sound prevents it. Conditions otherwise permit this brief free communication but do not grantActions. Tracking alone does not reveal a target's present location for an attack.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Actual hearing/smell, terrain-only tracking relief, literal moonlight/body-change predicate and complete free-own-turnSR howl contract.
submittedWorkedCases: A transformed owner howls on its turn for a foe it actually damaged; hearing allies receive one next-attack advantage through the owner's next regular end.
A moon-painted lantern is not actual moonlight. The feat creates neither transformation access nor current location knowledge from an old trail.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep actual source ally wording including self, with original target/sensory/budget conditions; no generalized automatic self-target for inherently two-person effects.

sourceObject.description: Your magical abilities resonate with ambient magical energy.

records.originalQuestion: Define ranked-spell recovery against the actual shared RP engine: recoverable amount, paid-cost ceiling, timing, natural20 attack eligibility, attack type, frequency and rest/event ledger. Preserve the level3 gate and avoid unlimited RP from harmless attacks, cantrips, extra attacks or repeated/copied results. No spell-slot system is inferred.

originalSourceObject.name: Arcane Resonance
originalSourceObject.description: Your magical abilities resonate with ambient magical energy.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Keep spellcasting ability and total character level3. NEW finite recovery interpretation: once per beneficial Long Rest, after your own genuine attack resolves with a kept natural20, recover up to2RP into an existing actual pool, capped by missing RP and an eligible previously paid rank1 spell cost from this same rest epoch. Choose one committed rank1 cast receipt that actually spent RP before this attack and still has at least1unrecovered paid RP. Refund at most the lesser of2, its remaining paid amount and missing pool capacity; mark exactly that paid amount recovered so it cannot fund this feat again or a second refund of the same expense. A discounted1RP cast funds at most1; a free innate cast funds0. You may decline and keep the use; a declaration with no eligible paid receipt or no missing capacity is ineligible.

The qualifying attack may be a weapon or spell attack, including a genuine cantrip attack, but must be yours against a conscious, independently acting actual hostile opponent presenting a real encounter threat. NEW anti-farming exclusions: no object, self, willing training partner, compliant captive, your own controlled/summoned creature, copied/reflected roll or fabricated repeat of a natural20. A legitimate hostile opponent’s immunity does not erase its actual natural20 attack trigger; damage is not a printed requirement. An expanded critical on19, automatic hit, hypothetical die or replaced natural20 that was not kept does not qualify. Companions using your spell attack bonus are still different attackers. Resolve any triggering attack’s consequences first; recovery cannot retroactively pay an unaffordable cast or prevent that event’s death. No spell slot or “ranked recovery” pool is created.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: One LR use;2RP/actual unrecovered rank1-cost ceiling; legitimate personal natural20 trigger and finite expense ledger.
submittedWorkedCases: You paid1RP for a legal discounted rank1cast and later roll a kept natural20 against an active hostile foe. With3RP missing, this feat can restore only1RP and spends its use, not2.
After using the feat, additional natural20cantrip attacks recover nothing until the next beneficial Long Rest. Attacking your own familiar cannot trigger it even while the use is available.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Retain WIS17 and total character level15. NEW mechanical grant interface only: acquire one feat-scoped Astral Projection entitlement at its named rank9, using WIS, with one charge per beneficial Long Rest and no ordinary class-level17 prerequisite for this specific grant. It grants no ordinary rank9 repertoire or class advancement. Once the named spell has its own complete approved payload, apply that payload’s exact action, components, target eligibility, costs other than normal rank price, concentration, interruption and ending, using the shared feat casting route. The rank9 feat cast would build base2Dissonance plus actual Refrain and is blocked at its actual Limit+6. Reserve the charge at legal cast start; an interrupted legal cast does not refund it. Before the deferred payload is authored and reviewed there is no legal activation, no charge payment and no invented destination, projection body, soul rule or plane access. This grant record is not full-feat readiness and remains a post-push dependency.

Keep verbal components, priced/consumed materials, focus eligibility, nonproficient-armor costs and genuine hand availability separate. Do not import unprinted War Caster reaction-spell benefits.

originalSourceObject.name: Battle Mage
originalSourceObject.description: You blend magic and martial combat.
originalSourceObject.prerequisite: Spellcasting ability, proficiency with martial weapons
originalSourceObject.effect: You can cast spells with somatic components while holding weapons and shields.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual personal spellcasting and a genuine martial-weapon proficiency grant; NEW one specified martial weapon proficiency is sufficient, without inventing proficiency with all martial weapons. For a spell you personally cast, one hand otherwise legally holding a weapon or shield may perform that spell’s S gestures while retaining that object. The hand and limb must still be capable of the required motion; restraints, missing anatomy or a feature explicitly forbidding gestures are not bypassed. NEW a buckler-occupied hand can use this same narrow S exception despite its ordinary lack of a free S hand. This gives no extra hands for loading, material manipulation, grappling, tools or wielding. A two-handed weapon can be held through the gestures, but its actual attack still requires its normal grip. F must independently be supplied by a legal focus; holding a sword does not make it a focus. V, priced/consumed materials, actual source access and nonproficient armor casting/concentration consequences remain. No advantage on concentration or Reaction spell is granted by this feat.

submittedWorkedCases: A caster with an actual martial sword proficiency holds sword and shield and can supply S through one hand under this feat. A spell also requiring F still needs an independently legal focus arrangement.
Binding both hands so gestures cannot be made still prevents S. The feat does not remove a nonproficient armor RP surcharge or concentration disadvantage.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual access to the exact ordinary Dispel Magic spell. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Retain CHA15 and an actual already established worship-of-a-deity credential without selecting a new deity or interpreting doctrine here. NEW once per beneficial Long Rest, after your own actual saving throw or ability check is called for, or after its result is known but before its consequences commit, declare this feat to replace that one outcome with ordinary Success. No Action, component or new roll is required; it can protect a living incapacitated creature making an actual save, including a death save. It cannot act after death or reverse committed harm. Fixed-DC task outcome becomes Success, not Critical Success; saves become successful without a natural face or a success-by-margin value. A death save gains one ordinary success, not natural20healing. For a genuinely authorized crafting completion check, this means Standard success in that craft procedure, retaining all work/material/access requirements and any independently reviewed quality adjustment.

For your side of an actual opposed ability check, NEW it wins against an ordinary rolled opponent regardless of total. If both sides commit an explicit automatic-success effect to the same opposition, resolve their incompatible claims by preserving the existing state, as with the Core initiating-tie rule; no retroactive transfer of an already resolved result. This declared conflict rule needs joint review. The feat does not create an ability check when none is allowed, overcome physical impossibility, convert an attack into a check, grant NPC consent outside a legitimately established social success outcome, or grant knowledge unavailable to the legal task. Only one check/save is affected; another save from the same damage event remains separate. Other outcome-triggered rules see ordinary Success, no natural20/1 and no invented numerical margin.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At total character level5or later choose acid,cold,fire,lightning or thunder permanently. NEW the source is not restricted to spells: your actual personally caused damage of that type qualifies, including a legal weapon elemental component and an attributable deployed trap, but not a companion’s separate attack, another operator’s damage, reflected/copied damage or a resource/HP payment. For each genuine damage event, total the chosen-type components after normal dice/critical resolution and eligible flat bonuses but before percentage bonuses/target defenses. Add floor(that total×10/100) damage of the same type once to that event. Where another genuine percentage feat also applies, both calculate from the same pre-percentage baseline in their actual scopes; neither compounds the other’s bonus. A shared area damage result supplies the same base to each legitimate target’s event and defenses, not a multiplied total based on target count. Distinct actual repeated hits/ticks may each qualify; replaying one event or splitting one component cannot generate another bonus. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:

originalSourceObject.name: Enchantment Focus
originalSourceObject.description: Your enchantment spells are more effective.
originalSourceObject.effect: Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against your enchantment spells.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual access to a spell cast through an Enchantment placement. Creatures have disadvantage on actual saving throws against spells you personally cast through their Enchantment school/mode. NEW this includes initial and later repeat saves belonging to that same Enchantment cast, for its actual duration; it includes a qualifying spell-cast item/feat route whose actual recorded school is Enchantment. A same-name Illusion or Universal placement is not Enchantment merely because another class has that school. Apply ordinary advantage/disadvantage cancellation, not an extra die per feat or repeated disadvantage. Actual control immunity, target restrictions, voluntary-save rules, information protection and automatic ending remain. A separate CONconcentration save caused by an Enchantment spell’s damage is a save to maintain the target’s own concentration, not a save against your spell, and receives no disadvantage from this feat. Ability checks, opposed social rolls and nonspell class techniques are outside its scope.

sourceObject.name: Metamagic Adept
sourceObject.description: You have learned to modify your spells in subtle ways.
sourceObject.effect: Learn 2 metamagic options, gain 2 sorcery points

records.originalQuestion: Preserve two selected metamagic options and two sorcery points, but neither a point-to-RP exchange nor an imported external option list is authorized. Compare the complete provisional Mage Metaspell Access card; explicitly resolve feat option identities, costs, recovery, timing and combining modes. A matching metamagic tag does not grant class acquisition or convert one-per-rest uses into points.

originalSourceObject.name: Metamagic Adept
originalSourceObject.description: You have learned to modify your spells in subtle ways.
originalSourceObject.effect: Learn 2 metamagic options, gain 2 sorcery points

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Keep personal spellcasting and total character level4. NEW grant a separate pool of two feat sorcery points, maximum2, initially full and restored to2only by a beneficial Long Rest. There is no RP/RC/HP/charge exchange, class-resource conversion, overcap or refill from ordinary spell refunds. At acquisition permanently choose two distinct modes from the finite three-mode menu below, based explicitly on the actual Mage Metaspell Access card; this does not acquire that Mage card or its Long-Rest use.

Reach: spend1point when committing a personal spell cast to add30feet to its finite positive numeric casting range. Self,Touch,unlimited and a separate effect/command radius do not gain range. Widen: spend1point at commitment to add5feet to one circular/spherical area radius or one cone length of that actual spell; choose the one eligible dimension in advance, not all independent areas/parameters. It does not create an area on a single-target spell. Sculpt: spend1point at commitment to choose up to max(1,actual casting ability modifier) eligible creatures in that spell’s initial area; they automatically succeed on its initial save and take no damage if that success would normally halve damage. Their later saves/ticks and nondamage successful-save consequences follow the original spell; there is no permanent friendly-fire immunity.

NEW one metamagic mode total per cast across this feat and Mage Metaspell Access; declare which actual source pays. You cannot use two points for two modes or duplicate a class mode on the same cast. Other separately applicable feats keep their exact scopes. Spell Sniper doubles the printed numeric range first, then Reach adds30; it does not double Reach’s30. The chosen mode adds no spell rank, RPdiscount, Action, concentration slot or second cast. Commit the point with the legal spell; a later miss, save, counter or interruption refunds neither. Illegal mode/target declarations spend nothing. The spell still needs all its own resources, components and access.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: 2-point LRpool; two permanent choices from actual three-mode comparison;1point/cast and one mode across class/feat; precise timing/range order.
submittedWorkedCases: A caster with Reach and Sculpt spends1point to extend a60-foot ranged spell to90feet. If Spell Sniper legally applies too, range is150feet:120from doubled printed range plus30.
After spending its second point, the caster cannot convertRPinto more sorcery points. Having the Mage card’s own use does not allow an additional mode on a cast already modified through this feat.

This new tag is a separate candidate overlay and needs joint approval, including its effect on the actual Wizard Ritual Casting feature. It changes neither those spell effects nor their ordinary class membership.

NEW feat learning route: with an actual complete legitimate formula/text or a willing qualified teacher who genuinely knows the exact ritual, spend8active hours per rank and10gp per rank of real practice/writing materials to record it in your actual usable ritual book. FT84 source-follow-through selection (proposed; the following explicit interaction controls only this named composition):
FT84-Q01 / FT84-WRITTEN-RITUAL-01 — scoped selection for Ritual Caster learning and Spell Scribe.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: the actual Ritual Caster written-learning route is an authorized spell-copying procedure when the learner personally uses an already complete, legitimately accessible written version of the exact eligible ritual, can actually use its language/notation, and records the learned ritual in the learner's real usable ritual book. The written source must supply the complete instruction, not merely a title, unfinished notes or text whose missing content must be taught. This predicate is about how the real work is done; the presence of a tutor does not disqualify otherwise genuine written copying, and writing lecture notes does not convert teacher-led learning into copying.
For that written-copy work, an actually acquired Spell Scribe halves the ordinary eight-active-hours-per-rank learning requirement; take the strongest eligible time factor once, then apply Spell Scribe's final whole-minute upward rounding. A current rank-one ritual therefore requires 240 active minutes. Retain every completed 15-minute learning phase and its governing interruption/final-remainder rule. No reading, comprehension, recording, rank, tag, consent, facility, tool or source requirement disappears. Diligent Researcher, Craftsman, Quick Ritualist and Ritual Channeler do not reduce this learning transaction. No new starting ritual or physical book, Wizard spellbook entitlement, ordinary scroll-production permission, check, trade XP or automatic class acquisition is granted.
Teacher-led learning without the qualifying complete written source remains 480 active minutes per rank. A later lawful switch to written-copy work can affect only actually remaining unworked learning at a completed phase boundary; log the old and new basis and retain all actual time/materials. Do not retroactively relabel completed teaching or an interrupted uncredited segment as discounted copying. Only one route credits each actual minute. Wizard Spell Scribing keeps its own legal-found-Wizard-spell/spellbook predicate and its own bill; merely being a Wizard or having the same physical book does not substitute its class route for this feat route. When two reductions genuinely cover the same procedure and material category, take the strongest once, not their product.
NEW LIMITED BILL COMPLETION: before claiming a material reduction, record the real ten-gp-per-rank practice/writing bill as actual stock quantities and identified categories; it is not a new currency-only substitute for materials. Ordinary blank writing stock, ordinary nonrare ink and ordinary practice supplies are discountable only when their actual source/provider identifies them as such. Rare inks and unique or specifically required components remain full quantity; copying rights, instructor/facility services, reusable tools and the separate blank book are not made discountable by calling them consumables. There is no universal numeric split of the ten gp. A stated mixed bill must retain its undiscounted total and each actual lot's identity, availability and legal precision. Apply Spell Scribe's 3/4 mundane factor separately from time; preserve divisible quantities, ceil required indivisible units once, and ceil the final actual purchase once to copper. Known protected items remain unchanged.
An unitemized or ambiguous bill has no justified material discount. The otherwise legal learner may still use the qualifying half-time route and supply the complete genuine undiscounted materials/bill; missing classification does not ban copying or its independent time benefit. Missing actual required materials still prevents work. No guessed rarity classification, refund for supplies already used, duplication of the source, free rare ink or teaching-cost waiver follows. Real consumption, deterioration and fees are recorded as they occur; interruption loses only its actual phase credit and actual resources, never refills stock.

sourceObject.name: Spell Echo Chamber
sourceObject.description: Your spells can affect a wider area through magical resonance.
sourceObject.effect: Next spell affects area twice

records.originalQuestion: The source only states next spell affects area twice. Define activation, cost, cadence, duration/expiry, qualifying area spell, two areas versus two resolutions, placement/overlap, saves/damage/control/concentration and delayed packets as explicit NEW decisions. Compare pending Echo Spell without adopting its half-effect rule by name.

sourceDirection.name: Spell Echo Chamber
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: The source only states next spell affects area twice. Define activation, cost, cadence, duration/expiry, qualifying area spell, two areas versus two resolutions, placement/overlap, saves/damage/control/concentration and delayed packets as explicit NEW decisions. Compare pending Echo Spell without adopting its half-effect rule by name.

originalSourceObject.name: Spell Echo Chamber
originalSourceObject.description: Your spells can affect a wider area through magical resonance.
originalSourceObject.effect: Next spell affects area twice

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Keep total character level10. The original sentence “Next spell affects area twice” has no complete trigger,budget or geometry, so all following limits are NEW. Once per beneficial Long Rest, use a Bonus Action to prime one Echo Chamber for one minute. It applies to the next eligible spell you legally commit in that interval; a spell with no qualifying area does not consume the priming but the clock continues. Repriming is impossible until the use returns. An eligible spell directly establishes a finite,explicit cone,line,cube,circle or sphere of spell effects, instantaneous or sustained; it does not create extra creatures,objects,portals,physical inventory or paid item bodies merely because their spell has a listed area. A solely single-target,touch-only or indeterminate-area spell is ineligible.

At that eligible cast’s commitment, declare two full placements of the same actual area geometry, each independently legal under the original casting range/origin/line rules. Self-origin cones/lines must both originate at the actual caster; choose their separate orientations, not a second caster. A self-centered emanation retains its one actual center, so a coincident duplicate grants no wider footprint. A point-area spell may use two legal points. Spend only the spell’s ordinary cast costs, with one Dissonance/Refrain update, interruption window and concentration obligation; the feat use was already spent at priming and its prime is consumed at commitment even if countered.

Both placements have full native size/effect; NEW a creature or physical target included by both is resolved only once for each actual native spell trigger event. Roll shared native damage once for the combined simultaneous application, then resolve each distinct target’s save/defenses. No overlapping double damage, duplicate save or control record. For sustained zones, keep one actual spell identity and its existing per-target trigger budget across both areas; moving through both cannot reset a same-turn/round/cast allowance. Later pulses occur at the original spell’s real deadlines, and a genuine different native trigger remains distinct only where the original card already permits it. Concentration loss or ordinary ending ends both. If the source allows one area-movement command, NEW move at most one placement with that one command, not both for free; each remains subject to all actual control ranges. A dispel selecting this single ongoing cast ends its whole duplicated area application unless the original spell explicitly defines independently separable effects. The feat adds no second spell, second payload budget or half-strength Echo Spell rule.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: BA/1LR/1-minute prime; two independently legal full areas; no overlap duplication and shared sustained-trigger identity.
submittedWorkedCases: A qualifying20-foot-radius spell is placed at two legal origins. A creature in both rolls its one native save and receives the shared damage result once; a creature only in the second is also a normal eligible target.

A sustained damaging area’s native once-per-turn entry limit remains one across both placements. Losing the one concentration ends both, and moving one area with an Action does not move the other for free.
sourceDirection.decision: Retain the MF-26 complete grant/procedure and boundaries. BA/1LR/1-minute prime; two independently legal full areas; no overlap duplication and shared sustained-trigger identity. Final named supplementary menus and shared spellcasting rules are part of this source decision; no pending payload or class is promoted.

sourceObject.name: Spell Penetration
sourceObject.description: Your spells are particularly effective against magical defenses.
sourceObject.effect: +2 bonus to spell attack rolls against targets with spell resistance

records.originalQuestion: Define an actual spell-resistance predicate from sourced mechanics, including the supplied Shaman Spell Resistance card, versus resistance to damage or save advantage. Preserve+2 to spell attack only, level5 and spellcasting; resolve target qualification and stacking without inventing a resistance stat or granting bypass.

sourceDirection.name: Spell Penetration
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Define an actual spell-resistance predicate from sourced mechanics, including the supplied Shaman Spell Resistance card, versus resistance to damage or save advantage. Preserve+2 to spell attack only, level5 and spellcasting; resolve target qualification and stacking without inventing a resistance stat or granting bypass.

originalSourceObject.name: Spell Penetration
originalSourceObject.description: Your spells are particularly effective against magical defenses.
originalSourceObject.effect: +2 bonus to spell attack rolls against targets with spell resistance

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Retain total character level5and actual personal spellcasting. NEW bounded target predicate: at the instant of your personal spell attack roll, the target must have a real currently active source explicitly named Spell Resistance or Magic Resistance, or a rule granting general advantage on saves against spells as a category. The supplied Shaman Bloodcaller Spell Resistance qualifies through its actual active save-advantage card; its lack of an attack-defense number does not erase the feat’s printed attack bonus. Specific fire resistance,highAC,cover,condition-only save advantage or War Caster’s concentration advantage does not qualify by itself. An inactive,suppressed or exhausted conditional defense does not qualify.

Against such a target, add+2to your genuine spell attack roll, once for this feat identity. This does not negate its defense,lowerAC,change saveDC,aid a Counterspell/Dispel ability check,turn a save into an attack or ignore immunity. A separately actual general flat spell-attack feat bonus can combine under the proposed feat family unless its own source says otherwise. Apply the predicate from real game state without giving the player an extra identification scan: the Director can adjudicate a hidden qualifying record without disclosing its name or inferential reason. Companion attacks merely using your spell attack modifier are not your personal spell attack for this feat.

submittedWorkedCases: A Shaman with active Spell Resistance is targeted by your actual spell attack. Add2to your attack; its ordinary save advantage remains relevant to other actual saves and is not removed.
A target resistant only tofire grants no Spell Penetration bonus. A Counterspell check against an actual spell from a resistant caster is still an ability check and gains no+2.

sourceObject.effect: When you cast a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, the spell's range is doubled.

originalSourceObject.name: Spell Sniper
originalSourceObject.description: You have learned techniques to enhance your spells.
originalSourceObject.prerequisite: Ability to cast at least one spell
originalSourceObject.effect: When you cast a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, the spell's range is doubled.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Require an actual acquired ability to cast a spell. When you personally cast a spell whose own procedure requires a ranged spell attack, double its finite positive printed casting range for that cast. NEW this is a casting-range modifier, not a doubling of radius,cone,length,speed,companion command range,secondary-target spacing or maintained-control distance. Self,Touch,unlimited and a creature’s independent ranged attack after summoning do not qualify. A spell requiring only a save or a melee spell attack does not qualify merely because its narration travels through the air. A spell granting a separate ordinary weapon attack is not converted into a ranged spell attack by this feat.

The actual target/origin must remain legal within that doubled casting range and under line,visibility and source exclusions. A spell with an independently stated shorter later control/attack distance retains that distance; this feat changes only its initial range. Use the actual chosen placement’s printed range, not the catalog’s maximum header from another mode. Apply the doubling once; proposed Metamagic Reach adds its30feet afterward. No cover ignoring,extra cantrip,expanded critical or generic accuracy bonus is granted.

Define an explicit shove action/target/range/size/ability/DC, push/pull distance, resistance and repeated-use cadence. No invisible hand, free attack or extra command budget inferred from outside rules.

originalSourceObject.name: Telekinetic
originalSourceObject.description: You have learned to move things with your mind.
originalSourceObject.effect: You learn the mage hand cantrip and can cast it without verbal or somatic components. You can use it to shove creatures.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Choose INT,WIS orCHA permanently for this feat. Learn the exact ordinary Mage Hand identity (`mage-hand`,Universal rank0), using a NEW feat route with that chosen casting ability. Waive only its V/Scomponents for casts through this feat; a genuinely added other requirement remains. It is a real cast with its actual Action,shared Refrain/strain and interruption eligibility; absence of V/Sdoes not itself grant invisibility or hide an observable manifestation. Keep the current LRXvisible hand,no creature/objectHP,concentration up to1minute,30-foot control range,10lb/1-foot-cube unattended-object capacity,10-foot movement per caster Action and cargo-release rules. It does not become the different Transmutation Magehand identity.

NEW explicit creature-shove exception: as the one manipulation of the creation Action or a later Action commanding this actual hand, you may move the hand up to its ordinary10feet along a visible unobstructed path and attempt to shove one visible Large-or-smaller creature within5feet of the hand and within30feet of you. The target makes STRsave against8+PB+your feat ability modifier. On failure choose before resolution to push it5feet directly away from you along a legal supported path, or knock itProne; on success neither. This replaces the ordinary physical opposed-Shove roll only for this feat; no body-size growth,damage,pull,grapple or extra attack. Actual forced-movement/Prone immunities and geometry apply. No free object manipulation accompanies the shove. Each attempt uses its own legal Action; extra Actions do not refresh other resources, and there is no Bonus Action or autonomous-hand turn. If range/path/concentration is lost, the hand cannot shove and its normal ending/release rules apply. It supplies no ordinary spell-component hand or attended-object theft.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Permanent feat ability; exact Mage Hand route with V/Swaiver; Action/STRsave/Large cap/5-foot push-or-Prone exception.
submittedWorkedCases: Creating the visible hand can include one legal shove attempt instead of lifting an object. The target passes itsSTRsave, so no movement orProne occurs; the casting Action and chronological strain record remain spent.

A later shove command is an Action using the existing hand, not another cast and not free telepathic manipulation. A creature beyond30feet cannot be shoved by claiming the hand has a separate unrestricted reach.
sourceDirection.decision: Retain the MF-29 complete grant/procedure and boundaries. Permanent feat ability; exact Mage Hand route with V/Swaiver; Action/STRsave/Large cap/5-foot push-or-Prone exception. Final named supplementary menus and shared spellcasting rules are part of this source decision; no pending payload or class is promoted.

records.name: Telepathic

sourceObject.name: Telepathic
sourceObject.description: You can reach out to others with your mind.
sourceObject.effect: You can communicate telepathically with creatures and cast detect thoughts once per long rest.

records.originalQuestion: No exact Detect Thoughts definition was found in the848 ordinary plus10 ancestry catalogs. Define telepathy range, willing/aware recipients, senses/languages, directionality and actions; separately resolve once-per-Long-Rest spell grant and actual dependency. Do not invent mind-reading content, a spell profile or creature cognition taxonomy from the feat name.

sourceDirection.name: Telepathic
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: No exact Detect Thoughts definition was found in the848 ordinary plus10 ancestry catalogs. originalSourceObject.name: Telepathic
originalSourceObject.description: You can reach out to others with your mind.
originalSourceObject.effect: You can communicate telepathically with creatures and cast detect thoughts once per long rest.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure:
Choose INT,WIS orCHA permanently as this feat’s casting ability. NEW communication procedure: while conscious, you may direct one brief intentional message at a time to one perceived willing conscious creature within60feet and line of effect, with the same ordinary conversational timing as speech and no extra Action. A willing recipient may reply through that same temporary channel while eligibility continues. Shared language permits normal phrases; absent a shared language, only a simple voluntarily conveyed image,emotion or basic idea is received, not automatic precise translation. The recipient may refuse or end the exchange; silence supplies no diagnosis of presence,thought,consent or mind protection. This grants no reading,compulsion,command authority,remote tracking,hidden-creature search or ability to use telepathy as a spell’s Vcomponent. Loss of range,line or consciousness ends the channel. It supplies no simultaneous group channel or extra reaction-time instructions beyond actual turn rules.

The named Detect Thoughts has no exact entry in the848ordinary plus10supplemental ancestry source catalogs. NEW proposed feat-only spell payload, explicitly not an alias for Read Surface Thoughts: rank2Divination,Action,V/S/F,one perceived creature within30feet and line of effect,concentration up to1minute. The feat gives one cast per beneficial Long Rest through the common charge route. At initial resolution and on a later Action spent on this one same target while it remains in range/line, request one sample and make a fresh targetWISsave against the featDC. A failed save reveals one actual current conscious surface thought under the already reviewed Read Surface Thoughts information limits; success reveals none. The initial cast Action includes at most one sample. No new sample occurs without its real Action, and repeated sampling does not recast or replay Dissonance. NEW the target becomes aware of an attempted mental intrusion at the first sample, regardless of its save, without automatically identifying a hidden caster.

An absent conscious thought,protection or failed information access supplies no reason-diagnosis; ordinary dreams are not conscious thoughts without a specific exception. Preserve verbal thoughts’ actual language and nonverbal impressions without inventing meaning. There is no memory search,truth enforcement,forced subject,biography,creature-type cognition assumption or automatic translation. Specific information protections,including actual Divination/Scrying protection,apply. No target switch within the one cast; loss of its range/line prevents sampling while the original deadline continues, and ending concentration ends the attempt. The new supplemental profile must be accepted/replaced by GPT before any use; it does not add ordinary class access or silently claim a missing original definition was recovered.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Finite consensual two-way communication; NEW isolated Detect Thoughts recurring surface-sample profile with actual saves,Actions,notification and information protections.
submittedWorkedCases: Two willing creatures sharing no language can exchange a simple image of an open door through the channel; this does not translate an unknown legal contract or read unspoken motives.

A legal Detect Thoughts cast is followed by two later sampling Actions. The target makes three distinct saves total; only actual failed samples expose the thought currently present then, and none compels it to think about the caster’s preferred question.
