records.name: War Caster

sourceObject.name: War Caster
sourceObject.description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat.
sourceObject.prerequisite: Ability to cast at least one spell
sourceObject.effect: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration on spells.

records.originalQuestion: Preserve its sole printed effect: advantage on Constitution saves maintaining concentration on spells. Bind current concentration/strain procedure, damage-event timing, normal advantage cancellation and nonproficient-armor disadvantage. Do not import somatic exceptions, reaction spells or nonspell concentration benefits.

sourceDirection.name: War Caster
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Preserve its sole printed effect: advantage on Constitution saves maintaining concentration on spells. Bind current concentration/strain procedure, damage-event timing, normal advantage cancellation and nonproficient-armor disadvantage. Do not import somatic exceptions, reaction spells or nonspell concentration benefits.

originalSourceObject.name: War Caster
originalSourceObject.description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat.
originalSourceObject.prerequisite: Ability to cast at least one spell
originalSourceObject.effect: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration on spells.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual acquired spellcasting. You have advantage on CONsaving throws whose actual purpose is maintaining concentration on a spell you are sustaining. This includes a real damage-triggered concentration save or another explicit CONsave to retain that spell, and no other roll merely because losing it might later break concentration. Use the existing damage-event timing and one-save procedure; temporaryHP absorption and actual damage consequences retain their governing definitions. Ordinary nonproficient-armor disadvantage or another actual disadvantage cancels the advantage normally; neither produces additional dice. A source-specific flat concentration bonus such as the proposed Resilient Mind applies separately if genuinely eligible under its own rule. WoundCONsaves,death saves,ordinary Strain/Exhaustion saves and nonspell concentration checks do not qualify simply because this creature also casts spells. The sole printed effect grants no occupied-hand Spermission,Reaction spell,reaction attack,automatic success or second concentration slot.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Exact concentration-spell CONpredicate, including actual disadvantage cancellation; no imported same-name extra clauses.
submittedWorkedCases: Damage causes one CONsave to maintain a real spell concentration. War Caster grants advantage, but nonproficient worn armor’s actual concentration disadvantage cancels it to one die.
The same damage event causes a WoundCONsave as well. That separate save gains no War Caster advantage, even if becoming incapacitated from its consequences would end concentration.

records.name: Arcane Armor

sourceObject.name: Arcane Armor
sourceObject.description: A caster reinforces their defenses with a brief arcane ward while shaping a spell.
sourceObject.effect: While you are casting or concentrating on a spell, gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws against reactions triggered by that casting.
sourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

records.originalQuestion: Resolve whether the reaction-trigger qualifier limits both AC and saves, or only saves, and what concentrating contributes after casting ends. Identify casting-triggered reactions, onset before interruption, exact expiry, stacking and level4 gate. Preserve inactive+5-percent legacy text without turning the ward into general resistance.

sourceDirection.name: Arcane Armor
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Resolve whether the reaction-trigger qualifier limits both AC and saves, or only saves, and what concentrating contributes after casting ends. Identify casting-triggered reactions, onset before interruption, exact expiry, stacking and level4 gate. Preserve inactive+5-percent legacy text without turning the ward into general resistance.

originalSourceObject.name: Arcane Armor
originalSourceObject.description: A caster reinforces their defenses with a brief arcane ward while shaping a spell.
originalSourceObject.effect: While you are casting or concentrating on a spell, gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws against reactions triggered by that casting.
originalSourceObject.source: Completed from the existing feat draft corpus on 2026-08-05; playable wording supplied, final balance pass still required.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require character level 4. NEW the qualifier governs BOTH+1 AC and+1 saving throws: they apply only against a Reaction whose actual printed trigger is your casting or continuing concentration on a spell. Begin eligibility at commitment of that cast, before interruption; end when its casting/held concentration/ordinary concentration ends. Merely attacking a concentrating caster is insufficient. The relevant Reaction must itself cause an attack against you or a save you make; Counterspell’s caster-side ability check is neither and receives no penalty. A triggered attack still uses ordinary critical rules. The bonus is passive, grants no Reaction, and cannot protect unrelated attacks or ongoing damage. Current same-stat bonus arbitration applies. Preserve the alternative broad AC reading and old 5% resistance as inactive source alternatives.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Both bonuses are narrowly trigger-qualified, including an expressly concentration-triggered Reaction; no general AC or resistance.
submittedWorkedCases: An actual on-cast Reaction attacks AC 14: eligible+1 makes AC 15, unless a stronger same-stat bonus already governs.
An enemy’s ordinary attack during your ongoing concentration receives no Arcane Armor modifier.
sourceDirection.decision: Adopt the narrow grammatical scope on both AC and saves: only casting-triggered Reactions, not all attacks during concentration; keep+1, not legacy percentage resistance.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: PB uses per completed LR; no mid-epoch refill fromPBgrowth. After one actual hostile spell event targeting/affecting you resolves, if you either succeeded on its real save OR received no positive resolved damage from that event, you may spend a Reaction/use to recover 1 RP up to your real maximum. NEW require meaningful unwilling opposition: harmless, allied, cooperative, self-authored or farming spells do not qualify. A spell attack that legally targeted you but missed, immunity, or complete prevention can satisfy the no-damage branch; temp HP absorption is damage and alone cannot. A failed save against a hostile nondamaging control spell still satisfies literal no-damage, but only if its result leaves you able to react. One grant per actual cast identity across later ticks/events; no fan-out or repeating-zone farm. Positive saved-against damage may qualify through success. Resolve full damage/control/death first; no ordinary Reaction at 0 HP. Decline before spending if noRPheadroom. This is recovery, not transfer from the attacker or a new pool.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Hostile-threat and one-cast identity bounds preserve both printed branches while blocking harmless farming.
submittedWorkedCases: Successful save halves a hostile spell to 5 damage: the success branch permits oneReaction for 1 RP.
A missed hostile spell attack can qualify; receiving a friendly harmless cantrip cannot.
sourceDirection.decision: Keep Reaction to an original hostile spell event with actual source conditions; actual Temp HP damage counts, and all source-specific no-resource flags remain.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At character level 12, gain advantage on actual saving throws against an effect that would banish, forcibly teleport or displace you between planes. Once LR, after such a save fails but before consequences, optionally replace that failure with success; use the source’s actual success outcome, which may retain other effects. No Action or Reaction is required. It does not create a save against a save-less effect, convert willing travel to hostility, anchor nearby creatures, reveal destinations or permit an otherwise illegal movement. A save against damage accompanying independent displacement qualifies only if that same save actually determines the unwanted displacement. Existing explicit unpreventable/no-replacement rules control. No permanent immunity or new cosmological fact is implied.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: For each actual illusory creature/object you personally create, the first attack or interaction that would end that particular illusion’s existence instead delays only that ending until the current actual turn ends. NEW outside initiative use the end of the current canonical six-second window. It remains nonphysical and observers retain information already obtained; known illusions do not regain concealment, cover, belief or control. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: For a spell you can actually cast through a legal ritual route, halve only the route’s additional ritual time, with resulting additional time at least 5 minutes; retain the base printed casting time in full. NEW measure the result in elapsed seconds and round up to the next whole second so fractions never shorten a required interval. An original 10 minute addition becomes 5 minutes, not half the whole cast. An original shorter addition is not increased: use min(original additional time, max(300, ceil(original/2))). This explicit non-worsening interpretation preserves the minimum for reductions without penalizing a preexisting faster route. Components, formula/repertoire, costs, concentration, helpers and interruptions remain. It grants no Ritual tag or access; the separate proposed Ritual Caster overlay needs its own approval. Apply this additional-time change before any separately legal group active-time adjustment, whose minimum rule remains.
sourceDirection.submittedNewChoices: Additional-time-only arithmetic, no worsening of already-shorter routes and second rounding.
submittedWorkedCases: A 1 Action base plus 10 minutes ritual addition becomes the same 1 Action base plus 5 minutes.
A source’s 2 minute special addition stays 2 minutes, and this feat creates no ritual permission.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW a group ritual is one actual legally available ritual spell with a designated lead and at least one physically present willing assistant continuously performing that same ritual’s active work; it is not simultaneous crafting, travel or independent casts. Use the exact source’s assistant qualifications/cap. If it supplies none, the proposed default assistant must know that ritual or have proficiency in the lead’s actual relevant Arcana/Religion/Nature skill; count at most two ordinary assistant contributions, with no numeric roll bonus when the source has no assistant benefit. This feat-holder contributes as two ordinary assistants within that cap, never as two leads or two physical bodies for a separate location requirement. One or more holders reduce the group’s total active casting time once by 25%, rounding up seconds; passive waiting is unchanged. NEW the double-assistant contribution applies only while actually serving as an assistant. A lead who owns this feat can supply the time reduction but cannot simultaneously count as two assistants; one person never performs both assigned jobs at once.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW select 15 ward HP over preserved 50. The feat has one armed grant per beneficial SR/LR; acquisition arms it. At the first real encounter start after arming, automatically create one personal runic ward with 15 points and spend that entitlement, even if surprised/incapacitated; a dead creature receives none. It persists between encounters until depleted or the next beneficial SR/LR, when any old ward ends and entitlement rearms for the next combat, not immediate refill in combat. Repeated initiative does not refill it. This is a distinct spell-only ward, not temp HP: after ordinary defenses and before temp HP, intercept up to its remaining points of actual incoming spell damage in stable component order. Nonspell damage bypasses it. Record ward absorption separately, excluded from actual damage received by the body, Wound/death thresholds and concentration checks; any surviving packet resolves once normally. No transfer, double ledger, HP healing, return on revival or resource proc from ward absorption. Counterspell/dispel cannot target this nonspell passive ward without explicit applicable source permission.

A sword’s 8 nonspell damage ignores the ward entirely; starting another encounter does not restore spent ward points.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Once LR, NEW spend a Reaction when a hostile pending spell has selected you as its sole creature target, after ordinary cast interruptions but before its attack/save/effect resolution. It must be an actual single-target payload, not one target remaining from an area or multi-target mode. Roll an unmodifiedd 20;16–20 redirects, preserving this explicit 25%procedure over legacy 10%. On success choose a different legal creature under the original spell’s actual target restrictions, range/line measured from the original origin, personally perceived by you where necessary; the original caster remains owner and supplies all stats/choices. Recheck legality, then use fresh original attack/save procedure against that new target; nothing resolves against you. If no legal new target exists, or on 1–15, the spell continues against you with advantage on each actual initial save it requires; no save is invented for an attack/automatic spell. FEAT335-COPY-RELEASE-SOURCE-01-ADDENDUM — controlling release completion.
NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Every paid feat-copy cast records `castFamilyKey = feat-copy::<canonicalSourceEffectId>`. `canonicalSourceEffectId` is the stable identity of the actually witnessed underlying spell/effect from which the bounded profile was captured; for a source-qualified monster ability use that ability's stable source identity. Changing the capture event, owner, Eldritch Echo/Mimicry/Arcane Adaptation permission, bounded profile, selected damage/type component, q, or qualifying casting-ability route does not create a new family. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.

NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. A concentration-required copy establishes the releaser's one concentration burden during casting commitment under the ordinary sequence, ending an incompatible existing concentration before the counter window. If that cast is later countered, prior concentration remains ended and no copied lasting effect remains. Loss of concentration ends the Ward/Hindrance/Boon copied effect immediately; their printed earlier deadlines still cap duration. Immediate profiles establish no new concentration burden. Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. No witnessed original concentration tag is inherited or used to change these seven profile tags.

COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. Use FS-09 exactly: base Dissonance 0 for q/rank 0, 1 for ranks 1-5, and 2 for ranks 6-9; apply ordinary same-family Refrain using CRS-01; and use `Limit = max(4, 2*PB + casting modifier)` for that copy route, including its existing surcharge/block thresholds. The owned route chosen to qualify the copy supplies only the permitted casting ability, rank ceiling and other expressly required source credentials; it does not import that class engine's protected Dissonance reduction, routing, vent, prepared-matrix treatment or proc chain into the feat-copy cast. In particular a Wizard-qualified copy is not a prepared matrix, a Shaman-qualified copy is not an ordinary Shaman spell for the totem vent, and a Mirrorsage-qualified copy is not class Echo Release. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.

FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-04 — NEW split command/phase completion. On the owner's regular turn, first establish a legal shared Bonus Action, an available owner/numbered-round offensive-companion allowance, and actual receipt of the required within-60-ft audible or visible command by each nominated participating plant. At that legal commitment spend the Bonus Action and that one shared offensive allowance once; record the owner, original regular-turn/round identity, participating plant IDs, one chosen mode and target or area, its permitted origin or nominated Lash origins, and the immediately following attached phase. This is a paid pending command, not a Readied action, independent plant turn or extra allowance. It need not be the owner's last voluntary decision that turn. Resolve it once in the attached phase after that same regular turn's actual end processing, using the preserved schedule; an extra turn neither advances nor duplicates that phase. Recheck the surviving unended, unsuppressed, otherwise capable participating plant and the mode's actual target/area, range, perception and line-of-effect requirements. For Lash, an independently legal surviving nominated origin may support the same selected target; losing the selected Spore/Entangle origin does not authorize another origin or mode. For an area, resolve its actual occupants at that phase. If the chosen outcome is no longer legal, close the pending command with no effect, no refund, no new target and no carry to a later phase. After actual receipt, later owner incapacity, Silence, loss of owner-to-plant sight/range/channel, or owner death alone does not retract that command: no continuous concentration/channel/consciousness requirement is added. These states can prevent a NEW command or personal creation/Bloom Burst. An effect expressly cancelling the pending command or disabling/ending its plant still controls. Once committed, no other companion or armed trap can spend the same owner-round allowance, and the phase does not spend it a second time.
KEEP the already-operative SUP-07 floraBody/dc acquisition requirement: at acquisition permanently select and record one actual possessed spellcasting route as this feat's DC provider. Use DC 8 + current PB + that route's current casting-ability modifier; do not invent Wisdom, Spellcraft or another default. This source choice is separate from the later seedling mode/burst-type choice. Ownership initializes only the finite creation allowance and body capacity, with no plant, pending additional creation, command or active effect. All printed acquisition predicates and the actual earned feat opportunity remain required.
FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-01 — KEEP acquisition-only provider selection. A valid paid Conjure Flora acquisition permanently binds its actual qualifying personal casting route and the ability operand supplied by that route. Later loss, expiry, retraining-away or temporary unavailability of that casting grant does not by itself remove Conjure Flora, reselect its provider, prohibit an otherwise legal Flora creation/command/Bloom Burst, terminate an existing seedling or disable an already armed entry trap. Current prepared repertoire, renewable casting charges and RP are not new ongoing Flora prerequisites. This does not qualify a NEW feat acquisition through a grant that is actually gone; ACQ-03 still governs that separate snapshot. Flora is a magical nonspell feat, not a cast through the provider: a spell-only prohibition applies only to its actual scope, Silence still blocks an audible command, and an effect actually suppressing this feat, a plant, its magic or the required action applies under that effect's own rule. NEW explicit lost-provider representation: retain the original provider/ability binding and compute Flora DC as 8 + the owner's current lawful PB + the current modifier of that bound ability; no alternative route, Wisdom default, reconstructed casting entitlement or favorable old ability score is substituted. A missing or invalid original acquisition/provider record is not cured by this rule. Completed results are not recalculated, and existing body HP/save snapshots, deadlines, spent uses and ownership are not reset.
FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-02–03 — NEW second-creation window completion. Each legally completed first creation records one original use ID, its first-plant ID and that plant's original minute deadline, with at most one additional creation unspent. This is a bounded open-use record even when the owner is below total level 10; it is not another rest use or an immediately usable creation at that level. Admit a second creation only while that same first plant remains present and unended, before its original deadline, with the additional creation unspent, current total character level at least 10, actual free plant capacity, and every ordinary Action, ground, range, line-of-effect and use predicate satisfied. The level-10 condition is live at the additional Action, not snapshotted at first creation. Genuine advancement during that open window can make the existing unspent permission usable, but creates no body, charge, healing or new window. Destruction, uprooting, Bloom Burst consumption, expiry or another actual ending of the first plant permanently closes any unused additional-creation permission immediately; its old future deadline does not keep that permission alive. Suppression without an actual ending is not by itself an ending. A legal additional creation consumes that one permission and costs its own Action, but no second rest use; its own minute begins at its own creation. Once the second plant exists, ending the first does not shorten the second's independent deadline. No ended plant, spent permission, missed deadline, level change, recovery, new ID or subsequent body can reopen the old use. A later beneficial rest restores only the ordinary creation allowance under FS-06; a later first creation starts a genuinely new use.
FEAT335-FLORA-SOURCE-CHECK-01 / FLQ-04 — NEW explicit owner/instance continuity. These particular one-minute, nonconcentration Flora bodies do not end merely because their owner is incapacitated or dies; retain the same owner, mode, actual body state, original deadline and no-resource restrictions. No recipient, ally, host, companion or replacement actor inherits control. A received pending command may resolve only at its already attached original phase under the split-command rule, even if the owner's live initiative slot is removed; preserve that one scheduled phase, not a new recurring independent turn. An already armed Trapcasting plant may perform its specified first-eligible-entry exception without a new owner Action/Reaction or remote command channel, even while its owner cannot act or is dead, but it still needs the actual qualifying entry, operative plant/trap, target legality and unspent same-owner numbered-round allowance. Incapacity/death neither refreshes that allowance nor rearms or moves the trap. Preserve the owner's last lawful PB/selected-ability state when its live actor view ends, applying any subsequently due source-defined changes; death is not a zero ability score, a new provider or a freeze of expiring modifiers. Use that continuing lawful record for later Flora DCs; a missing authoritative operand is an invalid/unestablished input, not permission to invent one. Lawful recovery continues the same history without replaying missed phases or refilling anything. Ending a generating plant still ends its own Poisoned/Restrained records immediately. A legally committed Bloom Burst binds its existing DC/type/area event, consumes its body before its one payload, and does not fail merely because that required consumption has occurred; it grants no other action to the ended body. Other independently applicable cancellation, suppression, condition, duration and target rules retain their own actual scope. No Animal Companion release/death rule or standard-companion movement/Dodge/attack is imported into these fixed Flora profiles.

FEAT335-COPY-RELEASE-SOURCE-01-ADDENDUM — controlling release completion.
NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Every paid feat-copy cast records `castFamilyKey = feat-copy::<canonicalSourceEffectId>`. `canonicalSourceEffectId` is the stable identity of the actually witnessed underlying spell/effect from which the bounded profile was captured; for a source-qualified monster ability use that ability's stable source identity. Changing the capture event, owner, Eldritch Echo/Mimicry/Arcane Adaptation permission, bounded profile, selected damage/type component, q, or qualifying casting-ability route does not create a new family. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.

NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. A concentration-required copy establishes the releaser's one concentration burden during casting commitment under the ordinary sequence, ending an incompatible existing concentration before the counter window. If that cast is later countered, prior concentration remains ended and no copied lasting effect remains. Loss of concentration ends the Ward/Hindrance/Boon copied effect immediately; their printed earlier deadlines still cap duration. Immediate profiles establish no new concentration burden. Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. No witnessed original concentration tag is inherited or used to change these seven profile tags.

COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. Use FS-09 exactly: base Dissonance 0 for q/rank 0, 1 for ranks 1-5, and 2 for ranks 6-9; apply ordinary same-family Refrain using CRS-01; and use `Limit = max(4, 2*PB + casting modifier)` for that copy route, including its existing surcharge/block thresholds. The owned route chosen to qualify the copy supplies only the permitted casting ability, rank ceiling and other expressly required source credentials; it does not import that class engine's protected Dissonance reduction, routing, vent, prepared-matrix treatment or proc chain into the feat-copy cast. In particular a Wizard-qualified copy is not a prepared matrix, a Shaman-qualified copy is not an ordinary Shaman spell for the totem vent, and a Mirrorsage-qualified copy is not class Echo Release. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.

Choose stat permanently at feat acquisition. Pay by ending that exact record before outcome; no refund or consumption of another source’s Bleed. Healing spends a NEW finite Hemocraft Reserve of 2×character level set only at beneficial LR, paying actual restored HP, no excess/copy/resource outputs. Reserve starts 0 on acquisition. No consuming historical/already-cured Bleed or staged victims. The record’s ordinary Medicine-ending DC is the same chosen feat DC; actual positive-potential magical healing ends eligible Bleed through the existing cure procedure.

sourceObject.name: Lightning Affinity
sourceObject.description: Storm-blood runs quiet in you until the sky asks it to speak. Prestige lineage: Storm Lord. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Spellcasting ability or proficiency in Nature
sourceObject.effect: You have resistance to lightning damage. Your lightning spells deal +1 damage per die and ignore half cover when the target is outdoors or under open sky. When you take lightning damage, you can use your reaction to store the excess (after resistance) as Storm Charge (max 2); spend 1 charge to add 1d6 lightning to your next spell or weapon attack before the end of your next turn.

FEAT335-COPY-RELEASE-SOURCE-01-ADDENDUM — controlling release completion.
NEW feat-copy chronological identity. Every paid feat-copy cast records `castFamilyKey = feat-copy::<canonicalSourceEffectId>`. `canonicalSourceEffectId` is the stable identity of the actually witnessed underlying spell/effect from which the bounded profile was captured; for a source-qualified monster ability use that ability's stable source identity. Changing the capture event, owner, Eldritch Echo/Mimicry/Arcane Adaptation permission, bounded profile, selected damage/type component, q, or qualifying casting-ability route does not create a new family. Copies sharing that key use the ordinary chronological Refrain history together. An ordinary cast of the underlying spell uses its ordinary spell family and does not share the feat-copy family; Mirrorsage Echo Release likewise keeps its own class family. A missing stable underlying source identity is ineligible for release rather than being assigned a favorable new key. This key grants no ordinary spell knowledge or access.

NEW feat-copy concentration tags. Strike: no. Burst: no. Mend: no. Ward: yes. Hindrance: yes. Boon: yes. Step: no; its movement/teleport resolves instantaneously. A concentration-required copy establishes the releaser's one concentration burden during casting commitment under the ordinary sequence, ending an incompatible existing concentration before the counter window. If that cast is later countered, prior concentration remains ended and no copied lasting effect remains. Loss of concentration ends the Ward/Hindrance/Boon copied effect immediately; their printed earlier deadlines still cap duration. Immediate profiles establish no new concentration burden. Ready is separate: preparation already occupies concentration. On release, an immediate profile resolves and that Ready concentration ends with the released spell; a concentration-required Ward/Hindrance/Boon continues on that same one concentration burden, never a second slot. COPY-ROUTE STRAIN SCOPE. A paid feat-copy cast under FS-08 is an independent feat-casting route for strain purposes. The ordinary `max(4, 2 + PB + max(0, modifier))` Limit in SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES remains controlling for ordinary class spells within its existing scope and is not globally changed here. If the only qualifying route is the feat-only Eldritch Blast grant, it supplies CHA and only its actual rank-0 ceiling; it does not change the copy engine or Limit, create a Warlock/class engine, or qualify a ranked q>0 copy.

COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 — owner-directed preparation-round-only successor for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles used through Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry. This supersedes COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01's both-touched-round policy only. All earlier archives and receipts retain their exact historical wording. This selection changes no profile payload, acquisition predicate, ordinary Ready rule, ordinary class casting cadence or unrelated Mirrorsage class Echo procedure.

PREPARATION. The shared feat-copy cap counts new paid feat-copy casting commitments: a direct cast commits in its current numbered round; a Readied feat copy commits in its preparation numbered round. Require and atomically spend that round's owner feat-copy allowance. If the owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds this feat copy, also require and spend that same preparation round's actual shared class allowance. A qualifying ability route alone never creates that engine. Validate the actual setup prerequisites first. At legal preparation commitment, pay the Action, current quote and other actual costs, consume the applicable permission/use once, provide components, record the independent feat-copy family/Dissonance/Refrain once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden before its single preparation counter window. No partial class/feat/resource debit is allowed. Countering, abandonment, replacement, expiry or concentration loss after commitment never refunds those preparation spends, recreates a capture, restores displaced concentration or reopens that round's allowance. Failed precommit validation spends nothing and cannot delete an existing valid hold.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID and actual owner to its fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, preparation-bound choices, paid transaction, consumed permission receipt, preparation round and actual ledger identities. Preserve its original Ready deadline and every independently applicable earlier source/capture/use deadline. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but the hold cannot extend the original permission window. No future round's allowance is reserved. The hold remains subject to ordinary concentration, body/source availability and valid replacement rules. Paid preparation alone creates no payload. Earlier prose calling the limit one-copy-release per round is controlled here: it limits new direct casts and Ready preparations, not a later completion of this same paid hold.

RELEASE. After an actual perceivable trigger has completed and before every governing deadline, validate the actual hold and its preparation receipts, the available lawful Reaction, continuing concentration and the release predicates at the points required by their actual sources. Select legal current targets/ordered recipients/area/destination at release under the fixed preparation profile and mode; do not freeze a setup-time ghost target or rewrite preparation-bound choices from hidden results. Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends a new feat-copy allowance or a new Mirrorsage shared-release allowance. The preparation receipts remain spent in their original round. An otherwise lawful delayed release therefore remains eligible even when the release round's feat allowance, an actually owned class shared allowance, or both have already been spent by another lawful use. This exemption belongs only to completion of that specific paid feat-copy hold; it does not waive any new direct cast's or unrelated class Echo's own allowances.

A declined trigger or an invalid precommit release, including no actual Reaction, invalid target/geometry, missing source predicate or uncompleted/unperceived trigger, spends no Reaction, makes no new debit and grants no hidden diagnostic. Keep the existing hold only while its actual concentration and original deadlines permit; another genuine trigger occurrence may be considered. An already-spent release-round copy allowance alone is NOT a failed-release reason. At an exact governing expiry, expiry wins. Lost concentration, actual abandonment, successful replacement or another real ending terminates the hold without a refund; a failed release cannot restore a hold that ended.

On a valid release commitment, atomically consume this hold once and spend the real Reaction before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, capture-use consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Subsequent prevention or a failed attack/save outcome does not refund the Reaction or preparation; actual source-specific hidden-eligibility checks retain their own paid timing. Duplicate callbacks/retry IDs cannot create a second payload or debit. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step end the held concentration after resolution. Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden under their actual effect clock and earlier limits, never a second concentration slot.

OTHER USES AND PERSISTENCE. Another copy in the release round still needs its own genuinely available Action/source permission, current legal resources/credentials, its own new-commitment allowances and all ordinary concentration/cadence predicates. No Action, Reaction refresh, capture or second concentration slot is granted. A concentration-breaking new cast can end the old hold even though its allowance is irrelevant to the old release. Releasing a prior hold first leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for a separate lawful new commitment; a lawful prior current-round use does not by itself block the old hold's release. Actual competing-use opportunities before the owner's next regular START are illustrative prerequisites unless supplied by a real source; the old Ready cannot be carried past that START merely to obtain the ordinary Action. Save/load, extra turns, changing routes/profiles or round labels must preserve owner/hold identity, original expiry, actual consumed receipts, completed release identity and chronological/per-round ledgers. Release never rewrites a later cast's history. This rule is a proposed authoring successor, not implementation of scheduling, live perception, source-qualified recipient effects, canonical persistence or the game engine.

records.name: Quickened Thought

sourceObject.name: Quickened Thought
sourceObject.description: Your mind outpaces the tick of Aethel's clocks—ideas arrive finished in the Temporal Tower's shadow, as if tomorrow's spell were already written in today's breath. Prestige lineage: Chronomancer. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.prerequisite: Intelligence 15+, Arcane Calculus or Temporal Theory
sourceObject.effect: You gain +2 to initiative and advantage on concentration saves while holding a readied spell. Once per short rest, you may cast a spell of 2nd level or lower as a bonus action; if you do, you cannot take a reaction until the start of your next turn. When you roll initiative, you may bank one cantrip cast—release it on any later turn in the encounter without spending an action.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual spellcasting AND (Nature proficiency OR a separately established Spellcraft credential). Spellcraft is not an Arcana alias; if absent, use the Nature alternative. Once per beneficial SR/LR, an Action places a fixed 15 ft radius Static Field at a perceived point within 60 ft and line of effect, requiring concentration for up to one minute. It affects all creatures, including allies: first actual entry or regular start inside per target per numbered round deals 1d6 lightning automatically. Placement covering a creature counts as entry once. While inside an active field, creatures have disadvantage on DEX saves, ending immediately on exit; actual immunities/suppression apply. Outdoors during an established storm, choose a 20 ft radius at creation. A separate once-SR/LR Action, Stormstep, teleports you up to 30 ft to a visible fitting unoccupied space with line of effect. Every other creature within 5 ft of arrival makes a DEX save against your actual casting DC for 1d8 thunder, half on success. NEW select the actual owned casting route at acquisition for both feat activations. Your afterimage supplies half cover until your next regular start only when the geometric ray from the incoming effect origin to your new position passes through your previous occupied space; it is not a solid object or general AC bonus. During an actual outdoor storm, your lightning spells also ignore half cover, but not stronger cover. These activations are nonspell magical feat techniques; they do not create weather, RP or extra casting resources.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: At your original regular-turn end, bank at most one genuinely unused NORMAL allowance: your wholly unspent movement budget, ordinary free object interaction, or unused ordinary Bonus Action. You must be conscious, able to act and actually possess it; prohibited, extra, borrowed, banked, readied or generated allowances cannot fund a token. Movement requires zero movement spent this turn; snapshot actual legal distance and modes. Consume the chosen allowance into one typed token; hold at most two, expiring at encounter end. On a later own regular turn, spend at most one token of each type without Action for its exact purpose: move up to min(stored feet, current legal normal Speed), one ordinary interaction, or one currently legal BA ability. Pay current terrain; modes must still exist. No conversion to full Action, Reaction, work time or new token, and no refresh of feature uses/cadences. After the second token spent in the real encounter, record one irrevocable fatigue cost due at encounter end: NEW one Core Exhaustion level, with actual immunity/recovery and lethal level 6 rules. Further spending creates no extra fatigue under this source but cannot erase the cost. No Time Loop, rewind or resource restoration.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Conjure Flora OR Verdant Bond qualifies for acquisition, but this feat supplies no missing plants. NEW only actual Conjure Flora profiles below qualify until another source is reviewed. At creation optionally arm a plant’s square as a magical trap using its fixed mode/burst type. Each meaningful hostile’s first actual entry in that square per numbered round, including forced entry but not plant placement, makes DEX save against flora DC; failure applies the profile’s trap result, success none. A legal trigger commits the owner’s shared offensive-companion allowance even on a save; if already spent by a command/other trap, no new trap activation occurs that round. One entrance cannot multiply across plants. Plants are visible, not automatically hidden: Action INT(Investigation) vs flora DC identifies an armed mode; Action DEX with actual thieves’ tools vs same DC disarms one trap without destroying its body, failure gives no automatic explosion. sourceObject.description: The green speaks to you in sap and silence. You answer with growth. Prestige lineage: Verdant Animist. completed from the existing development record.)
sourceObject.effect: You can communicate simple ideas to plants within 60 feet and sense coarse emotions from rooted life (fear, hunger, dormancy). While you have at least one conjured flora active, you gain +1 to spell save DC and attack rolls for nature spells, and difficult terrain from nonmagical plants does not cost you extra movement. You have advantage on Nature checks in wilderness terrain. Once per long rest, you may ask a stand of plants to hold a memory for 24 hours—a whispered name, direction, or warning that replays when an ally you designate passes within 10 feet.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: While conscious, exchange brief simple ideas with actual plants within 60 ft you perceive and have line of effect to, using ordinary communication; receive only coarse current fear, hunger, dormancy, not language, intelligence, visions, identity records or omniscient history. A plant may be unresponsive; compel nothing. Gain advantage on actual Nature checks in wilderness terrain, with normal work/senses. While at least one Conjure Flora seedling remains active, gain+1 spell attack/DC under the NEW finite Nature predicate: spells actually cast through your Druid, Ranger or Shaman route, excluding copied profiles; no alias from a plant-themed name. Current strongest same-stat bonus applies. In that same active-flora state, difficult terrain caused solely by nonmagical plants costs normal movement; other causes/hazards remain. Once LR spend one uninterrupted minute at a real rooted stand within reach to store a brief message of at most 25 words and one designated known ally identity. For 24 elapsed hours, the first time that ally passes within 10 ft the stand whispers it audibly once and ends the record. Others can hear normally; no remote confirmation or extracted plant memory. Destroying the stand ends the message; no new sentience or cosmology is asserted.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: After your personally cast noncopy spell deals positive resolved damage, optionally apply one Agony record to one living damaged target, once per owner/target/numbered round. Reapplication refreshes one profile without stacked dice. It deals 1d4 necrotic at the next three original target regular-start markers; a CON save against the generating cast DC at each affected regular end, including a current turn if applicable, ends it. The final third scheduled pulse ends the record after damage; no extra ending save afterward. It is a magical ongoing wound, not Core Wound, maximum HP injury or Bleeding by name. NEW a legal positive-potential magical heal or Action Medicine vs source DC ends it; suppressed records remain curable. While active, disadvantage applies only to actual existing CON saves to regain HP and actual saves against resurrection effects; no such save is invented. Death suspends living damage, retaining only the unexpired record tied to that exact death instance until the original third-start deadline; missed pulses are consumed, never backlogged. A legal revival closes that corpse-specific resurrection rider and retains only any still-future living pulse schedule until cured/expired. This grants no resurrection block or permission. sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Retain permanentINT15 prerequisite and resistance to psychic damage, subject to one same-type resistance. NEW while conscious, initiate one two-way telepathic conversation with one actual Aberration you perceive within60ft and line of effect. A brief message uses the ordinary free communication allowance on your own regular turn; an invited willing recipient may reply briefly without Action, including off-turn, without gaining another action. Both must know at least one language, but need not share one. No automatic type detection: choosing a non-Aberration produces no channel, not a diagnosis of why it failed. Recipient may refuse/end communication; you cannot read thoughts, memories, emotions or intentions, compel responses, or impersonate a voice. Maintain actual range/line of effect; loss ends the link. Silence/Deafened alone does not block purely mental speech, but Unconscious or explicit telepathy/mental-communication protection does. One channel at a time, no relay or shared senses. This grants no Aberration creature type, mutation activation or alien-origin fact.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual Gnome heritage. NEW once per24 elapsed hours, spend10 uninterrupted minutes with actual usable tinkers tools and5gp of suitable owned mundane parts; commit the use and parts at construction start. The feat grants construction permission with these tools but no general tool proficiency. On completion roll1d4 openly on the four complete profiles below; no choice, reroll, duplicate product or refund for an unwanted result. One active feat gadget at a time; beginning a new legal construction ends the old gadget. Interrupted work loses the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget. FT84 source-follow-through selection (proposed; the following explicit interaction controls only this named composition):
FT84-Q03 / FT84-CLOSED-CREATION-01 — Craftsman applies to actual authorized creation, not names or all fixed-duration work.
INTERPRETATION SELECTED: personally leading an independently authorized closed feat process that makes/assembles a new usable physical body or prepared kit is eligible creation even when it is non-artisan, lacks a catalog recipe ID or prints a fixed base duration. Craftsman supplies only its half-active-time factor; it supplies no process, skill, formula, assistants, work opportunity, materials, use or output. Use the strongest genuinely applicable creation reduction once. An explicit source exclusion or distinct alteration/preparation/service category still controls. Keep actual physical minimum phases only where the source requires them; do not manufacture an advanced-recipe incorporation phase for every short feat process.
Contraption Crafter's ten minutes are the ordinary base for its real gadget construction. With actual personally leading Craftsman ownership the complete job is five uninterrupted active minutes, not ten with a final five-minute discount and not two-and-a-half from a second equivalent half. The whole adjusted job must be uninterrupted; phase logging, assistant handoff, pauses, rest or partially completed earlier attempts cannot satisfy it. Keep actual Gnome heritage, usable tinker's tools, the same five-gp suitable owned parts and the same once-per-24-elapsed-hours use committed at start. A new lawful construction still ends its old gadget at start. Interruption spends the committed parts/use and yields no working gadget, no completion roll, no refundable tail and no resumable partial product. Completion rolls the same one d4 openly, once; it grants no chosen profile, duplicate gadget, general proficiency, quality, recipe XP or parts recovery. The same one-hour gadget lifetime starts at actual completion, not at the undiscounted hypothetical finish. Transfer/deployment/activation/recharge rules are unchanged. The time benefit is prospective and cannot manufacture a mid-job feat acquisition opportunity; if a real change interrupts the required work, the ordinary failure consequence applies.
Trapsetter's independently authorized thirty-active-minute kit assembly is likewise eligible creation: fifteen active minutes with Craftsman. This includes only its actual prepared-kit assembly from the real source parts; it cannot manufacture an ordinary twenty-caltrop stock bag out of an arbitrary substitute or count buying/deploying one as new creation. Keep the one completion DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves-tools check, ordinary task degree/natural shifts collapsed to binary, actual parts, failure consumption and recoverable remaining metal/frame. No manufacturing quality/yield/XP or general recipe is added. NEW NARROW WORK-CREDIT COMPLETION for this otherwise unphased kit assembly: track actual active work in seconds against the adjusted required total; pauses do not by themselves erase already completed usable physical assembly work. A pause earns no credit, protection or rest entitlement. Preserve the actual partial body and committed stock under their ordinary custody, deterioration and loss rules; work that a genuine physical event destroys cannot remain credited. The unfinished kit has no function. Resume only the remaining actual work with the real usable/replacement parts; do not duplicate stock, credit or partial bodies. No completion roll occurs until the whole adjusted job is actually complete. Neither Contraption's uninterrupted-work/use forfeiture nor advanced manufacture's incorporation/stabilization is imported. A more-specific explicitly authorized phase/loss rule still controls.
Kit assembly does not spend or refresh Trapsetter's three source-specific quick-placement allowances, arm a trap, clear an old active slot, reset hard-denial history or reduce placement, arming, disarming, collection or trigger/Reaction costs. Those remain separately paid physical events.
Apply the same predicate to Bowyer's actual bounded mundane bow/arrow creation and Master Smithing's authorized weapon/armor creation: their actual creation work qualifies, with full bridge credentials, stock, DC, phases and waits. Combat Engineering's actual barricade creation also qualifies but its own half factor and Craftsman compare once (60 to30, not15). Master Smithing's expressly nondiscounted eight-hour temper and Combat Engineering's expressly fixed ten-minute kill-zone preparation remain unchanged. Separate encoding, repair, maintenance, harvesting, copying, ritual casting and rest remain outside Craftsman. Actual advanced recipe121 still keeps its own required included incorporation/phase/stock/assistant rules; the short feat processes do not rewrite them. Merely printing a fixed duration neither exempts genuine creation nor makes a noncreation activity eligible.

sourceObject.description: Racial feat tied to Ogre heritage.
sourceObject.effect: Your melee hits knock targets back 5 feet if you're moving.

records.originalQuestion: Bind actual Ogre heritage,melee hit and precise moving requirement: own movement distance,straight path,timing,one hit versus every hit and cooldown. Define5ft push direction,target-size/save/space/collision,forced movement,reach and no source-implied bonus damage or extra attacks.

sourceDirection.name: Crushing Advance
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Bind actual Ogre heritage,melee hit and precise moving requirement: own movement distance,straight path,timing,one hit versus every hit and cooldown. originalSourceObject.name: Crushing Advance
originalSourceObject.description: Racial feat tied to Ogre heritage.
originalSourceObject.effect: Your melee hits knock targets back 5 feet if you're moving.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual Ogre heritage. NEW once on your own original regular turn, after moving at least5ft of voluntary continuous movement directly toward a target immediately before your next personal melee attack against it, a hit may push it5ft directly away. The approach must use a real movement mode and paid path with no intervening action/attack/teleport/forced displacement; the attack itself is the endpoint. The melee attack can be weapon, unarmed or spell if otherwise legal. No extra movement, attack or damage. NEW no saving throw and target at most one size larger than your actual body, not Powerful Build; choose use after hit before resolving push. Resolve damage/immediate riders first; target must still exist and be legally movable. Push uses ordinary forced-movement collision, occupies legal space and stops before a barrier, never adds collision damage or ordinary opportunity attacks. If no legal positive displacement remains, no movement occurs and the chosen attempt remains used. Other independently qualified source pushes retain their exact stacking rules; this is no once-per-hit loop.

submittedWorkedCases: A Large Ogre approaches5ft, hits a Huge target and may push it5ft if the path is clear.
An ally shoving the Ogre toward a foe does not meet voluntary approach; striking a wall-backed target adds no impact damage.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual Goblin heritage. NEW favored-skill scope is fixed from its actual chosen variant evidence: all Goblins gain Stealth checks through base Nimble Escape; Boom adds INT checks specifically concerning alchemy/explosives/incendiaries under Demolition Expert; Scrap adds WIS Perception to find useful junk or hidden objects and DEX Sleight of Hand to find hidden objects under its printed scavenging clauses; Shadow retains Stealth only. This is a task list derived for the feat, not a cultural truth or a new proficiency grant. On a qualifying actually rolled check, compute ordinary totalT after other legal modifiers, add floor(max(0,T)/10), then compare toDC/opposed total and apply normal task natural-result shifts. This is an explicit NEW10%-of-nonnegative-check-total interpretation of effectiveness, preserving the original percentage rather than substituting a flat bonus. No recursive multiplication, passive-perception multiplier, extra loot, reduced cost/time, spell/save/attack bonus or unprinted explosive creation. On opposed checks only your own eligible total changes. A natural1/20 retains its normal task shift; the bonus cannot abolish it. No re-roll or extra proficiency; zero/negative totals add0.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW select the Warrior4 counterpart's Reaction denial, explicitly replacing the standalone oneAction loss for this proposal. Require an Aberrant mutation equipped and at least the actual generating Aberrant mutation active. When an actual hostile fails a save against your directly applied Aberrant mutation effect, it loses its Reaction through the end of its next future regular turn. This is triggered, costs no extra action, and is once per actual target per encounter across both catalog representations. Range/target legality comes from that mutation, not an additional universal aura. Source immunity/prevention blocks the applicable rider; do not add Charmed, Stunned, silence, Speed0 or new hard denial. Reaction denial affects ordinary and extra Reaction tokens but does not spend or create them; expiry reveals any other still-operative restriction. A failed save against an unrelated spell, ally effect, periodic damage without a save or equipped-but-dormant mutation does not qualify. No loss of normalAction or guarantee of surrender. Retain the broader original wording as the explicit rejected alternative pending joint decision.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual Feykin heritage. Commit the attacker's action, ammunition and source costs first, then roll this check before its ordinary attack die or automatic-hit resolution. The first legal attack consumes that attacker's encounter record even if the percentage check succeeds or its later attack roll would miss. No record is spent by an illegal/out-of-range declaration. It applies to real melee/ranged weapon, unarmed and spell attacks, including a source-qualified automatic-hit attack; an automatic damaging effect without attack classification, save-only effect, ongoing tick or environmental damage is not an attack. For a multiattack sequence only its first attack faces this roll; one attack with several components faces one check. No sight requirement on either combatant is invented. Leaving/reentering, disguise, charm changes or a new form of the same attacker never resets the record. This is a supernatural feat defense with no creature-type, invisibility or cosmology grant.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW require Warrior8 and equipped/active Ossified Core. Its existing extra-critical-dice prevention is the qualifying critical-protection state; the feat does not declare every critical hit a normal hit or prevent critical-triggered riders. Adopt the counterpart scope: halve only bonus damage explicitly identified by an actual source as Sneak Attack or equivalent precision damage. A critical, poison, elemental infusion, spell rider or ordinary ability modifier is not automatically precision. NEW this halving is a source-specific precision resistance layer: halve each typed precision component once, rounding down; an existing same-type damage resistance also covering that component does not halve it again. Other nonprecision damage remains subject to its own ordinary defenses; vulnerability/immunity and fixed reduction use current damage ordering. If mixed precision types have already been separated, apply their own immunity/resistance once each; do not halve the entire weapon packet because one part is precision. Ossified's separate post-resistance piercing−2 applies once by its own event contract. Benefits stop when Ossified is not active. No new resistance to every critical or all physical damage.

sourceObject.description: Successful kills enhance your combat capabilities.

records.originalQuestion: Reconcile melee kill with Warrior4 counterpart meaningful-hostile zeroHP,once per round,next-melee-attack+1 and Speed+10 until next regular-turn end. Define dying/dead distinction,ownership,refresh/stacking,actual mutation activation and movement already spent. Preserve anti-farming and no additional full Action.

sourceDirection.name: Kill-Chain Adaptation
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Reconcile melee kill with Warrior4 counterpart meaningful-hostile zeroHP,once per round,next-melee-attack+1 and Speed+10 until next regular-turn end. Define dying/dead distinction,ownership,refresh/stacking,actual mutation activation and movement already spent. Preserve anti-farming and no additional full Action.

originalSourceObject.name: Kill-Chain Adaptation
originalSourceObject.description: Successful kills enhance your combat capabilities.
originalSourceObject.effect: After a melee kill, gain +10 ft movement and +1 to hit

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW require Warrior4 and two actual Combat mutations equipped and active at the trigger. Once per numbered round, after your personal direct melee attack reduces an independent meaningful hostile from positiveHP to0, gain+10ft to each existing usable Speed mode and one+1 entitlement on your next melee attack roll, both ending at the end of your next future original regular turn. This intentionally selects the counterpart zeroHP trigger rather than requiring actual death; resolve floors/knockout/death replacements first. The trigger grants no attack or fullAction. Copies, owned companion damage, ongoing ticks, captives, harmless targets and recycled bodies do not qualify. Modes derived from another Speed include this bonus once, not twice; previously spent movement remains spent. The attack entitlement consumes on the next legal melee attack roll, hit or miss; a save-only melee effect does not consume it. Same-family new trigger may refresh an unexpired record under the once-round cap but never gives+20ft or queued+1s. It ends if required equipped or active mutation eligibility is lost, even before its deadline. Encounter transitions do not extend or refresh either benefit.

A second down in the same round adds nothing. The next legal melee attack consumes+1 even if it misses.

records.originalQuestion: Bind three actually active Vital mutations against real slot/active limits and temporary exceptions; resolve equipped-only prerequisite versus active benefit and Warrior8 gate. Identify actual flanking rule before denying its sole advantage. Do not erase other advantage sources,nearby allies or tactical positioning effects by an undefined blanket immunity.

sourceDirection.name: Living Fortress
sourceDirection.originalQuestion: Bind three actually active Vital mutations against real slot/active limits and temporary exceptions; resolve equipped-only prerequisite versus active benefit and Warrior8 gate. Identify actual flanking rule before denying its sole advantage. Do not erase other advantage sources,nearby allies or tactical positioning effects by an undefined blanket immunity.

originalSourceObject.name: Living Fortress
originalSourceObject.description: Multiple vital mutations make you nearly impregnable.
originalSourceObject.effect: Gain immunity to flanking

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: NEW require Warrior8 and three actual Vital mutations equipped for acquisition; the benefit operates only while at least three distinct Vital mutations are actually active. No feat adds slots or active limits: the Warrior must have actual unlocked slots and an expressly acquired temporary active-count exception where needed. A Warrior8 normally cannot equip three mutations, so the printed level is a minimum rather than proof of present eligibility. Selected doctrine is the counterpart precise protection: opponents receive no advantage solely from a source explicitly granting advantage for flanking you. Reviewed ordinary combat has no global flanking advantage; this feat does not invent one. Independent unseen/Restrained/other advantage survives. It does not erase nearby bodies, ally assistance, legal target geometry, Tactical Flanker's separately proposed damage die, attacks or cover. When any required active state ends/suppresses, protection immediately stops; restoration within existing durations can restore protection without new actions or resources. No numericalAC/DR or immunity to all positioning effects.

sourceDirection.submittedProcedure: Require actual Umbrin heritage. While your actual occupied space is in total darkness, gain+2 to actualDEXStealth checks and add floor(native damage/10) to each eligible personal direct attack/spell damage event. NEW your whole occupied footprint must be dark, not dim or partly illuminated; determine this independently from darkvision, which changes perception rather than illumination. It grants no ability to see targets, Hide automatically or ignore your actual Sunlight Sensitivity. Damage bonus uses the already proposed common pre-percentage base after critical dice/flat additions and before defenses; allocate increment across native typed components by proportional largest remainder with stable ties. Count direct initial attacks/spell resolutions, not copies, companion attacks, transfers or later ongoing ticks; one area event uses each target's actual native packet after its save as usual. No new attack/damage event or added damage type. Check darkness at the attack/spell's actual damage resolution and at the Stealth check; a light-generating effect can remove eligibility before damage. Distinct percentage sources do not compound and the flatStealth bonus never grants a proficiency credential.
